title: Account Executive Auth0
description: Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. Auth0 supports Okta’s vision of freeing anyone to safely use any technology by providing a secure, highly available, enterprise-grade platform that secures billions of log-ins every year for Consumers and SaaS applications. This team in the I BERIA is growing exponentially with net new growth headcount being released to support the demand in the market. The Auth0 Account Executive Opportunity As an Auth0 Account Executive, you'll play a pivotal role in expanding our footprint and driving significant revenue growth. You'll be instrumental in demonstrating the profound value of our platform to Application Development teams, including Engineering, Product, Security, and Architecture leaders. This isn't just about closing deals; it's about building lasting partnerships, identifying new opportunities, and nurturing existing customer relationships to ensure their continued success and expansion with Auth0. What You'll Do: Drive New Business Growth: Proactively generate and nurture top-of-funnel activity to create a robust pipeline of new customer opportunities. Master the Sales Cycle: Execute every sales engagement with precision, leveraging a methodical and controlled sales approach to navigate complex deals. Strategic Territory Management: Develop and execute comprehensive territory plans, demonstrating strong operational excellence and delivering accurate forecasts. Engage Technical Audiences: Employ a sophisticated "bottom-up, top-down" strategy to effectively target and engage Developers, Engineering Leaders and other technical stakeholders. Achieve and Exceed Targets: Skilfully scope, negotiate, and close agreements, consistently meeting and exceeding your revenue quota. Cultivate Internal Partnerships: Build and foster strong, collaborative relationships within your Okta ecosystem, including SDRs, Pre-Sales, and Customer Success teams, to ensure seamless customer experiences. Deliver Value-Driven Insights: Adopt a compelling, value-based sales approach, consistently bringing a unique and insightful point of view to every customer interaction. Connect In-Person: Travel as needed to meet with customers, building stronger relationships and understanding their unique needs firsthand. What you’ll bring: • Proven Enterprise SaaS Sales Success: Demonstrable track record of successfully selling complex enterprise SaaS products to large organisations. • Technical Sales Acumen: Significant experience and comfort selling to highly technical customer profiles. • Executive Engagement: Ability to educate and create demand with C-level decision-makers, effectively articulating the business value of Auth0. • Hunter Mentality: Strong experience and a clear passion for acquiring and then expanding new logo accounts. • Complex Deal Navigation: Proven ability to navigate intricate sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, both within the customer organisation and your internal ecosystem. • Technical Curiosity: A strong technical aptitude and an insatiable curiosity to continuously learn and understand new technologies. • Sales Framework Expertise: Demonstrated expertise in utilising a structured sales framework such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Sandler. title: Account Executive - UK
description: Our Mission: Why Lighthouse? At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue. With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act. Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light We are Lumineers . Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment Pursuit of greatness : We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail Meaningful work matters : We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward Elevate each other : We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship? 🚀 Job details ● 💼 Revenue Team ● 📍Barcelona ● 🕜 Full-Time Hybrid What you will do You’ll be the face of Lighthouse for our most strategic prospects, owning complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles from prospecting to close. This is a senior hunter role: you carry a significant quota, you build your own pipeline, and you’re accountable to outcomes and success. No excuses, just results. What makes this different: you won’t do it alone. Lighthouse is deploying an agent AI infrastructure — Enablement, Pre-Sales, and Coaching agents — alongside a modern revenue stack. AI handles the prep, the sequencing, and the pattern recognition so you can focus on what matters — building relationships, running sharp discovery, and closing deals. Where you will have impact Own your territory and your number. Build and execute a strategic territory plan targeting high value and enterprise accounts. Maintain 3x pipeline coverage, forecast honestly, and take full accountability for your results. Your quota is your commitment. Hunt and build a pipeline. Source a meaningful share of your own pipeline through outbound sequences, ICP targeting, your existing network, Lighthouse Connect events, and industry conferences. Activate relationships from prior roles and industry tenure. This is not an SDR-reliant role. Run a disciplined sales process. Using MEDDPICC to qualify and advance opportunities. Use the AI Pre-Sales Agent to identify gaps before every major call. Navigate complex deal cycles with multiple stakeholders and longer timelines. Advance deals through stage gates with evidence, not optimism. Leverage AI to make your days easier and focus on more selling time. Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage the Enablement Agent for call prep, discovery frameworks, and positioning. Use the Coaching Agent to surface patterns in your pipeline and win rate. Push back on the tools when they’re wrong — help make the system smarter. Become a hospitality expert. Understand the commercial challenges hotels face across pricing, distribution, and business intelligence. Position Lighthouse’s full platform as the integrated solution that replaces fragmented point tools. Know the competitive landscape inside out and run value based ROI conversations confidently. Drive results beyond net-new. Consistently meet and exceed sales targets through new business and by identifying expansion and upgrade opportunities within your accounts. Partner with Product to share market feedback and influence the roadmap. Represent Lighthouse at industry events to build the brand and your network. Elevate the team around you. Share deal strategies, competitive insights, and best practices with the broader AE team. Informally mentor newer reps and contribute to playbooks and enablement content. This isn’t a management role, but leadership is expected. About Our Team You’ll join a global Revenue team of 150+ sales professionals across 24 countries. Our team works across the full Lighthouse product suite, helping hotels, chains, and hospitality groups achieve their commercial goals . It’s a collaborative, high-energy environment with real opportunities for career growth and the chance to learn from experienced leaders as we continue to expand our market share. What’s in it for you Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices. Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance. Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery. Payflow App: Access your earned salary in advance at no cost to you. Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery. Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription. Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents. Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues. Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential. Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide. Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work. Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent. Who You Are 5+ years in a closing sales role with a consistent track record of hitting or exceeding quota. SaaS experience is essential; hospitality tech is a strong advantage. Self-directed, coachable, and driven to continuously improve. You seek feedback on your calls, your pipeline, and your positioning — and act on it within the next deal, not the next quarter. You treat AI tools as a core part of your selling motion, not a novelty. You adopt new tooling quickly and bend it to your style. You’ve worked with MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks and can demonstrate how structured deal execution has driven your results. Strong business acumen with the ability to sell on value, not price. Confident engaging stakeholders from GMs to C-suite and navigating complex buying committees. • You want to win. You prospect when it would be easier not to. You follow up one more time. You’re not okay with a bad quarter Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter. Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you! title: Senior Account Manager
description: BidMachine Exchange – a fast-growing global programmatic exchange built for the future of in-app advertising. BidMachine operates with a strong US foundation and an international presence, with teams across Warsaw, Barcelona, Parkland (FL), and remote experts around the world. We combine deep AdTech expertise, proprietary technology, and a data-driven mindset to deliver transparency, performance, and efficiency in the mobile advertising ecosystem. Why BidMachine? At BidMachine, we are building more than an exchange — we are shaping the infrastructure that powers fair, efficient, and scalable in-app programmatic advertising. Our mission is to create a high-performance marketplace where publishers maximize value and advertisers access premium inventory with full transparency and control. We are proud of our technology, our ambitious vision, and our globally distributed team of talented professionals who continuously raise the bar in AdTech. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Ownership & Accountability We move fast, take responsibility, and think like builders. Every team member has a direct impact on product growth and market success. Data-Informed Excellence We leverage data to make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and build scalable solutions that deliver measurable results. Innovation & Technical Depth We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem. Global Collaboration We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards. Ambition & Impact We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market. About the Role As a Senior Account Manager, Publishers, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic publisher partnerships on the BidMachine exchange. Once a publisher is signed by our Sales team, you become the primary owner of the relationship—ensuring successful onboarding, maximizing revenue performance, driving adoption of new opportunities, and building long-term partnerships. You'll work at the intersection of commercial strategy, data analysis, customer success, and mobile ad tech. By understanding publishers' businesses and translating market insights into action, you'll directly influence BidMachine's supply growth and contribute to product evolution. What You'll Do Own and grow publisher partnerships Manage a portfolio of publisher accounts throughout their lifecycle. Build trusted, long-term relationships with key stakeholders. Conduct regular business reviews to discuss performance, opportunities, and strategic initiatives. Act as the primary point of contact for commercial and operational matters. Drive revenue growth Analyze account performance and identify revenue opportunities. Increase publishers' share of wallet through upsells, new products, and optimization initiatives. Proactively recommend strategies that improve monetization and strengthen publisher performance. Maintain a healthy commercial pipeline within your existing portfolio. Ensure successful onboarding and activation Lead publisher onboarding after the Sales handover. Ensure agreed applications and inventory are successfully integrated and activated. Coordinate cross-functional efforts to remove blockers during launch. Solve problems and drive execution Monitor account health and respond quickly to revenue fluctuations, integration issues, and ad quality concerns. Coordinate with Product, Demand, Technical Support, and Data teams to resolve issues. Keep publishers informed throughout issue resolution while maintaining ownership of outcomes. Turn customer insights into product improvements Gather structured feedback from publishers. Identify recurring market trends and customer needs. Share actionable insights with Product and Demand teams to influence roadmap and commercial strategy. Contribute to improving internal tooling, monitoring systems, and knowledge sharing. Represent BidMachine externally Attend industry events and conferences. Expand your network within the mobile advertising ecosystem. Position BidMachine as a strategic partner within the publisher community. What We're Looking For Experience 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partner Management, or Publisher Development. Strong background in mobile advertising technology. Experience working with publishers, mediation platforms, SSPs, exchanges, or monetization products. Proven track record of growing revenue within existing customer portfolios. Technical & Analytical Skills Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret performance data and identify business opportunities. Comfortable working with dashboards, reports, and large datasets. Understanding of mobile monetization, programmatic advertising, and publisher economics. Ability to discuss technical integrations with engineering teams and customers. Commercial Skills Experience running business reviews and executive-level customer conversations. Strong negotiation, upselling, and relationship management skills. Ability to balance customer advocacy with business objectives. Soft Skills Exceptional ownership and accountability. Highly proactive with strong problem-solving abilities. Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Curious, adaptable, and eager to continuously improve processes. How Success Is Measured Success in this role is measured through: Portfolio revenue growth Activation of signed publisher inventory Growth in publisher spend and share of wallet Customer retention and satisfaction Quality and speed of issue resolution Successful upsell execution Quality of customer insights shared across the organization You'll Work Closely With Sales Demand Operations Product Management Technical Support Data Analytics As the commercial owner of your portfolio, you'll coordinate across these teams to deliver the best outcomes for publishers. What Makes Someone Successful The strongest Senior Account Managers at BidMachine: Think like business owners rather than account coordinators. Use data to identify opportunities before customers do. Build trusted relationships that extend beyond transactional support. Balance reactive issue resolution with proactive revenue generation. Continuously contribute ideas that improve our products, tools, and ways of working. With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space. Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!

title: Lead AI Consultant (Field)
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. You will lead the team of junior Consultants and team with experts (AI, Product, Functional) to make sure the customer achieves value and adoption. As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization. This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption. The Work You’ll Do Pre-Sales: Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity. Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals. Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans. Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. description: At Revlon, we create beauty innovations for everyone that inspire confidence and ignite joy every day. Breaking beauty boundaries is in our company’s DNA. Elizabeth Arden made waves as a woman-led beauty company in the 1920s. In 1931, Almay became the original hypoallergenic, fragrance-free beauty brand. Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more. We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers. We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty. This role is a Hybrid Role: Employees are expected to work from our office in Barcelona (Cornellà de Llobregat) 3 days per week and may work remotely the remaining days Overview We are looking for an experienced eCommerce Business Development Manager (Amazon) to accelerate growth across our Mass Beauty portfolio and play a key role in expanding our eCommerce business. This is a high-impact position for a commercially driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment and has a proven track record managing Amazon businesses at scale. Reporting to the Senior Director of eCommerce, you will own the commercial performance of the Amazon channel, driving revenue growth, profitability, brand visibility, and customer experience. What you'll do As the business owner for Amazon, you will: Lead the end-to-end management of Revlon's Amazon business with full P&L accountability. Develop and execute growth strategies aligned with brand priorities, pricing, and profitability objectives. Drive sales and market share through assortment optimization, promotional planning, and successful new product launches. Build and manage strategic relationships with Amazon and key internal stakeholders. Lead Joint Business Planning, forecasting, negotiations, and performance reviews. Optimize the digital shelf, including content, imagery, A+ content, and SEO, to maximize visibility and conversion. Analyze commercial performance, market trends, shopper behavior, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities. Partner closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Brand teams to ensure flawless execution and operational excellence. Stay ahead of eCommerce trends, tools, and innovations to strengthen Revlon's market leadership. What we're looking for Required qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in eCommerce, Business Development, Key Account Management, or a similar commercial role. Proven success managing Amazon Vendor Central and/or Seller Central accounts with measurable growth results. Solid experience within FMCG, Beauty, Personal Care, Consumer Goods, or related industries. Strong analytical capabilities, advanced Excel skills, and data-driven decision-making. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Highly organized, proactive, and commercially focused. Preferred qualifications Experience working with Amazon Retail Analytics (ARA) and other eCommerce analytics tools. Knowledge of digital marketing levers including AMS/AMC, DSP, and SEO. title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
description: Location : Come and join us in Barcelona! Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. One of our core goals for 2026 is the complete digitalization of the European taxi market. We work with taxi companies to provide them with our advanced dispatch and fleet management software completely free of charge. This enables them to significantly reduce operating costs, successfully differentiate themselves from major ride-hailing providers, and manage a profitable, sustainable business. To support this, we are looking for a Sales Manager who will become the face of this initiative. We look forward to your application and can't wait to have you on board for this journey! As we are an international company, we ask that you submit your application documents in English. YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE: Prospect, engage, travel and pitch our Dispatch tool to SME taxi companies in Spain. You are the driving force behind converting traditional vehicle fleets into modern, connected Freenow by Lyft partners. Guide entrepreneurs, fleet owners, and senior dispatchers through the fear of operational change. Act as the voice of our partners. You will gather on-the-ground feedback about our software and collaborate directly with our Product and Strategy teams to help "co-build" the ultimate solution. TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE: 3-5 years of professional experience in areas such as B2B business development, sales, or account management. Experience in mobility, logistics, or selling SaaS solutions to SMEs is especially valued. Proven track record of managing a B2B pipeline and handling objections. You understand that even when a product is free, you still have to expertly "sell" the time, effort, and operational shift required to adopt it. Strong communication skills with the ability to build trust and long-term relationships. The ability to deeply understand a partner's business operations at a process level. You are skilled at guiding new partners step by step through the change process and ensuring they smoothly adopt the new software and new workflows. You see travel as an essential part of the role. You don't mind spending a significant portion of your working time (up to 40–50%) on the road if needed, meeting partners exactly where they operate. Fluency in English and Spanish is required due to regular interaction with clients and internal stakeholders. Beyond new partner acquisition, this role also involves an ongoing account management component. You will be expected to support local operations in the respective markets, own new client onboarding end to end, coordinate internal stakeholders to ensure successful launch, and maintain and nurture relationships with existing partners even after onboarding, to ensure continued satisfaction and smooth day-to-day operations. BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL: Flexible working arrangements LinkedIn Learning Sabbatical & special leave policies WeRoad partnership Birthday, 24th + 31st December off Short term EU work policy Mobility Credit Employee assistance program Plus more local benefits depending on your work location! DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION: Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age. We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work . ABOUT FREENOW: Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

title: Account Executive, Enterprise
description: At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture. If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you. WHAT YOU’LL DO The ideal candidate has at least 5 years of SaaS selling experience within CRM, Marketing Automation, CDP, Analytics, or Content Marketing Solutions. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, you have a knack for simply selling complex tech solutions, and you excel in fast-paced environments. Responsibilities Execute deal cycles from inception to close, navigating through various stakeholders within large organizations. Deal sizes typically range from $500K to $2.5M+. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers at all levels of an organization. Drive value-based selling strategies, leveraging MEDPICC to effectively articulate our value proposition. Proactively identify and qualify new opportunities through targeted prospecting, networking, and market research efforts to continually build your pipeline. Create strategic growth opportunities for your existing customer base. Build strong cross-functional relationships with teams such as business development, marketing, deal desk, customer success & services. Qualifications Minimum of 2 years of experience in Enterprise sales, with proven successes in executing complex deal cycles and driving high-value sales opportunities. Strong understanding of value-based selling techniques and experience. Familiarity with Force Management’s sales training; Command of the Message and MEDDPICC is preferred Ability to research accounts, develop a point of view (POV) on the value your technology can drive for the account, and prioritize accounts across a territory to maximize bookings A demonstrated history of net-new prospecting and pipeline generation, both personally and in collaboration with BDRs and Marketing partners Executive presence with exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to effectively engage and influence executive-level stakeholders. Experience working with cross-functional teams and demonstrated ability to build strong internal relationships across various departments. Familiarity with navigating agency and technology partner ecosystems, with a demonstrated ability to leverage partnerships to enhance sales capabilities. Experience with Salesforce.com CRM or any other CRM utilized for sales pipeline management required. A proven connector in your daily life through social media and other mediums Prior experience in a startup, or emerging growth, technology company a plus Ability to travel to customer/prospect sites, marketing events, and to company and regional gatherings WHAT WE OFFER Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as: Competitive compensation that may include equity Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans Flexible paid time off Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® ABOUT BRAZE Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences. The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025. Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore. description: BidMachine Exchange – a fast-growing global programmatic exchange built for the future of in-app advertising. BidMachine operates with a strong US foundation and an international presence, with teams across Warsaw, Barcelona, Parkland (FL), and remote experts around the world. Innovation & Technical Depth We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem. Global Collaboration We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards. Ambition & Impact We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market. BidMachine is looking for an entrepreneurial Head of Business Development & Product Strategy to own the commercial success and market evolution of our mediation business. This role sits at the intersection of business development, product, and go-to-market. You'll build relationships with leading publishers and prospective mediation customers, identify market opportunities, bring competitive intelligence back into the business, and work closely with Product leadership to shape what we build next. Success in this role isn't measured by producing strategy presentations—it's measured by winning customers, identifying opportunities before competitors, and turning market feedback into product decisions that drive revenue. You'll work in close partnership with our Head of Business Development and the broader Supply organization to ensure our mediation business evolves as one integrated commercial offering rather than a standalone product. This is a highly operational role for someone who enjoys being in the market, speaking with customers, validating ideas, and influencing both commercial and product decisions. Location: Barcelona, Spain Responsibilities: Own BidMachine's commercial strategy for the mediation business by continuously engaging with customers, prospects, partners, and the broader market. Build and maintain executive relationships with leading publishers and prospective mediation clients, identifying unmet needs and converting them into commercial opportunities. Drive customer discovery by conducting senior-level meetings that uncover real business challenges and validate future product opportunities. Own BidMachine's understanding of the competitive mediation landscape, continuously monitoring competitors' products, positioning, pricing, partnerships, and go-to-market strategies. Translate validated customer demand and competitive intelligence into clear product priorities, partnering closely with Product leadership to influence roadmap decisions. Act as the primary bridge between Product, Sales, and the market, ensuring every significant product investment addresses a real customer need. Partner closely with the existing sales and account management organization to ensure mediation opportunities are fully integrated into BidMachine's overall commercial strategy. Validate new product concepts before development by working directly with customers and assessing commercial demand and market viability. Represent BidMachine externally at industry events, customer meetings, and partner discussions, building the company's reputation within the mediation ecosystem. Continuously identify new commercial opportunities, partnerships, and market segments that can accelerate BidMachine's mediation business. Requirements: 8+ years of experience in business development, commercial leadership, partnerships, or product strategy within a leading mobile mediation platform. Deep understanding of the mobile mediation ecosystem, including publisher monetization, SDK integrations, mediation technologies, and the competitive landscape. Strong network across the mobile mediation industry, with a proven ability to build trusted executive relationships and convert them into commercial outcomes. Demonstrated experience influencing product direction through direct customer engagement and market validation rather than solely internal product management. Proven ability to operate across business development, product discussions, and commercial execution with equal confidence. Experience working closely with engineering and product teams to prioritize features based on customer demand and commercial impact. Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, validate them quickly, and drive execution. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Advanced Business English, both written and spoken. Willingness to relocate to Barcelona. Nice to Have: Senior leadership experience at one of the industry's leading mediation platforms. Experience across both mediation and adjacent supply-side products, including exchanges, SDKs, or publisher monetization platforms. Experience launching new products or business lines within a fast-growing ad tech company. Existing relationships with major mobile publishers and strategic ecosystem partners. With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space. Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!

title: Associate (AI) Solution Consultant (Benelux) - Orbit Program
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. Location: Madrid for an onboarding period of 2 years and a possible relocation to Amsterdam after. Customer base will be in the Benelux region, involving travel to meet clients in person. Role Description As an AI Solution Consultant you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You are part of our Value Engineering team and are the trusted advisor for customers working on the intersection of technology and business. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers. Launch Your Enterprise Software Career - Orbit Graduate program Kickstart your career in enterprise software through our immersive 12-month Orbit Program. During the Orbit Graduate program, you will be joining the Global VE Center of Excellence which is an international, diverse, and dynamic organization at the core of the Celonis Value Engineering team supporting our local field teams. As a team, we enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and share a sense of belonging to an international community that wants to learn and grow together. The team culture is one based on building trust, continuous development, and improvement through coaching & mentoring. This program offers a unique blend of client engagements, dedicated mentorship, and a strong team culture where collaboration and shared success are paramount. You'll leverage your technical background to develop essential skills, build lasting client relationships, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor, paving the way for significant career growth within Celonis. Your journey begins with comprehensive onboarding and enablement, followed by hands-on experience in customer engagements and targeted training. You will gain expertise in: Discovery & AI Solutioning Building and coding within the Celonis platform (SQL, PQL and Python) Scoping business and technical requirements Effectively handling objections Developing industry domain knowledge Delivering impactful presentations and demos Understanding value selling and realization Managing customer accounts What You'll Do: AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a “can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform Proof Projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects showcasing the value of Celonis Process Intelligence tailored to customers and align our solutions with their AI strategy. Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries Business Impact Presentations: Articulate and quantify strategic business value for customers, delivering impactful presentations to senior executives to ensure successful value realization for customers. Ensure Successful Project Outcome: AI Solution Consultants stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached Best Practice Modeling: Contribute to the Global Value Engineering Center of Excellence by creating reusable collateral, best practices, and tools. What You Need: Degree in Engineering, Data Analytics/Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related STEM field. Excellent academic performance Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work experience. Ideally at the intersection of business and technology. Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt/context engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors. Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies. Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply technology to business challenges. A customer-centric mindset with a focus on delivering value. Confidence in presenting to diverse audiences. A proactive approach to problem-solving, with a willingness to learn from mistakes. Curiosity, self-motivation, a commitment to continuous learning, and the desire to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and execute on deadlines. Excellent communication skills and fluency in English and Dutch. Foundational business acumen and domain understanding, e.g. in areas such as Supply Chain. Bonus Points: Degrees combining technical (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science) and business (e.g., Economics, Marketing) skills. Customer-facing, customer success/service, or sales experience. Hands-on experience with technical Proof of Concept projects Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages. Supply Chain process experience (Procurement, Order Management, Inventory Management, Production). Experience modeling ROI and TCO for business case justification. Experience with ERPs such as SAP and/or Oracle What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

title: Senior Data Strategy Manager
description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com . Nuestra cultura y nuestras personas son el motor de WPP Media, y nos impulsan a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales. En este rol, tu contribución será clave para vivir y promover nuestros valores: Ser Extraordinario: Liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza. Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa. Tu rol y contribución Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Data Technology & Analytics buscamos un/a Senior Data Strategy Manager que impulse la estrategia de datos de forma integral, actuando como principal punto de conexión entre negocio, tecnología y capacidades digitales para convertir los datos en una palanca real de transformación de negocio. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de: Liderar la conversación de datos con el cliente y los equipos internos, actuando como punto de conexión entre negocio, tecnología, medios y capacidades digitales para asegurar una visión compartida y una gobernanza efectiva del ecosistema de datos. Definir y evolucionar la hoja de ruta de transformación de datos a 2-3 años, garantizando la consolidación de los elementos fundamentales y la identificación de nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento y diferenciación. Priorizar iniciativas y liderar el portfolio de proyectos de datos, traduciendo necesidades de negocio en planes de acción concretos y coordinando a los equipos especializados para asegurar una implementación eficiente. Impulsar la ideación, diseño y supervisión de casos de uso end-to-end, asegurando una visión holística de los datos y su aplicación práctica para generar impacto tangible en negocio, experiencia de consumidor y eficiencia operativa. Actuar como facilitador transversal, conectando capacidades de CRM, CDP, Analytics, eCommerce, Media e IA para impulsar la adopción de nuevas capacidades, la gestión del cambio y la evolución de la madurez de datos del cliente. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Aportar experiencia demostrable liderando programas de transformación de datos, CRM o Customer Data Platforms en grandes organizaciones. Contar con experiencia trabajando en entornos complejos y gestionando múltiples stakeholders (marketing, tecnología, datos, eCommerce y negocio). Demostrar casos reales de implementación, adopción y generación de impacto de negocio (muy valorable experiencia en sectores con alta madurez digital como banca, tecnología, telecomunicaciones, retail o travel). Poseer un conocimiento profundo del ecosistema MarTech y AdTech, incluyendo CDP, estrategias de First Party Data, Data Governance, marcos de medición y Data Clean Rooms (DCR). Aportar conocimientos valorables en Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), IA aplicada a Marketing y Media, soluciones de identidad cookieless y herramientas de visualización de datos (BI). Combinar la definición estratégica con la ejecución práctica, participando activamente en la implantación de soluciones y modelos operativos. Demostrar una fuerte visión de negocio (Business Acumen), capacidad de resolución estratégica de problemas, mentalidad comercial y liderazgo transformacional con visión a largo plazo. Disponer de un Grado Universitario en Publicidad, Marketing, ADE o STEM (valorable Máster especializado). Contar con un nivel fluido o avanzado de inglés (mínimo C1), imprescindible para liderar reuniones globales. Vida en WPP Media y beneficios En WPP Media, invertimos en nuestra gente, impulsando tu crecimiento profesional con la misma pasión con la que lideramos la inversión responsable en medios. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Además de un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, en WPP Media nos preocupamos por tu bienestar y equilibrio. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete de beneficios pensado para ti: Flexibilidad: Disfruta de un modelo híbrido de teletrabajo en Madrid o Barcelona , complementado con flexibilidad horaria en la entrada y salida. Bienestar y ventajas: Accede a un plan de Retribución Flexible que se adapta a tus necesidades, subvención del menú diario y café y fruta en la oficina. Cuidado personal: Fomentamos tu salud y bienestar con clases de Yoga/Pilates y la posibilidad de sesiones de fisioterapia. Próximos pasos Si te identificas con esta oportunidad y quieres formar parte de WPP Media, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!. Envíanos tu candidatura y, si tu perfil encaja con lo que buscamos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo. WPP Media ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y considera las candidaturas para todos los puestos sin distinción de raza, color, sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, embarazo, nacimiento de un hijo/a, condiciones médicas o discapacidad. Para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas consulta nuestra Política de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ). #Hiring #WPPMedia #MediaAgency #DataTechnologyAnalytics #DataStrategy #MarTech #LI-PROMOTED Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Staff Technical Data Architect, Integrations
description: Our Mission: Why Lighthouse? At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue. With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act. Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light We are Lumineers . Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment Pursuit of greatness : We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail Meaningful work matters : We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward Elevate each other : We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship? 🚀 Job Details 💼 Engineering, Integrations 📍 Spain 🕜 Full-Time/Remote What you will do The Lighthouse Integrations Engineering teams are responsible for large-scale ingestion and transformation of hospitality data into Lighthouse’s data infrastructure. We build and maintain complex data pipelines handling large data sets from a wide range of connected hospitality systems. On a daily basis, our integrations data pipelines process millions of hotel reservations, tens of millions of prices, transactions and other data points from hundreds of integrated systems, hundreds of terabytes of daily data. As Staff Technical Data Architect, Integrations , you will own the technical architecture of our Integration domains, a set of end-to-end data domains, unifying the world's hospitality data into a strategic unified canonical data model. This is a high-impact role where you will see your work directly translate into real-world applications that impact hotels worldwide. The role requires you to combine strong technical experience in data architecture and data engineering with a good sense of business acumen, product affinity and a drive for excellence. Where you will have impact Own the technical architecture of the data systems and pipelines that ingest and transform the massive volume of data powering our products. Your work spans multiple engineering teams and domains. Gather requirements to realize the product and technical vision and to ingest and process the massive data sets we retrieve from third party systems Map out our current architecture, analyze and design the required future architecture to meet these requirements Help build, test, maintain, support and evolve the current and future architecture. Regularly dive deep into code, operational tooling, cloud resources, logs, monitoring, data quality, to stay grounded in the day-to-day reality of data engineering work. Proactively and continuously improve the architecture and systems design. Set up and own standards and best practices in data engineering and data architecture at scale. Be a trusted go-to technical authority for the data engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and high quality. Collaborate with the architects and leaders in other engineering and product teams, and in other parts of the organization to improve our organization’s architecture maturity. Embed AI strategy in the Integrations architecture, and set the standard for how AI is applied across the department in architecture and engineering work. Identify and prioritize AI initiatives across our pipelines, tooling and engineering workflows; design and pilot those solutions. About our team The Integrations function spans multiple teams and domains that ingest, process, and move large volumes of varied data across systems. As new roadmap initiatives create opportunities to build and rebuild key solutions, you will bring dedicated architectural expertise to the function and help engineers establish consistent, high-quality approaches across existing and greenfield systems. What's in it for you? Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance. Alan Flex benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery. Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery. Wellbeing support: Subsidized ClassPass subscription. Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents. Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide. Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent. Who you are You come from a strong hands-on background in data engineering, with deep experience in ETL/ELT, data pipelines, complex data transformations, and data modelling. Ideally, you have worked as a senior data engineer on various types of data architectures and pipelines at scale before transitioning to a data architect role. You have proven experience as a data architect incl. on (cloud) systems level, ideally across multiple teams, domains or projects. You have experience in a (data) integration context, where robustness, reusable connector and ingestion frameworks, external integration patterns like schema-drift detection, backfill and replay, idempotency are key. You get energized from optimizing technical architectures, structure, tooling, support and other processes, and from designing future-proof architectures in a fast-moving environment. You have a proactive, "can-do" attitude, viewing challenges as opportunities and inspiring a positive, solution-oriented mindset. You excel at seeing the bigger picture, breaking down large architectural projects into clear, scoped technical initiatives. You have strong knowledge of data cloud technologies, data-related services and systems (like Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Google Cloud Composer/Airflow), and cloud database solutions (like BigQuery, Spanner, Snowflake, or Databricks). Professional proficiency in Python for large-scale data processing and pipeline development. You are a forward-thinking architect who views AI as a core part of modern architecture. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. The Challenge We are looking for a Principal Solutions Engineer to lead the RFX practice within OneTrust’s Solutions Engineering Centre of Excellence. This is a high-impact role for someone who can improve how OneTrust approaches strategic RFIs, RFPs, security questionnaires, and proposal-driven evaluations across the business. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Product, Product Marketing, Infosec, and other subject-matter experts to turn complex customer requirements into differentiated, high-quality responses that help us win. This role is not about personally running every questionnaire that comes in. It is about owning the strategy for the most important opportunities while building the systems, content, operating rhythms, and AI-enabled workflows that help the wider field execute better at scale. At the same time, you will help raise the level of the broader Solutions Engineering organization by creating a stronger RFX function: one that is more strategic in deals, more efficient in execution, more consistent in quality, and more useful as a source of market, customer, and competitive insight. Ultimately, the mission is to lead and focus RFX efforts in ways that positively affect win rate, efficiency, response quality, and business impact. This is a builder-operator role for someone who can combine deal strategy, technical understanding, strong writing, operational rigor, and cross-functional influence to create a smarter and more scalable RFX motion. Your Mission Lead OneTrust’s strategic RFX motion end to end, owning high-priority RFIs, RFPs, and related proposal efforts from kickoff through submission Shape win strategy with account teams by aligning messaging, differentiators, timelines, and the right cross-functional contributors Translate OneTrust’s capabilities across privacy, data, risk, and AI governance into clear, customer-relevant value Improve the RFX operating model through better process, reusable assets, self-service guidance, and stronger field adoption Use data, customer signals, and win/loss patterns to improve sales execution, inform product priorities, and focus effort on win rate, efficiency, response quality, and strategic impact Apply AI, automation, and knowledge systems to reduce manual work, improve response quality, and scale the function globally What Success Looks Like You improve the quality, consistency, and competitiveness of OneTrust’s responses in strategic opportunities You positively affect win rate, response efficiency, and overall impact on strategic deals You help account teams move faster while making complex OneTrust solutions easier for customers to understand and value You turn field data and RFX trends into actionable insights for both sales and product teams You build a more scalable RFX function through greater content reuse, less manual work, and stronger field self-sufficiency Your Experience Includes 7+ years in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical pre-sales, proposal leadership, or a similar role in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment Strong experience leading or contributing to complex enterprise RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires, or proposal-based evaluations Strong understanding of strategic deal execution, including qualification, positioning, executive messaging, and response quality Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups and driving outcomes in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Ability to interpret field data and qualitative patterns, and turn them into practical recommendations for go-to-market execution and product feedback Hands-on experience using AI tools, workflow automation, or knowledge systems to improve business processes Strong written communication skills and the ability to turn technical complexity into clear, persuasive customer-facing content You Are Commercially minded and clear that great pre-sales support is measured by business outcomes, not just completed responses Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building structure, scale, and better ways of working where no mature playbook exists yet Equally strong as a strategist and operator, able to move from executive-level thinking to hands-on execution Analytical and pattern-oriented, able to turn customer signals, deal feedback, and content trends into clear recommendations Credible across technical, sales, and leadership audiences, with the ability to drive cross-functional progress without formal authority Fluent in English, with additional languages considered a plus Nice to Have Familiarity with proposal, content, and knowledge platforms such as Glean, Copilot, Highspot, Salesforce, Loopio, or similar systems Experience building automations or lightweight internal tools using Power Automate or similar workflow platforms Familiarity with grounded AI workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, or enterprise knowledge orchestration Experience in privacy, data governance, risk, security, or compliance-related software categories Experience creating scalable enablement programs, content libraries, or operational playbooks for field teams Where we Work We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. Market Intelligence: Immerse yourself in the Process Intelligence and Enterprise AI markets. This includes supporting our analyst evaluations, such as the Gartner MQ. The qualifications you need: Experience: Extensive internship experience or 1-2 years of full-time work in solution engineering, forward-deployed engineering, management consulting, technical pre-sales, competitive intelligence, or a fast-paced technology environment. You enjoy transferring your knowledge and coaching them on how to best position Celonis to increase our chances to win. Project & Stakeholder Management: Ability to drive a multi-stakeholder process end to end under deadline. You can orchestrate input from subject-matter experts, sales, and product, keep contributors on track, and help drive the timeline for a high-stakes RFX response. Builder DNA: You are an entrepreneur at heart. You spot manual, repetitive work, and your first instinct is to build something that fixes it for everyone. Technical Foundation & Hunger to Learn: You bring hands-on experience with SQL and/or Python, and you have already built or experimented with LLM-based tools or AI agents (e.g., side projects). Market Curiosity: A strong desire to master the Process Intelligence landscape and the broader Enterprise AI ecosystem, and to stay current as both move fast. Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into a clear “Value Story” that non-technical sales reps and customers can easily understand Nice to have (big plus): Automation Tools: Hands-on experience with automation platforms like Make.com, n8n, or Zapier to string together complex AI workflows. Knowledge Orchestration: Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) concepts and feeding agents with proprietary data and knowledge. RFP Experience: Previous experience managing or contributing to complex technical RFPs/RFIs. Entrepreneurial Background: Experience starting a side project, a small business, or being part of an early-stage startup team.
