title: KYB  Specialist
description: About the opportunity We are looking for a Specialist in Know-Your-Business (KYB) to join our growing team. In this role, you will support functioning of key due diligence processes for corporate legal entities and Treasury counterparties, ensuring optimal risk governance and seamless operational support for our Treasury Front Office. In KYB, our goal is to foster a culture of compliance within N26 that is trusted by authorities, institutional counterparties, and shareholders. For that purpose, developing your knowledge in corporate ownership mapping, UBO verification, Ongoing Due Diligence (ODD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), High-Risk Customers (HRC), and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) will be key to your success in this position. The Specialist role focuses on operational support, executing basic-to-intermediate corporate KYB reviews, and processing Treasury Due Diligence cases. Through structured training and continuous learning, the Specialist will become a key contributor to N26's regulatory compliance and day-to-day operations. In Your Next Challenge, You Will: Learn and apply fundamental knowledge of regulatory requirements (GwG, KWG) and standard procedures related to KYB, TSY DD, EDD, and ODD processes. Apply your experience with due diligence processes related to High-Risk Customers (HRC) and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP). Correctly apply established policies in each case assessment, maintaining a clear understanding of compliance requirements to ensure quality work. Contribute to the maintenance of the Service Level Agreement (SLA): Efficiently manage assigned cases, ensuring deadlines are met. Showcase proficiency in using KYB tools and platforms (Salesforce, Dow Jones, Factiva, Handelsregister, Transparenzregister) for efficient processing and management of complex corporate cases Demonstrate your analytical and investigative skills to assess and mitigate risks associated with High Risk customer profiles. Showcase your ability to interpret and analyse financial statements, transactions, and other relevant data to make informed decisions. Conduct thorough and accurate assessments, identifying risks and relevant documentation. Demonstrate a high level of Problem-Solving skills, continuously proving the ability to identify and solve problems independently. Demonstrate effective team collaboration, working closely with peers in a multicultural and fast-paced environment. Foster open dialogue within the team and share key case findings. Actively seek help and feedback for professional growth. Collaborate with internal stakeholders (such as Treasury Front Office, MLRO, Sanctions, and Customer Support) to resolve questions quickly and effectively. Adapt quickly to process changes and maintain a positive attitude. Actively participate in the adoption of new guidelines and tools. Be exposed to a fast-paced environment, demonstrating openness to learning and incorporating new methodologies and technologies into the KYC workflow. Participate in team projects and complete assigned operational tasks accurately. Embrace our Customer-Centric Approach, focusing on enhancing the user experience for our customers undergoing the KYC process, balancing compliance requirements with a seamless and user-friendly approach. What You’ll Need to Be Successful Background: Foundational experience in KYB, Corporate Due Diligence, or general KYC operations. Proven track record of managing and resolving KYC cases efficiently. Previous experience in similar fast-paced Finance and Banking companies is desired. Skills: 1-3 years of experience in KYB, KYC, or AFC Operations. Knowledge of banking regulations. C1 level English language proficiency (both writing and speaking) and having German language proficiency is a big plus. Traits: Actively help yourself (and others) be successful. Continuously learn and challenge the status quo. Think globally, act locally. Strong bias for action. Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback. Respect and follow internal escalation rules What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona. Besides the main offices, N26 also has local offices in Paris, Madrid, Milan, and São Paolo. Sound good? Apply now for this position. N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

title: AI Product Engineer (Demo)
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: Celonis Demo Engineering is the creative and technical engine of our Go-To-Market strategy. We are embarking on a high-stakes mission to build the Next-Gen Demo Factory - a world where AI agents and LLMs handle the heavy lifting of demo creation. This transformation is critical not only to maintain our lead in Process Intelligence but to ensure Celonis wins the Enterprise AI market. By feeding operational business context to AI, we enable the world’s largest companies to industrialize AI and unlock real ROI. You will co-lead this transformation within the team, architecting agentic systems and building tools that turn customer business problems into compelling demos for 1,000+ GTM colleagues inside and outside Celonis. The work you’ll do: Architect Agentic Demo Builds: Lead the shift toward "Prompt-to-Demo" workflows, from Atlas mockups to in-product demos with Apollo. You will build and continuously improve AI agents to automate the generation of data stories, UI screens, and configurations from simple business requirements. Elevate Field Delivery & Enablement: Create "Self-Service" agentic tools that allow Sales Reps and Solution Engineers to "chat" with a demo environment. These agents will generate custom talk-tracks, executive summaries, and personalized pitch decks on demand, ensuring every pitch is "Gold Standard." . Drive adoption through enablement and iterate based on user feedback. Master the AI Demo Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end development**, release, and ongoing improvement** of our most strategic AI demo tools and assets. This includes identifying the highest-impact demo opportunities across pre-sales , prioritizing features, building solutions, and leading technical configuration and QA . Work with Product and engineering partners to evolve these tools alongside the Celonis platform. Scale Through Automation: Identify repetitive manual tasks in the demo lifecycle—from data cleaning to screen setup—and build AI-driven tools/orchestrations to reduce manual effort and demo creation time . Creative AI Storytelling: Use generative tools to translate complex data into visionary C-level narratives, ensuring our automated assets maintain a human-centric, high-impact quality. The qualifications you need: The Builder DNA: You are a natural "problem solver through automation." You have hands-on experience building tools that help others succeed and a preference for building a scalable "generator" over manually fixing a single screen. 1.5+ Years of Experience: Professional experience in Value Engineering, Applied AI, Solution Engineering, Demo Engineering, Technical Consulting, or a similar "Product-adjacent" role. Technical Baseline: A hunger to learn new technologies and hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable programming language . You should be comfortable working with data, integrating AI models and APIs, and debugging the tools you build . Strategic Storyteller: The ability to identify high-impact use cases and take complex technical capabilities and turn them into a simple, value-driven business story for an executive audience. High Learning Velocity: The AI landscape moves fast; you must be excited to constantly experiment with new models, frameworks, and prompting techniques. Nice to Have (Big Plus): Cloud Platforms & Workflows: Experience building cloud-based workflows or applications using services such as Microsoft Azure and Azure Blob Storage. Software Development & Delivery: Experience with GitHub, version control, deployment workflows, and maintaining web applications used by others. Web Applications & UI/UX: Experience with frontend development and UI/UX design, turning complex AI capabilities into intuitive web applications. Celonis & Process Expertise: Experience with the Celonis platform, in-product applications What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

title: QA Analyst
description: Scopely is looking for a QA Analyst to join our Monopoly Go! team in Barcelona. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. Monopoly GO! is our new casual game and a key franchise that has just become one of Scopely’s largest games enjoyed by millions of players. The team is based in Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players. What You Will Do Reporting to your Vertical Group QA Lead of Live Minigames, you will play a vital role in upholding quality standards within one of Monopoly Go’s tightly integrated teams, known as a Pod. Collaborating with both internal and external partners, you’ll support regular feature and content releases, from initial concept through to post-release support, ensuring that the highest quality is maintained throughout. As a key advocate for quality at Scopely, you will help shape our ongoing commitment to excellence. Ensure your pod’s contributions to each release meet the highest standard of quality, focusing on both defect prevention and overall user experience, while also maintaining a broad, holistic view of release quality across the wider team Develop clear and comprehensive test plans that define scope of coverage, accurate time estimates, resourcing needs, tooling / cheat needs, and any wider requirements to support testing from concept through to release Drive the creation, upkeep, and execution of test suites and cases tailored to your pod’s specific needs and evolving scope Support and adopt AI-driven QA initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, coverage, and reporting Maintain a clean and prioritized bug database in alignment with your pod’s work Lead the onboarding of external embedded QA resources into your pod, ensuring they are set up for success and aligned with internal processes, while fostering a strong working relationship to remain aligned on priorities at all times Take ownership of your pod’s quality output by leading through example, performing hands-on testing, and ensuring accountability at all stages of development Raise pre-production quality concerns by reviewing briefs and design documents, championing a ‘shift left’ attitude Facilitate pod-specific playtests to gather broader feedback, track issues effectively, and ensure follow-up actions are taken where needed Collaborate with Customer Support and the Live & Release teams to investigate live issues, advocating for timely resolutions while addressing root causes to prevent recurrence Adhere to team-wide QA governance and best practices, ensuring full alignment with the project’s QA lifecycle from inception through post-release support Actively participate in POD and QA team ceremonies, providing feedback and staying aligned with team strategies and direction Collaborate closely with developers to understand changes in scope and assess cross-functional impacts that may require additional quality control Monitor holistic app health metrics such as ANRs and crash rates, particularly following your pod’s contributions to a release, and act accordingly to mitigate issues Embody and promote Scopely’s core tenets through your actions, communication, and leadership What We’re Looking For Strong verbal / written communication and an excellent attention to detail Strong time management, accountability and organisational skills Strong negotiation skills with the ability to effectively advocate for your team’s needs, while maintaining a clear understanding of business priorities to ensure balanced, mutually beneficial outcomes Proactive, enthusiastic and self-motivated Flexible to an agile setup with the ability to multitask, managing coverage for multiple high profile releases with strict deadlines A strong commercial awareness with an understanding of business priorities and goals Exceptional reporting capabilities Extensive knowledge of JIRA and / or similar bug tracking systems Mobile exposure and an understanding of Apple / Google submission protocol A sound understanding of the gaming industry and the typical end to end development lifecycle At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure! Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. title: Flight analyst
description: About the company At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.” By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology. With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber. Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs. Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era. About the role Barcelona or Palma Nuitée is hiring a Flight Analyst to own the financial accuracy of our Flights business. A single flight booking touches an airline, a GDS, a supplier, Nuitée's own platform, and the customer — each with its own record of what was charged. You'll be the person who makes sure those numbers agree: tracing bookings from the raw PNR and ticketing data through to the supplier invoice and the customer charge, catching mismatches, figuring out why they happened, and making sure Finance always has clean, trustworthy data to work from. This isn't a traditional accounting role. You'll sit at the intersection of Flights, Finance, Data and Engineering; and as you build real expertise in how flight pricing works, the role will grow from reconciliation into margin analysis and pricing strategy. Flights is one of Nuitée's fastest-growing pillars: the product, integrations (GDS, low-cost carriers, NDC), and 50+ customers are already in place, and this role exists to make sure the financial controls scale with it. Nuitée has grown significantly since 2022 and raised a $48M Series A led by Accel. What makes it interesting for you: Real financial ownership from day one; the numbers you reconcile directly protect revenue and margin A clear growth path: you start in reconciliation and move into revenue, pricing and margin analysis as you build domain expertise Cross-functional exposure to Flights Product, Finance and Engineering, not a siloed back-office role You're building process, not inheriting one; a lot of what's manual today is being automated, and you'll shape how The kind of problems you'll work on: Why doesn't this supplier's invoice match what we actually booked? Is this a one-off pricing error, or a systematic issue running across thousands of bookings? What's really driving the margin on this route or this supplier, and how do we improve it? How do we automate reconciliation so it scales without needing more people to do it manually? This role fits someone who: Has 3+ years of experience in the airline, flight distribution, OTA, TMC, GDS or related travel industry Understands how airline bookings and ticketing work; PNRs, tickets, fares, taxes, commissions, GDS processes Understands airline pricing concepts: published vs. private/net fares, markups, commissions Has strong SQL skills and is comfortable reconciling large datasets; BigQuery or similar warehouse experience Has experience with Looker Studio or a similar BI tool, and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills Has excellent attention to detail; comfortable tracing a discrepancy down to a single booking Has strong written and spoken English, and is comfortable working across Finance, Product, Engineering and external partners Bonus if you've worked with GDS platforms, airline consolidators, or have hands-on experience with airline settlement/reconciliation processes or flight financial accounting. You will do well here if you genuinely enjoy finding the reason two numbers that should match don't, and you're comfortable moving between a supplier invoice, a SQL query, a PNR and an internal ledger until you understand exactly what happened. This is less suited to someone who wants a purely accounting-style role with no data work, or who needs the role's scope fixed from day one — this one is expected to expand as you grow into it. If that resonates, we'd love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The interview process is straightforward and typically takes 3 weeks. Why Nuitee? At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it. Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale. World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally. Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup. Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions. By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you. By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at careers@nuitee.com. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026 .

description: Scopely is looking for an Lead Product Manage r to join our MONOPOLY GO! Game team in Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis (3X week in office). At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. What You Will Do Direct the cross-functional group managing MONOPOLY GO! Live Minigames. You are responsible for every initiative from initial planning to live execution, ensuring exceptional experiences for players alongside stable, predictable operations globally. Drive the strategy for live minigames, balancing player delight, brand vision, commercial goals, operational stability, and technical efficiency throughout the product lifecycle. Coordinate execution across Design, Engineering, Art, UX, Economy, Analytics, Production, QA, and Localization, establishing clear milestones, accountability, dependencies, and launch readiness decision points. Ensure high-quality launches using structured specifications, configuration checks, rigorous playtesting, prompt issue resolution, risk mitigation, and contingency planning. Implement comprehensive product, economic, and technical telemetry for all events, establishing automated alerts, coverage schedules, clear escalation channels, and standard operating procedures. Leverage analytics, player feedback, market trends, and post-launch reviews to optimize progression, rewards, engagement, and monetization while preventing recurring operational issues. Expand our portfolio capabilities through reusable frameworks, streamlined content pipelines, automation, performance tracking, and mentorship that frees up bandwidth for innovation. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of product management leadership delivering complex live services at scale, with a proven track record of driving player satisfaction, product quality, and reliable execution. A degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience is preferred. Deep expertise in free-to-play mobile mechanics, player motivations, core loops, progression systems, economy design, social features, and long-term retention strategy. Proven operational success managing concurrent launches, data validation, quality assurance, live monitoring, incident management, and post-mortem analysis under tight timelines. Strong analytical competency and technical proficiency across product data, segmentation, A/B testing, system architecture, deployment pipelines, observability, and debugging. Exceptional communication skills and collaborative leadership ability, with a structured approach to resolving ambiguity, evaluating data objectively, and driving team alignment. Active integration of AI tooling and automated workflows into daily tasks, demonstrating practical applications that elevate quality, speed, efficiency, and overall operational performance. Bonus Points Prior experience operating top-tier mobile free-to-play titles, high-scale live-service games, or consumer platforms with rapid update cycles. Hands-on familiarity with game economies, experimental frameworks, telemetry pipelines, monitoring dashboards, alerting setups, or incident response protocols. Demonstrated success optimizing content delivery, configuration tools, build pipelines, or multi-region live coverage schedules across diverse time zones. Please submit your CV in English. title: Senior Application Product Manager - Supply Chain - Procurement
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base. The Role: You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis. As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them. The work you’ll do: Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes. Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints. Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform. Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams. Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models. Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries. If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level. The qualifications you need: 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Founding/Forward-Deployed Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a comparable technical, customer-facing role hybrid role. Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows in supply chain and procurement. You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions. A track record of building coherent solutions, not just isolated features. You think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together. Expert in data analysis and data modeling including tools native to the Celonis platform: SQL, Python, quick to pick up new tools and platforms and able to prototype and build. Experience with platform-native tools like PQL is a significant asset. Advanced architectural mastery of LLM orchestration, tool use/function calling, RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and agentic patterns for enterprise workflows. Hands-on exposure to enterprise architectures, with ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) or Material Requirements Planning (MRP) logic considered a strong plus. Demonstrated project management capabilities accompanied by excellent planning and organizational skills. Creativity in problem-solving, a solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating smoothly across multi-disciplinary squads. title: Principal Country HR Partner - Fixed Term
description: Strength in Trust OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. Strength in Trust OneTrust’s mission is to enable organizations to use data and AI responsibly. Our platform simplifies collecting data with consent and preferences, automates data governance with integrated risk management across privacy, security, IT/tech, third-party, and AI risk, and enables responsible data use by applying and enforcing data policies across the entire data estate and lifecycle. Recognized as a market pioneer and leader, OneTrust serves more than 14,000 customers globally. The Challenge We are seeking a strategic, commercially minded Senior Principal / Director, HR Country Manager to serve as the HR leader for our Madrid office, our hub for the EMEA region. This role will be based in Madrid and will provide visible, on-site leadership for the site while partnering closely with local leaders and global People stakeholders on both day-to-day operations and broader business strategy. The role combines executive partnership, strong operational and compliance oversight, and hands-on support for complex people matters in Spain. This leader will also spend part of their time mentoring the current senior HR country leader to help strengthen their capability and develop toward a broader site leadership scope. Your Mission To translate business strategy into a Spain people strategy that enables growth, leadership effectiveness, organizational health, compliance, and employee experience for the Madrid site and broader Spain employee population. This leader will ensure that OneTrust’s global People philosophy is applied thoughtfully in Spain while advising leaders on local market realities, regulatory risk, workforce planning, and high-impact people decisions. You Are A seasoned HR leader with strong business acumen, sound judgment, and credibility with senior stakeholders. You bring deep expertise in Spanish employment law and labor practices, a track record of leading through complexity and change, and the ability to balance strategic influence with hands-on execution. You are pragmatic, data-driven, and comfortable operating as both a site-level operator and a strategic business partner in a fast-moving, multinational environment. Main Tasks & Responsibilities Serve as the senior in-person HR leader for Spain and the effective HR Manager for the Madrid site, acting as the primary advisor to local leaders on organizational strategy, people risk, workforce effectiveness, and leadership decision-making. Partner with business leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, talent strategy, retention priorities, and organizational change aligned to business goals. Translate global People strategies into Spain market execution that is legally compliant, culturally relevant, and operationally scalable, while ensuring strong partnership across People Business Partnership, People Operations, Payroll, HRIS, Total Rewards, Finance, and Legal. Lead complex employee relations, investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, restructures, and sensitive exits in Spain, including representing the company at SMAC conciliation proceedings where required and guiding leaders through legally informed decision-making. Own Spain labor and statutory compliance across the employee lifecycle, including employment documentation, policy localization, working time and leave practices, separation requirements and execution, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives such as the establishment and ongoing governance of the Equality Plan for the Spanish entity. Identify and recommend policy, process, and controls updates to mitigate risk and maintain audit readiness. Provide strategic HR leadership for organizational changes, manager capability, team health, and culture, ensuring leaders are equipped to make fair, consistent, and business-aligned people decisions. Use HR metrics and workforce analytics to identify trends, assess organizational health and compliance risk, and recommend actions to improve employee experience, manager effectiveness, and operational performance. Mentor the current HR country partner and local team to help broaden their capability and support their development toward stronger site leadership and support remits. Minimum Education and Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced degree in HR, business, or a related field preferred. Deep knowledge of Spain employment law, labor practices, statutory compliance, and employee relations frameworks, including experience with sensitive exits, conciliation processes, and practical application of local requirements in a business setting. Direct experience leading Equality Plan design, implementation, governance, and related compliance initiatives within Spain, inclusive of a strong track record representing company interests with employee representative bodies. Strong experience with HRIS platforms and reporting tools; Workday strongly preferred. Strong analytical capability and comfort using data to influence executive decisions and improve HR effectiveness; professional HR certification is a plus. Fluency in Spanish and English required. Background & Experience 12+ years of progressive HR experience, including meaningful experience in senior HR leadership, HRBP, country HR, or director-level roles. Experience as the leading HR partner for one or more offices is required. Proven experience leading complex employee relations, investigations, restructures, sensitive exits, and legally informed decision-making. Strong track record of operating in Spain’s regulatory environment and applying local requirements within a global or multinational company context. Experience leading or influencing cross-functional teams and driving execution through ambiguity, scale, and change. Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with operational rigor. Where we Work We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. Benefits As an employee at OneTrust , you will be part of the OneTeam . That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers. Resources Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: OneTrust Careers on YouTube @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram Your Data You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview . You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form . Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com . A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. title: Creator Program Specialist
description: We're looking for a Creator Program Specialist to join our Central Creator Strategy team, within our Marketing Operations team, in our Barcelona studio hub on a hybrid basis (2 days in office). This is a Fixed Term Contract of 6+ months. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. The Marketing team deeply understands a game's audience, creative strategy and priorities. They are the glue between the Brand, Product, and our Player Communities that will redefine our social strategy to amplify our games across new and existing social channels while building a meaningful community for our players. What You Will Do As part of our central Creator Strategy team, you'll build the foundations of our creator programs - the frameworks, playbooks, and reward mechanics that let each game team run a strong ambassador or organic creator program of its own. Rather than managing creators day-to-day yourself, you'll design the tools and standards that community managers across our titles use to run their own programs, and you'll consult with them to iterate and improve what's already live. You'll work closely with community, brand, social, and legal/IP teams to make sure new programs are set up for success and existing ones keep evolving with platform and creator culture trends. Responsibilities include: Build Program Foundations: Design the frameworks, playbooks, and templates for new organic creator and ambassador programs - covering creator identification, onboarding, tiering, and reward structures - so game teams can launch and run their own programs. Design Reward Mechanics: Develop non-monetary incentive structures - creator codes, rewarded deep links, early access, exclusive perks, and recognition tiers - that motivate creators without paid contracts, and set the standards for how they're used across titles. Consult & Iterate on Existing Programs: Act as the go-to expert for game teams' community managers, who own and run their programs day-to-day, advising on what's working, what isn't, and how to improve creator identification, retention, and reward design. Set Content & Brand Guardrails: Create the creative direction, content brief templates, and IP/brand guidelines that community managers use with their creators to keep organic content authentic while staying on-brand. Shape Portfolio Strategy: Help define the organic creator strategy across the portfolio, and translate it into operational tools, creator personas, and program roadmaps that individual game teams can adopt. Establish Performance Benchmarks: Define how organic creator program performance is tracked - engagement, reach, sentiment - and use social listening and analytics tools to identify what's working across titles and where programs need adjustment. Share Cross-Portfolio Learnings: Package program recaps, creator spotlights, and benchmarks into resources and presentations that keep game teams and leadership aligned on what's working across the portfolio. What We're Looking For We're seeking someone with hands-on experience building and running creator programs who's ready to shift from operating a single program to building the foundations that let many teams run their own. Qualifications include: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field Relevant experience building, running, or scaling creator, ambassador, or UGC programs, ideally in gaming Hands-on experience with creator codes and other non-monetary reward mechanics (rewarded deep links, tiered perks, early access) Ability to turn program experience into reusable frameworks, playbooks, and templates that other teams can pick up and run Comfort acting as a consultant to other teams - influencing without direct authority, and adapting recommendations to each game's needs Deep familiarity with organic content dynamics on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch and other platforms Strong analytical skills, with working knowledge of social listening and data visualization tools (ideally Looker) Clear, confident written and verbal communication for both internal stakeholders and external creators Bonus Points Gaming industry experience Influencer Marketing experience Experience with social listening or creator discovery platforms Experience working directly with community and social teams on organic growth initiatives Familiarity with influencer/creator disclosure requirements About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com . Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice . Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Sr. Identity and Access Management Engineer
description: Strength in Trust OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. The Challenge As a Senior IAM Engineer, you will design, build, and operate core identity security capabilities across the enterprise. This includes Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) architecture , Privileged Access Management (PAM) , and secrets management , as well as the automation and integrations that enable secure access at scale. This role is responsible for multiple areas of IAM (not just a single platform), and will contribute at a strategy, design, and execution level—partnering with Security, IT, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable identity services. Your Mission IAM / IGA Architecture & Engineering Architect and implement IGA capabilities including identity lifecycle (joiner/mover/leaver), access request workflows, approvals, provisioning/deprovisioning automation, certifications, and role/entitlement governance. Design and maintain the identity lifecycle management (ILM) framework and controls across the environment. Build and enhance IAM integrations (e.g., HR source, directories, SaaS apps) using industry standards (SCIM, SAML/OIDC, APIs) and automation patterns. Privileged Access Management (PAM) & Secrets Management Engineer and mature PAM controls and operating processes for privileged identities and activities, including access request/approval patterns, time-bound elevation, auditing, and least privilege enforcement. Implement and manage secrets management capabilities (vaulting, rotation, access control, auditability) for human and non-human identities, including service principals and automation identities. Scripting, Automation, and Development Develop automation using scripting and software engineering practices (e.g., PowerShell/Python/Bash), including CI/CD-friendly workflows and infrastructure-as-code patterns (e.g., Terraform). Create repeatable solutions for access governance, role engineering, connector onboarding, reporting/analytics, and operational runbooks. Operations, Incident Support, and Continuous Improvement Respond to IAM operational work (tickets/requests) requiring engineering changes and enhancements. Assist in investigation and remediation of IAM incidents and issues, improving controls and automation to prevent recurrence. Conduct proofs-of-concept (POCs), partner with vendors, and recommend solutions aligned to security and business requirements. Collaboration, Advisory, and Documentation Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders—translating complex IAM topics into clear recommendations and implementation plans. Produce and maintain technical documentation, standards, and procedures supporting audits and operational readiness. Mentor peers and positively influence the team’s technical direction. Required Technical Skills (Must Have) IGA architecture & engineering expertise (identity lifecycle, RBAC/ABAC concepts, access reviews/certifications, entitlement modeling, SoD/least privilege). Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts and hands-on implementation (JIT/JEA, session controls, privileged identity separation, auditing). Secrets management (vaulting, rotation, access policies, non-human identity security). Scripting and development skills (e.g., SQL, JavaScript, PowerShell, Python, Velocity, SOAPUI, ARC, Postman, Java/J2EE, Bash; API integration; Git-based workflows). Experience designing and operating IAM controls in modern enterprise environments (cloud + SaaS) - especially Azure, including authentication/authorization and identity governance patterns. Preferred Skills (Nice to Have) Experience with IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, Omada) and IAM directories/IDPs (e.g., Entra ID/Azure AD). Experience with PAM and secrets tooling (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust, Akeyless, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager). Familiarity with compliance frameworks and evidence collection for audits (SOX/SOC2/ISO27001-style controls). Experience integrating IAM with ticketing/workflow systems and operational processes. You Are Typically requires a minimum of: BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or a related subject 5+ years of IAM experience 3+ years of PAM and/or Secrets Management experience 3+ years of cloud experience (e.g., Azure, AWS, G-Suite) Equivalent work experience. Where we Work We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person. Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview. Benefits As an employee at OneTrust , you will be part of the OneTeam . That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers. Resources Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: OneTrust Careers on YouTube @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram Your Data You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview . You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form . Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com . Our Commitment to You When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career. OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Lead Deployment Engineer
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role As a Lead Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact. The Work You’ll Do Initiate and Connect Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required Build & Value Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance Rollout, Adoption, and Handover Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff Domain & Industry Depth Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable The Qualifications You Need Experience: 7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python. AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus. Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus. Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact. Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field. Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus. Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. title: HR Business Partner
description: Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence. We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world. Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space. Why Appodeal? At Appodeal, we’re more than just a company—we’re a team united by a common mission: Help people discover and grow their talents through products that enable successful mobile app businesses! We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Continuous Learning and Growth: We are passionate about learning, growing personally, and building rewarding careers. Making an Impact: We are committed to building a history-defining company that leaves a lasting impact on the mobile app industry. Solving Exciting Challenges: We tackle complex problems every day, supported by a team of world-class professionals and mentors. Enjoying the Journey: We believe in having fun while working toward our goals. We're hiring an HR Business Partner to work directly with the leaders and teams across our business, acting as a trusted advisor on everything from team structure to performance to day-to-day people issues. You'll be close enough to the business to know what's actually going on in a team, not just what shows up in a status update, and you'll use that vantage point to help leaders lead better, resolve problems early, and keep the organization healthy as it grows. And here's what makes this role different: when you find a problem, you don't write a recommendation — you build the fix. You'll ship the tools and AI agents that run our people processes, and manage the agents working in your domain. Half your week belongs to the business; half belongs to building. We call it forward-deployed: the model Palantir invented and AI-native companies now run. You'll own a portfolio of teams you partner with directly, and one company-wide domain end-to-end — Performance & Reward, or Talent & Hiring Systems — including the tools and agents that run it. You'll report directly to the Chief People Officer. Key Responsibilities: Partner with leaders on the people side of running their teams: structure, workload, hiring needs, and overall team health. Coach and support leaders as they grow into their roles, with direct, honest feedback rather than platitudes. Help leaders navigate performance conversations, ratings, and other difficult calls, and be willing to challenge a decision that doesn't hold up. Build and ship the systems behind your domain — self-service tools, automations, AI agents — using AI as your default execution partner. Recurring requests become product, not recurring favors. Run the agents in your domain: set their guardrails, review their behavior, decide what stays human. Act as a trusted, informal point of contact for employees who want a perspective outside their own manager. Work with leaders to build the evidence-based picture of where real talent sits — from actual work, not gut feel — and help build development paths, mentorship, and coaching, whether internal or external. Build learning into the flow of work and the tools themselves — we believe most growth happens through real work, not formal programs. Bring an outside eye to team dynamics and process, and flag what isn't working before it becomes a bigger problem. What We're Looking For: Solid experience as an HR Business Partner or in a similar embedded HR role. You can actually build: workflows, automations, agents (think n8n, APIs, Claude-class tools). You don't need to be an engineer — you need to ship things that run without you. Evidence over instinct: you'd rather read what someone actually produced than run a questionnaire. Comfortable operating close to the business, not just close to the HR process. A strong communicator who builds trust quickly, at every level, including with people more senior than you. Good instincts for when someone needs support and when a harder conversation, or a different decision, is what's actually needed. Someone who believes high standards and genuinely caring about people aren't in conflict, and who's a little uneasy with kindness that quietly protects underperformance. There's a clear charter for where this function is going, and genuine freedom in how you get there — you should be energized by that combination, not waiting for a process manual. What Matters Most: More than a specific background, we're looking for someone who shares a certain philosophy about people and performance: that most learning happens on the job, not in a classroom; that a good HR partner is closer to a referee than a service desk, carrying both a whistle and a red card; and that avoiding a hard conversation to spare someone's feelings rarely does them, or the team, any favors in the long run. And one more thing: that the future of HR is built, not administered — if you'd rather ship a system than send a reminder, you'll feel at home here. We are a group of different but like-minded people who are inspired by a common goal and love what they do. If you're a curious spirit who values constant learning and growth, please apply! With an outstanding product and a mission that excites and inspires, Appodeal offers a unique opportunity to make an impact while being part of an amazing team. Join us and help shape the future of mobile app success!
