title: Data Strategy Manager
description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com . Nuestra cultura y nuestras personas son el motor de WPP Media, y nos impulsan a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales. En este rol, tu contribución será clave para vivir y promover nuestros valores: Ser Extraordinario: Liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza. Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa. Tu rol y contribución Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Data, Technology & Analytics buscamos un/a Data Strategy Manager que impulse el diseño, implantación y optimización de estrategias de datos (AdTech, MarTech y 1PD) para uno de nuestros principales clientes del sector FMCG, actuando como el consultor estratégico de referencia que transforma los objetivos de negocio en soluciones metodológicas de datos accionables, además de coordinar y tutorizar el desarrollo del equipo a tu cargo. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de: Traducir los briefings de negocio del cliente en estrategias de datos integrales, definiendo el ecosistema de audiencias cross-channel (Programmatic, Social, CTV, DOOH) y liderando el uso, enriquecimiento e integración de la First-Party Data (1PD). Evaluar y auditar de manera continuada las herramientas tecnológicas del cliente (CDPs, DMPs, DSPs, Web Analytics), recomendando la arquitectura idónea para maximizar el retorno de la inversión publicitaria y la personalización de campañas. Coordinar, guiar y tutorizar el trabajo diario de perfiles junior, asegurando la calidad de sus entregables, su aprendizaje metodológico y la correcta distribución de la carga de trabajo. Dirigir la correcta ejecución de los proyectos de datos asignados desde la fase de conceptualización hasta la medición del éxito, coordinando de forma transversal a los equipos de activación de medios para asegurar la coherencia e integridad estratégica. Actuar como el interlocutor principal para el cliente en materia de estrategia de datos, simplificando conceptos técnicos complejos en narrativas y recomendaciones de negocio accionables para perfiles no técnicos. Identificar, evaluar e integrar nuevas soluciones de proveedores y partners de datos del mercado (incluyendo soluciones cookieless, clean rooms y 3rd Party Data innovadoras) para enriquecer el portafolio de productos internos del área. Colaborar activamente en la detección de oportunidades de up-selling y cross-selling, así como participar en la propuesta metodológica y técnica de data en procesos de pitch para nuevo negocio. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Mínimo de 4 años de experiencia en consultoría de datos o estrategia de audiencias en agencia de medios. Dominio avanzado de CDPs, DMPs, DSPs y analítica web (GA4/Adobe), así como de herramientas de visualización (Power BI, Tableau, Looker). Entendimiento de la regulación de privacidad (RGPD) y medición en entornos cookieless (Identity Solutions, Clean Rooms). Profundo conocimiento del ecosistema de medios digital (Programmatic, Social, Search) y capacidad para optimizar el Customer Journey mediante modelos de atribución. Perfil estratégico con excelentes habilidades de comunicación para traducir insights técnicos a negocio, y capacidad de gestión de proyectos (PMO). Nivel fluido de inglés (mínimo B2+). Grado Universitario en Publicidad, Marketing, ADE o STEM (se valorará Máster especializado y conocimientos en SQL/Python/R). Vida en WPP Media y beneficios En WPP Media, invertimos en nuestra gente, impulsando tu crecimiento profesional con la misma pasión con la que lideramos la inversión responsable en medios. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Además de un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, en WPP Media nos preocupamos por tu bienestar y equilibrio. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete de beneficios pensado para ti: Flexibilidad: Disfruta de un modelo híbrido de teletrabajo en Madrid o Barcelona , complementado con flexibilidad horaria en la entrada y salida. Bienestar y ventajas: Accede a un plan de Retribución Flexible que se adapta a tus necesidades, subvención del menú diario y café y fruta en la oficina. Cuidado personal: Fomentamos tu salud y bienestar con clases de Yoga/Pilates y la posibilidad de sesiones de fisioterapia. Próximos pasos Si te identificas con esta oportunidad y quieres formar parte de WPP Media, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!. Envíanos tu candidatura y, si tu perfil encaja con lo que buscamos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo. WPP Media ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y considera las candidaturas para todos los puestos sin distinción de raza, color, sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, embarazo, nacimiento de un hijo/a, condiciones médicas o discapacidad. Para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas consulta nuestra Política de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ). #Hiring #WPPMedia #DataTechnologyAnalytics #DataStrategy Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Intern Deal Operations and Analysis
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team: You will join the Deal Operations & Analysis team, which is part of the Finance organization. We are responsible that our quote-to-order process runs smoothly and efficiently. Additionally, we are collaborating with cross-functional teams within the company, including GTM, Pricing, Legal, Product & Engineering, to integrate business requirements and continuously enhance related processes for operational optimization. You will work closely with the Go-To-Market, Product, and Finance organization to ensure business requirements of high quality. As part of the Deal Operations & Analysis team, you will steer and optimize the current provisioning process to live up to Celonis’ growth ambitions. The work you’ll do: Manage Celonis’ global provisioning activities by ensuring the timely provisioning of new subscriptions and maintaining existing subscriptions based on customer contracts Being the point of contact for subscriptions, partners, and internal stakeholders for all provisioning-related questions Continuous review of existing processes to identify improvements and automation possibilities Collaborate with the Product team to maintain the knowledge hub of all provisioning changes and integrate new solutions Collaborate with Legal and Finance to ensure compliant and state-of-the-art provisioning processes Support the preparation of monthly reports and help maintain the policy and documentation repository to ensure it remains accurate and up to date. Participate in team initiatives and process improvement activities, such as conformance checks and data clean-up exercises. Support the FinOps team with ad hoc tasks and booking activities The qualifications you need: Completed bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (B.A. or B.Sc.) Relevant working experience in Consulting, Cloud/SaaS Business, Finance, Operations or comparable fields. Creative, high energy, entrepreneurial self-starter comfortable running initiatives and projects independently Work in a structured manner and quickly comprehend new topics and interrelationships Detail and results-oriented with an ability to work in a cross-functional, fast-paced, and constantly evolving environment Ability to evaluate priorities and multi-task accordingly, while keeping others apprised of status with respect to deadlines Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . title: Global IT Manager
description: About the company At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology. With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber. Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from Booking.com , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs. Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era. About the Role Hybrid in Barcelona - Global scope: Barcelona, Casablanca, London, San Francisco. Nuitee is hiring its first dedicated IT Manager. There is currently no central IT function to inherit: ownership is split across People, Engineering, external providers, and individual teams. You will join to assess the existing environment, define what the function should look like, and build it from the ground up. This is a hands-on role. You will set the strategy, but in the early stages you will also be the one implementing it. description: Allow us to introduce ourselves Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀 Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here Your mission as a Senior Backend Engineer We are looking for a passionate ( Senior) Backend Engineer (m/f/d) to join our amazing backend team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing new features and enhancing our existing code base using NodeJs, Express, and MongoDB. What you’ll be doing Design and maintain server-side applications and database architecture. Collaborate with front-end developers for a seamless user experience. Regularly review and improve code and system efficiency. Develop and deploy reusable, testable code and automated tests You will thrive in this role if You have at least 3 years of hands-on experience with Node.js, along with strong proficiency in TypeScript and Express. You have practical experience working with NoSQL databases, preferably MongoDB. You have a solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles. You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field – or have completed a comparable vocational training Having AWS (S3, ECS, EC2), Docker and Terraform experience is a plus Having previous experience with NestJS is a plus You are a proactive problem solver, always seeking innovative solutions and continuously improving processes. You are willing and able to get familiar with new systems. You are a team player and enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment, valuing team input and ensuring alignment with project goals. How we work We work in small, agile product teams with lots of ownership and fast decision-making. You’ll collaborate with smart, driven, and genuinely nice people. We keep meetings to a minimum – focus time matters. We use a modern tech stack that supports us in building great products: Backend: Node.js (TypeScript), Express, MongoDB, AWS, Docker, Terraform Frontend: Angular, Flutter Tools we love: GitHub, ClickUp, Slack What’s in it for you? Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year All the hardware you need and your own MacBook If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces Additional role details This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Germany, the UK, Portugal, the Netherlands, and Spain This role will report directly to our Head of Infrastructure Our interview process Screening Call with a Talent Acquisition Partner Technical Interview with our Engineering Team Case Study Interview with our Engineering Leadership Team Executive Interview with C-Level Reference Calls Offer Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm. Bridge Engineering and Business Strategy: Act as the technical sparring partner for Data Scientists and ML Engineers, translating business constraints into model requirements and ensuring technical architectures solve real consumer and operational problems. Balance Velocity with Banking Rigor: Manage day-to-day delivery, maintaining a healthy balance between launching innovative AI capabilities and upholding the strict security, auditability, data privacy, and reliability standards expected of a regulated bank. Empower Autonomous AI Adoption: Act as an AI evangelist and platform owner by defining standards, blueprints, and self-service toolkits that allow product squads across N26 to integrate AI capabilities into their own features safely and independently. What you need to be successful: Background: 5+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with a proven track record of owning and shipping production-grade AI/ML capabilities. Real-World GenAI & Agentic Systems Production Experience: Hands-on experience taking GenAI products from concept to live production. You must have direct experience building with concepts like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic workflows (ReAct framework, state/memory management, function-calling), and multi-agent orchestration systems. (Note: Utilizing off-the-shelf AI productivity tools is not sufficient; we require a track record of building customer-facing or platform products powered by AI). B2C Domain Scale (Technical Background Preferred): Experience working within high-volume, highly scalable technical domains (such as B2C FinTech, E-Commerce, or high-traffic consumer tech). Full AI/ML Specialization: Comprehensive expertise navigating the full AI product lifecycle, including problem scoping, target metric definition, data ingestion/labeling, model training/fine-tuning, evaluation framework design, deployment, latency optimization, and continuous retraining. Skills: Traditional ML Foundation + GenAI Evolution: A background grounded in traditional Machine Learning methodologies (classification, regression, ranking/recommendation engines) paired with hands-on expertise in modern LLM architecture. Deep Technical Literacy & Architecture Evaluation: Strong grasp of AI technical fundamentals, with the ability to evaluate trade-offs between Large Language Models (LLMs) and deterministic ML/rule-based logic across cost, inference latency, explainability, and accuracy. title: Customer Support Analyst (Temporal +1 año)
description: ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas? En el equipo de Customer Experience and Operations estamos buscando la persona idónea para que se incorpore como Customer Support Analyst. Formarás parte de Customers Operations un equipo fantástico, experimentado y profesional que trabaja para posicionar la marca Cabify con energía, optimismo y pasión. El área de Customers Operations es quizás el área más transversal de Cabify, teniendo que trabajar con todos los departamentos, lo que garantiza mucho aprendizaje, desafíos y diversión. Misión del puesto: Su misión es identificar, diseñar, gobernar y automatizar los flujos de atención y procesos transaccionales. Su objetivo central no se limita a la escalabilidad sino que busca fundamentalmente mejorar la experiencia del cliente, reduciendo drásticamente los tiempos de respuesta y eliminando los errores derivados de la ejecución manual en los procesos. ¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión? Identificar: Analizar las fricciones sistémicas y localizar los cuellos de botella en la operación diaria (tanto en el equipo interno como el equipo deslocalizado) que generan demoras o errores de cara al cliente. Diseñar: Crear la arquitectura de soluciones tecnológicas ágiles y proponer flujos internos de soporte que fomenten la autonomía del usuario y reduzcan el ratio de contacto. Automatizar: Implementar y desplegar herramientas No-code o soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial (IA) que eliminen tareas repetitivas, garantizando precisión milimétrica y liberando a los agentes para interacciones de mayor valor Gobernar: Definir los estándares y criterios de calidad para asegurar que cualquier integración o automatización local se mantenga alineada con la coherencia técnica transversal de OEx. ¿Cuál es el perfil que buscamos? Buscamos a un responsable de la transformación,el candidato ideal debe tener una mentalidad Automation-First , combinando una profunda empatía por la fricción operativa con un dominio práctico del ecosistema actual de IA y No-code. Stack Tecnológico y Experiencia Práctica Dominio de Integraciones y No-Code: Experiencia demostrable diseñando flujos complejos y orquestando APIs en plataformas como n8n (o similares) para conectar los sistemas internos de soporte con herramientas externas. Aplicación de IA Generativa y LLMs: Fluidez en el uso y configuración de modelos de lenguaje ( Claude, Gemini ) y herramientas de gestión de conocimiento ( NotebookLM ) para automatizar el triaje de tickets, análisis de sentimiento, extracción de datos y generación de respuestas de alta precisión. Construcción Ágil de Soluciones (Low-Code/AI Builders): Capacidad para prototipar y desplegar interfaces o herramientas internas de soporte de forma ágil utilizando plataformas impulsadas por IA Exploración en IA Multimodal: Familiaridad o capacidad de integrar soluciones de voz con IA (como ElevenLabs, Amazon Connect ,) para optimizar flujos de atención telefónica o respuestas interactivas. Visión Operativa y Gobernanza Gobernanza: Capacidad para construir soluciones locales ágiles pero bajo estándares técnicos estrictos, asegurando que todo lo que se diseña en CS es escalable y dialoga perfectamente con la arquitectura global. Traductor de Fricciones a Sistemas: Facilidad para sentarse con un agente, entender por qué un proceso manual toma 10 minutos y es propenso a errores, y traducirlo en un flujo automatizado que toma segundos y mejora el Superior Service . Pensamiento Sistémico sobre el Código: Entiende que el valor no está en escribir código desde cero, sino en saber qué pedirle a la IA, cómo evaluar lo que genera y cómo integrarlo de forma segura en la operación diaria. Habilidades Clave Priorización Implacable : Capacidad para rechazar peticiones de automatización tácticas, ruidosas o de bajo impacto ("parches") que los líderes de equipo puedan solicitar por urgencia, defendiendo siempre el tiempo dedicado al diseño estructural. Evangelizador Tecnológico: Habilidad para influir, formar y elevar el conocimiento técnico de los Especialistas y Coordinadores de CS, impulsando una cultura donde la IA sea una herramienta del día a día para todos. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Somos una empresa llena de gente feliz y motivada… ¡y no queremos que eso cambie! Aquí te mostramos algunas razones por las que te encantará formar parte de la familia Cabify: 📝Contrato temporal (previsión +1 año de duración) con salario competitivo 🌍Margen flexible en la hora de entrada y salida para que te organices a tu ritmo 💸Crédito mensual para usar en nuestra App de Cabify 💰Planes de retribución flexible adaptados a tus necesidades 🎟️Descuentos en restaurantes, tiendas y gimnasios 🐶Sala de mascotas para que te traigas el peludo a la oficina 🖥️Equipo de trabajo para que desarrolles todo tu talento Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno inclusivo para todas las personas, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¡Únete a nosotros!

title: Global Operations Associate
description: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The opportunity: The role of the Global Operations Associate is a critical part of making Flexport’s mission to make global trade easy for everyone a reality. To achieve this the Global Operations Team is at the heart of delighting our customers, managing our partners and working closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. With our focus on developing a global network, our operational teams are strategically located across the world to manage and execute our services and products offered to our customers and partners. Flexport Global Operations raises the bar by using data to manage our customer’s supply chains and identifies opportunities to improve fidelity in planning, responsiveness and overall execution. As a Global Operations Associate, you are an expert in executing the end-to-end movement of shipments within a regional network. On a day-to-day basis you will coordinate the supply chain operations with ocean activities within your region. This role will focus on driving a first in class customer experience by obsessing over quality and on time performance. Lastly, this role will work very closely with peers and supervisors to problem solve. Your responsibilities as a Global Operations Associate include, but are not limited to the following: Be the 'front line' in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time, exceptions are handled proactively, and clients receive a first-class experience through timely, clear communication. Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery, independently managing your priorities and commitments. Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and proactively flag opportunities for improvement. Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination, developing solutions independently and escalating to senior team members as needed Act in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior. Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day operations with the relevant internal and external partners for your team's scope (e.g. carriers, vendors, customs, regional trade lane management, cross-functional stakeholders, etc) Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements. Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy and parity with insourced operations (if applicable in a given region). Use data and operational tools to inform decisions, identify patterns in your work, and contribute to efficiency improvements. Requirements: BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent. 2+ years of experience in operations, logistics or freight forwarding Have a technology (and AI)first mindset and can thrive in a fast paced environment. Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks. Attention to detail. Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback. Effective communication both verbally and in writing. Teamwork and relationship building. Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization. Problem-solving capabilities. A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry. A client service mindset; you are obsessed with client satisfaction, and strive to investigate and troubleshoot the client’s problem. Language requirement: Mandatory Spanish and fluency in English. What's in there for you: An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment Lunch food budget 12 euros per person reimbursement. Snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 22 vacation days Medical Insurance: Flexport covers 100% of the premium for employees. Life & AD&D Insurance fully funded by Flexport Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success. Employee assistance program via Aetna Resources For Living. Flexport offers an employer-sponsored program available at no cost to you and all household members. Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. #LI-onsite Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: Sales Executive
description: ¿Por qué Cabify? En Cabify creemos que una nueva forma de movilidad urbana es posible, una que sea más sostenible, accesible y eficiente para todos. Nos movemos por un propósito claro: hacer de nuestras ciudades un lugar mejor. Si te apasiona el impacto social y ambiental, y buscas un lugar donde tu talento impulse un cambio real, ¡este es tu sitio! Aquí, cada día es una oportunidad para transformar la movilidad urbana y contribuir a un futuro más verde. Tu equipo Gestionamos las relaciones con nuestros clientes empresariales, desarrollando soluciones de movilidad a medida para compañías de todos los sectores. Somos el puente entre la tecnología de Cabify y las necesidades reales de las empresas, construyendo alianzas estratégicas que impulsan el crecimiento y la eficiencia. Nuestro día a día implica entender a fondo las necesidades del cliente, proponer soluciones innovadoras y asegurar que la experiencia Cabify sea siempre excepcional. ¿Con quién trabajarás en tu día a día? Head of B2B Sales Manager Equipo de SDRs Equipo de Operaciones y Productos Tu misión Como Sales Executive, tu misión será liderar el crecimiento de nuestra cartera de clientes empresariales, construyendo relaciones sólidas y estratégicas que maximicen el valor para Cabify y para nuestros partners. ¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión? Diseñarás y ejecutarás estrategias de prospección B2B, identificando y atrayendo nuevas cuentas clave para expandir nuestra presencia en el mercado español. Gestionarás de manera integral un portfolio de clientes empresariales, asegurando su satisfacción, retención y el crecimiento de la facturación a través de up-selling y cross-selling. Negociarás y cerrarás acuerdos comerciales complejos, demostrando un profundo conocimiento de nuestros servicios y adaptándolos a las necesidades específicas de cada empresa. Analizarás el rendimiento de tus cuentas, identificando oportunidades de mejora y optimización para asegurar el cumplimiento y superación de los objetivos de ventas establecidos. Colaborarás activamente con equipos internos (Operaciones, Producto, Marketing) para garantizar la excelencia en la implementación de soluciones y la resolución de incidencias, aportando la voz del cliente. ¿Qué buscamos? Afinidad con nuestros principios Experiencia demostrable de al menos 4 años en roles de ventas B2B, gestión de cuentas clave o desarrollo de negocio, preferiblemente en el sector tecnológico o de servicios. Habilidad probada para identificar, desarrollar y cerrar oportunidades de negocio complejas, con un historial sólido de cumplimiento de objetivos. Dominio avanzado de herramientas CRM (Salesforce es un plus) y capacidad para analizar datos de ventas para tomar decisiones estratégicas. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación y presentación, con fluidez en español e inglés. Formación universitaria en Administración de Empresas, Marketing, Economía o similar. Orientación a resultados, proactividad y una mentalidad orientada a la solución de problemas. ¿Qué ofrecemos? 📝 Contrato indefinido con salario competitivo 💸 Crédito mensual para usar en la App de Cabify 👩‍🎓 Presupuesto anual para formación y desarrollo 💰 Planes de retribución flexible 🎟️ Descuentos en restaurantes, tiendas y gimnasios 🐶 Sala de mascotas en la oficina 🖥️ Equipo de trabajo para desarrollar todo tu talento Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno inclusivo para todas las personas, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¡Únete a nosotros!

We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting riders to drivers at the touch of a button. You'll identify market opportunities and user needs through deep data analysis, qualitative research, and sharp product sense. You'll manage the full product lifecycle: from conceptualisation and design to launch and post-launch iteration, working closely with engineering, design, data, and operations teams. You'll influence and align multiple internal and external stakeholders, communicating the product vision effectively and ensuring cohesion in execution. 🔍 What we're looking for: Alignment with our principles 5+ years of proven experience in Product Management, Product Analytics, or equivalent roles, leading high-impact products. Excellent product sense and a user-centred approach, with the ability to identify problems and design innovative solutions. Strong communication, influencing, and leadership skills, able to inspire and align multidisciplinary teams. An analytical, data-driven mindset, with experience making decisions based on metrics and outcomes. An academic background in Economics, Engineering, or a relevant discipline is a plus. 🌍 What’s it like to work at Cabify? Here, your work isn't just a job, it's the chance to be part of a movement that's redefining urban mobility and building more sustainable cities. We offer an environment where autonomy, impact, and continuous learning are part of everyday life. On-site model: you’ll work from our office in Madrid. 💶 Excellent Salary conditions: From € 60K up to 90K. ⌚ Flexible work environment & hours. 🙌 Regular team events. 🚗 Cabify staff free rides. 🚀 Personal development programs based on our career paths. 📐 Coursera: your own license in Coursera to take as many courses as you wish and continue developing your skills. 💳 Flexible compensation plan: Restaurant tickets, transport tickets, healthcare and childcare. ☕️ And last but not least...free coffee and fruit! At Cabify, diversity fuels our teams. We actively recruit talent beyond traditional channels, embracing individuals from diverse backgrounds and supporting initiatives like Women Tech Dating , Contrata Diferente and our Internal Diversity Committee. Our commitment is reflected in inclusive job descriptions, creating an environment where every contribution is cherished. Join Cabify to be part of innovative teams that truly represent the rich tapestry of talent in the tech industry. Join us!

title: Animation Lead
description: Scopely is looking for a highly motivated Animation Lead to join our Marketing team Flamed in the Barcelona Office on a Hybrid basis (three days in the office)! At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. We are the in-house creative agency, Flamed, an International multidisciplinary team. We build thousands of creatives every year to support all Scopely games Marketing needs worldwide. This role will be primarily focused on Monopoly GO! , one of the world’s leading mobile games, directing and supervising the production of animated trailers, cinematics, UA videos and other marketing content. What you will do If you are an experienced 3D animator with strong storytelling, direction and leadership skills, and the ability to guide an animated project from early pre-production through final animation, this position is for you! We are looking for someone who can think beyond individual shots and take responsibility for the overall quality of a piece: ensuring that the story is clear, the storyboard and animatic communicate effectively, the layout has strong composition and timing, and the animation delivers appealing and engaging performances. You will directly supervise Storyboard Artists and Animators, providing creative direction, feedback and support throughout production. While this is primarily a leadership and project direction role, you may also contribute hands-on to Autodesk Maya layout or animation tasks when workload allows. Lead the animation and cinematic execution of trailers, cinematics, UA ads and marketing videos, from the initial brief through storyboard, layout and animation. Work closely with Creatives to ensure that the original idea, objectives, key messages and mandatory requirements defined in the brief are properly translated throughout production. Direct and review storyboards and animatics, ensuring narrative clarity, strong composition, staging, camera language, pacing, acting and timing. Supervise 3D layout and character animation, ensuring that camera work, performances, posing and movement are appealing, polished and appropriate for the tone and objective of each piece. Directly supervise Storyboard Artists and Animators, working closely with Producers to align on task allocation and priorities based on project needs, team capacity and individual strengths, while providing clear and actionable feedback and supporting the team’s artistic and professional development. Perform asset checks during pre-production, identifying the characters, props, environments, rigs and asset adaptations required for layout and animation. Use these asset checks to help structure pre-production and coordinate dependencies, priorities and handovers across the Animation, Assets and Lighting teams. Collaborate closely with the Asset Lead, who retains ownership of modeling and rigging, providing clear and detailed asset and rigging requests based on production needs. Coordinate with the Lighting Lead to ensure a smooth handover of approved cameras, animation and assets into lighting pipelined (UE5, C4D...), and collaborate when important VFX elements affect storytelling, staging or timing. Partner with the Motion Designer Lead on UA videos and projects with a significant motion design component, ensuring that 3D animation integrates effectively with motion graphics, transitions and editorial flow. Identify narrative, visual, technical and production risks early, proactively proposing practical solutions that protect quality, deadlines and the creative intention of the project. Collaborate with multidisciplinary internal teams and external vendors, maintaining consistent storytelling and animation quality across projects with different styles and tones. Contribute hands-on to Maya layout or 3D animation tasks when project priorities and workload allow. Research emerging AI tools and explore innovative workflows that can support storyboarding, previs, layout, animation and production planning. Help identify and implement practical AI-assisted workflows that improve creative iteration, production efficiency and communication between teams. What you will need Minimum 5 years of professional experience in 3D animation, cinematics, advertising, games, feature animation, VFX or a related entertainment field. Previous experience as a Lead Animator, Animation Director, Supervising Animator or in a comparable role involving project and team leadership. A strong portfolio or reel demonstrating high-quality 3D character animation, cinematic storytelling and animation direction. Advanced knowledge of Autodesk Maya and professional 3D animation workflows. Strong knowledge of 3D character animation, including body mechanics, posing, acting, facial performance, timing, spacing, weight and appeal. Strong 3D direction skills, with the ability to supervise storytelling, camera work, staging, composition, pacing, layout and character performance across an entire piece. Good understanding of modeling and rigging dependencies and the ability to anticipate the assets and rig functionality required for animation production. Experience reviewing rigs and identifying requirements related to character performance, props, interactions, facial animation and technical animation needs. Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities and stakeholders while maintaining a high standard of quality. Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Organized and proactive mindset, with the ability to make decisions, solve problems and maintain a clear creative direction in a fast-paced production environment. Collaborative attitude and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams, discipline leads, stakeholders and external vendors. Comfortable working in a constructive cross-feedback environment and delivering high-quality work under tight deadlines. An open and proactive attitude towards AI, with a willingness to explore new tools, adapt workflows and apply them responsibly within creative production. Nice to have Storyboarding, drawing or visual development skills. Experience in 2D animation. Ability to create thumbnails, draw-overs, paint-overs or quick visual notes to communicate feedback and direction. Experience developing animatics or working directly with Storyboard Artists during pre-production. Experience directing or supervising external vendors. Experience producing game trailers, cinematics, UA ads or other short-form marketing content. Experience in mobile games, advertising or character-driven entertainment. Experience using AI-assisted tools or workflows in animation, storyboarding, previs or other areas of creative production. Experience in mobile games or entertainment is a strong plus. Please ensure that the résumé/CV and reel you attach are written in English. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. In this role, you will partner closely with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Marketing to bring our cross-functional CS team to the next level. Balancing strategic vision with hands-on operational leadership, you will leverage modern AI technology, smart automation, and real-time user insights to maximize the value we deliver to Wallapop users (both C2C and Pro). This role requires a blend of operational leadership, AI-driven strategy, and deep user empathy to solve complex challenges in a fast-paced digital ecosystem. What You Will Do 👇 Pioneer AI & Modern CS Operations: Lead the integration of AI, automation, and intelligent routing tools to modernize customer support, streamline workflows, and enhance resolution efficiency across all user touchpoints. Lead Internal CS & CX Teams: Direct and mentor our internal Customer Service (CS) and Customer Experience (CX) teams across C2C and Pro segments, fostering a collaborative, high-impact culture focused on continuous development. Manage External BPO Partnerships: Oversee strategic relationships and day-to-day alignment with external BPO partners, ensuring partner performance seamlessly matches Wallapop’s quality standards, SLA targets, and customer-first values. Drive Operational Excellence: Design, optimize, and scale customer service processes and workflows to maintain high quality as Wallapop grows. Data-Driven Decision Making: Analyze customer interaction data, support metrics, and user feedback to identify emerging trends, pain points, and systemic product/service improvements. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Managed Marketplace, Seller Tribes, Product, and Tech teams to champion the voice of the customer and align CS initiatives with broader company OKRs. Champion Customer Centricity: Cultivate a customer-first mindset across the department and advocate for user satisfaction throughout the organization. What We Are Looking For 🔎 Leadership Experience: Proven track record of leading and scaling Customer Service / Support operations within a digital environment, e-commerce platform, or tech scale-up. AI & Innovation Focus: Demonstrated interest or experience evaluating, implementing, and optimizing modern CS technology, including AI tools, chat automation, and intelligent ticketing platforms. Vendor & Partner Management: Experience overseeing external BPO vendor relationships, contract execution, and SLA performance. Analytical Rigor: Strong data literacy and problem-solving skills—ability to translate complex operational metrics and customer feedback into actionable strategies. Bilingual Communication: Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to lead teams and present strategies across leadership functions. What Would Be A Plus 🚀 Prior experience in a peer-to-peer (C2C) or multi-sided marketplace environment. Background working directly with product and engineering teams to automate user-facing support workflows. Relevant academic background or equivalent practical leadership experience in Engineering, Business Administration, Information Systems, or related fields. Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals. Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone. We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package. This usually takes 45-60 minutes. Case Study Submission - you will be assigned a task to submit within 5 up to 7 days where you will be able to showcase your expertise for the role. Expertise Interview - run by the hiring team, focus on the required core skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60-90 minutes. Stakeholder Interview - run by relevant stakeholders reflecting the reality of the context of the role, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes. Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes. Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

title: Senior Director, Celonis Services EMEA Center of Excellence
description: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. As Senior Director, Celonis Services for our EMEA Center of Excellence, you will lead the Madrid CoE as the engine of AI-augmented delivery and the home of deep technical, product, and AI expertise across Celonis Services EMEA/JAPAC. This role is part of the EMEA/JAPAC Services leadership team, reporting to the SVP Services, EMEA/JAPAC. This is a deliberately broad role: you will lead both the innovation side of the CoE — AI-led delivery, new product rollout, reusable assets — and its delivery operations side — capacity, utilisation, and delivery excellence — through your leaders and managers. Comfort operating across that full range is essential and you will need to demonstrate a combination of strategic long-term thinking and practical operational execution on a daily basis. You will lead the CoE Managers as well as a group of Principal Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects, and, through them, a team of thirty+ Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects that support our business across EMEA/JAPAC. The CoE is the center of AI-augmented delivery, product innovation, new product rollout, technical domain ownership and supporting business domain knowledge to the field. Partnering with our Bangalore CoE, regional services leaders, and Global Programs, you will run one aligned CoE strategy and scale Madrid as an organization that generates and measures reusable assets and holds our deepest product, platform, and AI expertise. Responsibilities Drive the AI-augmented delivery transformation of the CoE — Apollo/Atlas, agentic delivery, and reusable assets — making AI-led delivery the default and lifting delivery productivity across the region. Collaborate with the Global CCO AI Agentification team for Services in doing so and bring best practices and assets to the regions. Be accountable for a balanced CoE scoreboard: utilisation, AI-driven delivery productivity, delivery quality and customer satisfaction, reusable-asset generation, and retention of senior talent. Work with services leadership to reinforce the Services CoE strategy, including the services to be delivered from the CoE, employee profiles and roles, hiring plans, organizational structure, enablement approach, career development, and relevant success metrics. Develop and grow the CoE Domains aligned to our business directions, empowering the skill and domain knowledge growth across the CoE. Creating the expert team supporting our Field teams and our Customers. Oversee the CS Project Office and, through it, resource management, utilisation and capacity planning, PSA, and delivery excellence for the region. Maintain Subcontracting relationships and governance as well as overseeing a pool of Subco talent centrally located in the CoE. Own the health of the EMEA CoE — engagement, morale, retention, productivity, resource allocation, and enablement — and the outcomes these drive. Serve as a day-to-day people manager for a team of managers, and principal Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects. Invest in their career development and overall employee engagement and contribute to a dynamic Services CoE culture. Work with CCO global programs and other CCO wide initiatives for repeatable assets, methodology development leveraging the talent we have in the CoE. Work collaboratively with and influence other departments, especially Product, Sales and Value Engineering, to promote customer satisfaction and achieve business unit and company goals. Skills and Capabilities Minimum 12 years of professional experience including relevant leadership and management experience; professional services practice leadership for a SaaS company is preferred Deep understanding of Celonis products and platform. Hands-on knowledge preferred. First-hand experience in a post-sales role within Celonis. Leader of Leaders, demonstrating experience in developing senior talent and managers. A top-performer with demonstrable past success achieving relevant targets and KPIs. Growing experience with AI-augmented delivery and a track record of adopting new tools and ways of working at scale. Experience in process engineering, program management, enablement practices, methodologies, and the corresponding tools/technologies for each. Excellent communication, presentation, leadership, management, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills. Passion for using operational metrics and process improvement to support decisions and drive organisational optimization. Ability to disseminate team goals, objectives, and metrics to higher level OKRs and track the outcome. Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, ever-changing, high growth environment and to approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking, and a growth mindset. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. description: About the opportunity We are looking for a dynamic AFC Analyst (Italian fluent) to join our AFC Operations Department to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and relevant company policies related to Anti-Financial Crime. Your responsibilities will include: Review and improve the investigation/assessments escalated by the Investigators, ensuring quality Investigations of complex Financial Crime escalations or cases of suspicious activities identified. Ensuring quality and suggesting better ways of working when difficulties are identified and /or for gaining efficiency. Enhancing our analysis, and expanding the processes in our procedures and rulebook, as well as identifying improvements related to our internal transaction monitoring systems. Draft and submit Suspicious Activity Reports/Authority requests to UIF and the corresponding authorities, prior escalation to the Associate/TL. What you need to be successful: Background: Min. 3 years with relevant banking experience in Anti Financial Crime (money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, tax evasion). Solid knowledge of European AML/CTF directives, as well as local regulatory frameworks. Direct experience handling SAR/STR reporting and communication with local Financial Intelligence Units. Fluency in English is required, along with professional fluency in Italian. Bachelor’s degree (ideally in law, business or finance) is preferred. Advanced use of MS Office (G suits) skills for Excel and Word. Salesforce experience is a plus. Knowledge of European and Italian regulations on Financial Crime (AML, terrorism financing, fraud, and tax evasion). Deliver with quality and keep confidentiality. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona. Besides the main offices, N26 also has local offices in Paris, Madrid, Milan, and São Paolo. Sound good? Apply now for this position. N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. title: Chief Data Science Officer
description: Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence. We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world. Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space. Why Appodeal? We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Continuous Learning and Growth: We are passionate about learning, growing personally, and building rewarding careers. Making an Impact: We are committed to building a history-defining company that leaves a lasting impact on the mobile app industry. Solving Exciting Challenges: We tackle complex problems every day, supported by a team of world-class professionals and mentors. Enjoying the Journey: We believe in having fun while working toward our goals. We are now expanding our data capabilities and seeking an experienced Chief Data Science Officer to lead and scale our Data Science UA team function in Barcelona. This role is ideal for a leader with a strong technical background, excellent people-management skills, and the ability to turn data into actionable, high-impact product and business outcomes. Role Overview: Chief Data Science Officer will be responsible for building and growing our Data Science organization, driving advanced analytics and ML initiatives, and ensuring our products and business units are empowered by high-quality insights and predictive capabilities. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Revenue, and Leadership teams to translate business needs into DS/ML solutions, strengthen our data infrastructure, and support decision-making across the ecosystem. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role with significant influence on product evolution, optimization algorithms, and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities: Leadership & Strategy Lead and scale the Data Science function across the organization. Translate business and product goals into clear DS/ML initiatives and execution plans. Build and promote a strong data-driven culture across all teams. Applied Data Science & ML. Oversee development, deployment, and monitoring of ML models across Appodeal’s product and monetization ecosystem. Guide experimentation, modeling, uplift measurement, and algorithmic optimization. Ensure model quality, reliability, fairness, and performance at scale. Collaboration & Stakeholder Management. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to integrate Data Science into product roadmaps. Work with business units to identify opportunities, define DS/ML requirements, and deliver impactful insights. Communicate DS outcomes, metrics, and recommendations to leadership. Team Leadership Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of Data Scientists, Analysts, and ML/AI specialists. Foster knowledge sharing, best practices, experimentation, and continuous improvement. Drive hiring, talent development, and team structure optimization. Data Infrastructure & Governance Collaborate with Data Engineering and MLOps teams to ensure robust pipelines, feature stores, and model deployment workflows. Improve data quality, observability, and governance standards. Qualifications: Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or a related field (PhD is a plus). Experience 5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Applied Analytics. 3+ years in a DS leadership role (Lead DS, Head of DS, Director of DS, or similar). Demonstrated experience building and leading Data Science teams. Proven track record of delivering DS/ML solutions with real business impact. Technical Skills Strong understanding of ML algorithms, experimentation, predictive modeling, and statistical analysis. Hands-on experience with Python, ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), and analytics tooling. Solid understanding of data pipelines, big data technologies, and collaboration with Data Engineering teams. Experience with AdTech, attribution, auction mechanics, or optimization algorithms is a strong plus. Leadership & Soft Skills Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to translate technical concepts into business language. Strong decision-making and prioritization abilities. Passion for mentoring, coaching, and building high-performing teams. title: Head of Product Engineering
description: BidMachine Exchange – a fast-growing global programmatic exchange built for the future of in-app advertising. BidMachine operates with a strong US foundation and an international presence, with teams across Warsaw, Barcelona, Parkland (FL), and remote experts around the world. We combine deep AdTech expertise, proprietary technology, and a data-driven mindset to deliver transparency, performance, and efficiency in the mobile advertising ecosystem. Why BidMachine? At BidMachine, we are building more than an exchange — we are shaping the infrastructure that powers fair, efficient, and scalable in-app programmatic advertising. Our mission is to create a high-performance marketplace where publishers maximize value and advertisers access premium inventory with full transparency and control. We are proud of our technology, our ambitious vision, and our globally distributed team of talented professionals who continuously raise the bar in AdTech. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Ownership & Accountability We move fast, take responsibility, and think like builders. Every team member has a direct impact on product growth and market success. Data-Informed Excellence We leverage data to make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and build scalable solutions that deliver measurable results. Innovation & Technical Depth We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem. Global Collaboration We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards. Ambition & Impact We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market. BidMachine's UA business unit is looking for an experienced Head of Product Engineering to own the technical and product vision of our demand-side platform (DSP) — the engine that runs managed-service campaigns for advertisers today, with a self-service version on our roadmap. You will unify Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, BI, and our bidding/prediction stack into a single, coherent product, replacing today's fragmented workflow with one clear roadmap and one set of aligned decisions. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll sit above our Data Science function, work daily with our go-to-market and sales leadership, and carry direct influence over how we compete with the handful of full-stack players (exchange + mediation + DSP) in this industry. Location: Barcelona, Spain Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end technical and product roadmap for the UA DSP, from bidding and prediction through to reporting and BI. Unify Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, BI, and backend engineering (predictor/bidder) into one product function with consistent, aligned decision-making. Lead, grow, and mentor a team of roughly 20 across engineering, data science, and analytics; accelerate the growth of the existing Data Science function. Partner closely with the Go-to-Market/Revenue lead and Head of Sales to translate market opportunities into technical feasibility assessments and vice versa. Drive the long-term transition from managed-service to self-service tooling for advertisers. Bring engineering rigor and a genuine product mindset — at BidMachine, "product" means engineers who understand the business and can set direction, not a separate function. Move quickly from close collaboration on direction-setting to independently owning and defending product strategy. Requirements: 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with demonstrated hands-on experience having built and scaled a DSP or comparable real-time bidding platform. 5+ years in a senior engineering or product engineering leadership role, managing teams of 15–20+ across multiple disciplines. Strong working knowledge of machine learning and data science concepts — sufficient to credibly manage, grow, and set direction for a Data Science organization. Solid grounding in data engineering, analytics, and BI, with the ability to operate fluently across all of them. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to operate with significant ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment. Advanced Business English, particularly in writing and speaking. Willingness to relocate to Barcelona. Nice to Haves: Prior experience at a full-stack ad tech company (exchange + mediation + DSP). Experience building or scaling machine learning-driven bidding/prediction systems specifically in mobile UA or programmatic advertising. With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space. Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. Oversee the operational health of live-minigame cycles, maintaining transparency across milestones, ownership, and potential project blockers. Audit final configurations against technical specifications to identify discrepancies and finalize pending decisions prior to deployment. Drive cross-functional synchronization between Engineering, Design, Art, to ensure seamless event execution. Maintain comprehensive documentation of strategic choices and project velocity to foster team alignment and clarity. Today, Revlon resiliently continues its legacy as a leading global beauty company. Our diverse portfolio—which consists of some of the world’s most iconic brands and product offerings in color cosmetics, skincare, hair color & care, personal care, and fragrances—is sold around the world through prestige, professional, mass, and direct-to-consumer retail channels. These brands include Revlon, Revlon Professional, Elizabeth Arden, Almay, American Crew, CND, Cutex, Mitchum, Sinful Colors, Creme of Nature, Christina Aguilera, John Varvatos, Juicy Couture, Ed Hardy and more. We honor our heritage, embrace change, and applaud diversity. We champion our employees and celebrate our consumers. We are Revlon, together, transforming beauty. Employees are expected to work from our Cornellà de Llobregat (Barcelona) office 3 days per week and may work remotely the remaining days We are looking for a Supply Planner to join an international company and support the planning and management of inventory to ensure product availability, maintain appropriate stock levels, and contribute to operational efficiency across the supply chain. Main Responsibilities The selected candidate will develop and maintain supply plans to ensure product availability while balancing inventory levels and service requirements. The role includes monitoring inventory, sales trends and demand forecasts, using data analysis to support planning decisions and anticipate potential supply issues. The position will work closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to align supply plans with business priorities, and will coordinate regularly with Procurement, Production and Logistics to ensure the smooth execution of supply chain activities. Additional responsibilities include identifying and mitigating supply risks, preparing reports on inventory and supply chain performance, monitoring KPIs, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency and service levels. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related discipline. Advanced English level (C1 or higher), both written and spoken. Ability to communicate effectively in Spanish (B1 level or higher). Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and support decision-making. Experience working with supply chain planning tools and systems in a complex business environment. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions. Ability to build effective working relationships with Commercial, Marketing, Operations, Procurement and Logistics teams. Comfortable working in a fast-paced and changing environment. High level of accuracy, attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality results. Assess how changes move through CI/CD pipelines and identify key control and risk points Cybersecurity and Resilience: Perform audits over security domains including vulnerability and patch management, endpoint security, incident response, backup and disaster recovery, and third party risk Identify Improvements: Analyze root causes of control deficiencies and propose pragmatic, technology-driven remediation strategies. title: Operations Growth Manager - Demand
description: Location : Come and join us in Barcelona or Madrid! At Freenow, we empower smarter mobility decisions, helping people move freely and cities to thrive. Join our Local Operations team at the heart of Freenow by Lyft taxi business in Spain. As an Operations Growth Manager with focus on Demand, you will own the local growth strategy, identifying opportunities to boost demand and unlock sustainable business growth. You will act as the General Manager's trusted advisor on all demand and growth topics, ensuring that local market insights influence company strategy while driving the successful execution of operational initiatives, product launches and marketplace experiments. Working closely with Product, Pricing, Marketplace, Marketing and Local Operations teams, you will transform data into action and opportunities into measurable business results. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring a combination of analytical thinking, operational excellence, and project management to shape the future growth of Freenow by Lyft in Spain. Are you ready for your next ride? YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE: Owning the growth of Freenow by Lyft business in Spain by identifying, prioritizing and delivering high-impact operational initiatives that increase completed rides and accelerate marketplace performance. Identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities, including new product features, strategic partnerships, expansion initiatives and operational improvements, defining the optimal go-to-market approach for the local market. Developing business cases, performance analysis and executive recommendations to support strategic decision-making and business growth. Leading growth projects end-to-end, from opportunity assessment and planning to execution, performance monitoring and continuous optimization. Partnering with Central Product, Marketplace, Pricing and Marketing teams to adapt global strategies, product features and commercial initiatives to local market dynamics while influencing future roadmap decisions. Leading the local rollout and testing of new products and features, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders to ensure successful execution, adoption and measurable business impact. Driving growth across strategic demand channels, including airports and other high-value points of interest, by developing operational partnerships and improving the customer experience at key locations. Providing strategic market intelligence through continuous monitoring of competitor activity, customer behaviour and industry trends, translating insights into actionable recommendations that shape local and central business decisions. Acting as a trusted advisor to the General Manager by bringing a local market perspective, identifying emerging opportunities and influencing Freenow's long-term growth strategy. Travel will be required around 20% of the time, with some weeks not travelling and others with up to a full week or a few days away. TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE: You have 4 to 5 years of relevant working experience in Operations, Consulting or Tech, with a proven track record of managing and executing projects end-to-end. You hold a Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Operations, or a related field, or have an equivalent qualification or relevant professional experience. You are hands-on, highly execution-focused, and results-oriented, ready to dive into day-to-day operations, navigate ambiguity, and deliver measurable business impact. You possess strong analytical thinking and strategic skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable operational insights and business decisions. You are proficient in data tools, including advanced Excel/Google Sheets, Tableau, and SQL (Python is a plus). You bring a growth mindset, using data and local market insights to identify operational opportunities, test initiatives, and prioritize high-impact projects. You demonstrate strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and align teams without direct authority.
