description: We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer in Ireland, UK, Spain, or Portugal in a hybrid or remote basis. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location. We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices. We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey! At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. What You Will Do Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS). Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD. Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR). Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers. Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance. Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers. Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs. Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms. Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline. What We Are Looking For 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms. Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code. Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs. Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs. Understanding of mobile GPU architecture (tiling, bandwidth, power constraints). description: Purpose of Position We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Team Pegasus, responsible for the Awin Mobile App and its backend platform. Pegasus is part of the Publisher Tribe that builds the experiences publishers rely on every day: discovering opportunities, generating links, tracking performance, and growing their partnerships on the go. The role is focused primarily on the creator-focused mobile app. You will lead two teams that bring it to life: Pegasus Mobile , building our Flutter-based mobile application. Pegasus Platform , providing the APIs and backend services that power the mobile app and our publisher web experience. This is a leadership role, not a hands-on coding role, but we expect strong technical depth so you can guide the team and unblock delivery when needed. Key Tasks Coach and mentor engineers, fostering their growth and career development. Drive recruitment efforts and ensure successful onboarding for new team members. Conduct performance reviews, track individual development plans, and provide regular feedback. Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to define team objectives and OKRs. Enable the team to take ownership of the software delivery lifecycle and drive continuous improvement. Facilitate discussions and decision-making processes within the team, resolving conflicts when necessary. Coordinate with Product, UX and other engineering teams to deliver on shared goals. Champion AI-assisted development, code generation and agentic coding workflows to accelerate delivery across the team. Contribute to knowledge sharing and promote a culture of learning within the team. Contribute to the strategic direction of the Engineering Management group. Skills & Expertise Required: Minimum 2 years of experience as an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead or equivalent leadership position, with a clear servant-leadership and empowering management style. Deep, hands-on experience building and shipping mobile applications in a commercial setting, ideally apps you have helped launch and scale. Strong product mindset, comfortable collaborating with Product and UX on discovery and shaping outcomes, not just executing requirements. Backend and cloud literacy sufficient to lead the Platform team (backend, API, AWS). Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, code generation and agentic coding workflows to accelerate delivery. Strong communicator across technical and non-technical audiences, comfortable adopting language based on the room. Comfortable working in an Agile setup (Scrum or Kanban), facilitating ceremonies and supporting the team through change. Nice to Have Hands-on experience with Flutter. Product experience in the creator economy, for example creator tooling, affiliate or creator monetisation platforms, or influencer-facing products. Experience orchestrating multi-agent AI workflows for engineering or product use cases. Our Offer Flexi-Week : We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance. Flexi-office : We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility. Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture : You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home. Health and Wellbeing : With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing. Development : We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development. Appreciation : Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme. We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview. Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture. Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities. Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know. Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. title: Digital Media Planner
description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com . Nuestra cultura y nuestras personas son el motor de WPP Media, y nos impulsan a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales. En este rol, tu contribución será clave para vivir y promover nuestros valores: Ser Extraordinario: Liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza. Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa. Tu rol y contribución Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Media Management & Delivery buscamos un/a Digital Media Planner que impulse la ejecución técnica y operativa de las campañas digitales, actuando como el nexo clave entre los equipos de cuentas, los publishers y la tecnología de ad serving. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de: Gestionar operaciones de Ad Serving, con dominio de CM360. Diagnosticar y resolver problemas técnicos de ad serving en colaboración con publishers y equipos internos. Mantener una comunicación técnica fluida y proactiva con publishers para la implementación de campañas y la exploración de nuevos formatos. Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos de Client Services para asegurar que las implementaciones técnicas se alinean con los objetivos del cliente. Realizar el seguimiento y la optimización de campañas para cumplir con los KPIs, confirmando su correcta activación y medición en el ad server. Resolver incidencias con soportes y proveedores para garantizar la continuidad de las campañas. Dar soporte general a los managers del equipo en la operativa diaria. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Más de 2 años de experiencia en operaciones de publicidad digital (AdOps) o roles similares. Experiencia avanzada y demostrable en la gestión de campañas con Campaign Manager 360. Experiencia en la relación y resolución de incidencias técnicas con publishers. Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de publicidad digital, especialmente en lo que respecta a Ad Serving. Capacidad para diagnosticar y resolver problemas técnicos relacionados con la implementación de campañas. Disposición e interés por aprender sobre el área de compra programática. Comprensión del modelo de negocio de las agencias de medios y la relación con clientes y proveedores tecnológicos. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, organización y una gran atención al detalle. Titulación universitaria en Marketing, Publicidad, Comunicación o un campo relacionado. Nivel de inglés suficiente para desenvolverse en un entorno técnico. Vida en WPP Media y beneficios En WPP Media, invertimos en nuestra gente, impulsando tu crecimiento profesional con la misma pasión con la que lideramos la inversión responsable en medios. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Además de un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, en WPP Media nos preocupamos por tu bienestar y equilibrio. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete de beneficios pensado para ti: Flexibilidad: Disfruta de un modelo híbrido de teletrabajo en Madrid , complementado con flexibilidad horaria en la entrada y salida. Bienestar y ventajas: Accede a un plan de Retribución Flexible que se adapta a tus necesidades, subvención del menú diario y café y fruta en la oficina. Cuidado personal: Fomentamos tu salud y bienestar con clases de Yoga/Pilates y la posibilidad de sesiones de fisioterapia. Próximos pasos Si te identificas con esta oportunidad y quieres formar parte de WPP Media, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!. Envíanos tu candidatura y, si tu perfil encaja con lo que buscamos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo. Para cualquier duda, puedes contactar con nosotros en talentacquisition.spain@wppmedia.com . WPP Media ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y considera las candidaturas para todos los puestos sin distinción de raza, color, sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, embarazo, nacimiento de un hijo/a, condiciones médicas o discapacidad. Para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas consulta nuestra Política de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ). #Hiring #WPPMedia #MediaManagementDelivery Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Principal Data Analyst
description: Who we are: Let's have fun shaping your future! We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them! Position Overview: We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth. You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making. What You'll do: Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization. Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance. Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes. Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards. Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices. What You Bring: Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products. Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most. Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design. Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus. Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis. Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders. Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar. Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus. Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic. What's in it for you as a Socialpointer? Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full Disability and life insurance Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet) Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies) Professional development budget for skills training Onsite perks include: State of the art gym facilities Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!) The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, which means we are committed to creating and celebrating diverse thoughts, cultures, and backgrounds throughout our organization. Employment with us is based on substantive ability, objective qualifications, and work ethic – not an individual’s race, creed, color, religion, sex or gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, alienage or citizenship status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, status as a victim of domestic violence or sex offenses, reproductive health decision, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing the necessary support and accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, health conditions, or impairments (subject to any local qualifying requirements) to ensure their full participation in the job application or interview process. Please contact us at recruitment@socialpoint.es to request any accommodations or for support related to your application for an open position. Please be aware that Socialpoint does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Socialpoint also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scamp or phishing attack, and you should not engage. Socialpoint’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a zynga.com, take2games.com, naturalmotion.com, smallgiantgames.com, themavens.com, gram.gs email domain).

title: Senior Supply Product Manager
description: Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence. We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world. Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space. Why Appodeal? At Appodeal, we’re more than just a company—we’re a team united by a common mission: Help people discover and grow their talents through products that enable successful mobile app businesses! We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Continuous Learning and Growth: We are passionate about learning, growing personally, and building rewarding careers. Making an Impact: We are committed to building a history-defining company that leaves a lasting impact on the mobile app industry. Solving Exciting Challenges: We tackle complex problems every day, supported by a team of world-class professionals and mentors. Enjoying the Journey: We believe in having fun while working toward our goals. We are seeking a results-driven Senior Supply Product Manager to join our growing team at BidMachine. This role will focus on the supply side of our Ad Network, collaborating with internal teams and external partners to optimize the flow of inventory and maximize revenue opportunities for our clients. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Ad Tech, programmatic advertising, and deep experience in supply-side products. Responsibilities: Lead the strategy and roadmap for the supply-side product offering within BidMachine, ensuring alignment with business objectives and user needs. Own the product lifecycle from ideation to launch, working closely with engineering, design, sales, and customer support teams. Collaborate with key stakeholders, including publishers, ad operations, and data teams, to identify market needs and develop innovative product solutions. Analyze supply-side performance data to make informed product decisions, optimizing for publisher revenue and advertiser satisfaction. Develop and manage product features related to supply-side inventory management, auction dynamics, and demand-supply matching algorithms. Drive product improvements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and ease of use for both internal teams and external clients. Lead market research, competitive analysis, and customer feedback collection to identify opportunities for innovation and improvement. Work cross-functionally to define and prioritize product requirements, timelines, and deliverables. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, programmatic advertising standards, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on supply-side products within the Ad Tech industry. Proven track record of developing and launching successful products in the ad network or programmatic advertising space. Strong understanding of supply-side advertising technologies, including mediations, direct integrations, header bidding, RTB, SSPs (Supply-Side Platforms), and ad exchanges. Experience working with large-scale, data-driven products, and leveraging analytics to inform product decisions. Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset and the ability to make decisions based on both quantitative and qualitative insights. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas to a broad range of audiences, from technical teams to business leaders. Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with a high level of organization and attention to detail. Familiarity with agile development methodologies and product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, etc. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with supply-side optimization and improving publisher monetization strategies. Knowledge of programmatic ad formats (display, video, native) and the broader ad tech ecosystem. Familiarity with A/B testing, machine learning, or data science techniques for optimizing ad networks. Why join Appodeal? Be part of a mission-driven company that empowers mobile businesses worldwide . Work with a talented international team that values creativity, ownership, and collaboration . Grow your career in a fast-paced, innovative environment where your work makes a real impact. Competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for professional development. title: Director of Live Roadmap & Release Operations | MONOPOLY GO!
description: Scopely is looking for a Director of Live Roadmap & Release Operations to join our MONOPOLY GO! game team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis. MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day. About the Role As Director of Live Roadmap & Release Operations , you will own the operational health, integrity, and readiness of MONOPOLY GO!’s live roadmap and release ecosystem. You will lead the systems, processes, and operating rhythms that turn product, content, events, promotions, tooling, and technical initiatives into coordinated and reliable live releases. This includes roadmap governance, dependency management, release readiness, risk assessment, deployment coordination, operational tooling, incident response, and post-release validation. This role sits at the intersection of Production, Live Operations, Product, Engineering, and QA . We are looking for someone who combines strong operational leadership with enough technical depth to work credibly with Engineering teams and improve the systems behind live delivery. The background could come from Live Operations, Production, Release Management, Technical Production, or Engineering Management . What matters most is demonstrated experience operating close to live releases and production environments, coordinating complex cross-functional delivery, and improving the processes and technical systems that support execution at scale. You should be equally comfortable shaping long-term operating strategy, working through a complex dependency or release plan with delivery teams, partnering with engineers on tooling and automation, or stepping into a critical launch or incident to help drive resolution. What You'll Do Own the operating health of the live roadmap, ensuring priorities, sequencing, dependencies, capacity, and release plans are realistic and executable Establish and evolve the end-to-end operating model for taking work from roadmap definition through development, validation, approval, deployment, monitoring, and post-release review Lead release governance and readiness, including risk-based gates, clear ownership, go/no-go processes, escalation paths, rollback planning, and post-release validation Coordinate complex, high-frequency live releases across Product, Engineering, Live Operations, Production, QA, Content, and other partner teams Identify roadmap, technical, operational, and dependency risks early and drive clear mitigation and decision-making Partner closely with Engineering to improve deployment pipelines, configuration workflows, validation systems, observability, dashboards, automation, and operational tooling Translate operational needs into clear technical requirements and help prioritize tooling and platform improvements that reduce manual work and release risk Establish metrics and reporting that provide visibility into roadmap health, release readiness, throughput, incidents, rework, operational load, and time to resolution Improve production and release workflows by removing unnecessary handoffs, clarifying ownership, increasing automation, and creating sustainable operating standards Step into critical launches, incidents, or escalations when cross-functional coordination and rapid decision-making are required Lead operational change across teams, helping new processes, tooling, and ways of working become embedded rather than simply introduced Build trusted partnerships across senior Product, Engineering, Production, QA, Data, and Live Operations leadership Mentor Producers, Release Managers, Engineering Managers, or other operational leaders involved in the live delivery ecosystem What We're Looking For Significant experience leading complex live operations, release management, technical production, engineering delivery, or a closely related function within a live-service environment Demonstrated experience owning or influencing high-frequency releases across multiple teams, systems, dependencies, and concurrent workstreams Strong operational judgment, with experience balancing delivery speed, technical risk, player experience, business priorities, and sustainable team execution Technical fluency in software delivery and production environments, including deployment workflows, configuration management, validation, monitoring, rollback, and incident response Experience partnering closely with Engineering teams on release tooling, automation, production systems, or workflow improvements Strong understanding of roadmap planning, dependency management, release readiness, risk management, and operational governance Experience improving operating models, processes, tooling, or organizational ways of working across multiple teams Ability to move comfortably between strategic planning and detailed execution, remaining close enough to delivery to identify issues and unblock teams Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership, including the ability to align teams with different priorities without relying on direct authority Experience leading teams or developing leaders within Production, Live Operations, Release Management, Engineering, or adjacent functions Clear communication of technical, operational, and delivery risks to both technical and non-technical audiences AI Capability & Readiness We believe AI can meaningfully transform how Live Operations and release organizations execute at scale. In this role, you’ll be expected to actively leverage AI-enabled tools to improve roadmap analysis, dependency mapping, release readiness, documentation, risk identification, incident response, production analytics, decision support, and workflow automation. We value leaders who experiment thoughtfully with emerging AI technologies to reduce operational overhead, improve visibility and decision-making, increase release quality, and help teams move faster while maintaining strong standards of safety, accountability, and execution. Bonus Points Experience operating a large-scale mobile free-to-play or other high-frequency live-service product Experience as an Engineering Manager with meaningful ownership of production delivery, releases, incidents, or Live Operations Experience as a Technical Producer, Production Director, Release Director, Game Operations leader, or equivalent Experience designing or operating release trains, deployment pipelines, feature-flag systems, configuration platforms, or production-control frameworks Experience with GameOps, LiveOps, developer productivity, release engineering, SRE, platform engineering, or adjacent technical operations functions Experience building operational dashboards and release-health metrics Experience introducing automated validation, change controls, release tooling, or post-deployment monitoring Experience leading globally distributed teams across multiple time zones At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure! About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
location: ES - Barcelona, Spain; GB - United Kingdom
description: Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build. What You'll Do: We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development. Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework. Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change. Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it. Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing. Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is. Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide. Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean. Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF. Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation. Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead. What We’re Looking For: Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience. 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team. You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against. You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread. You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live. You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate. You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs. You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters. You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time. You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input. Detail and organization come naturally to you. Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business. You play games and care about the industry. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com . Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice . Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. title: Director, Senior Employment Counsel (Global)
description: Scopely is hiring a dynamic and experienced Director, Senior Employment Counsel (Global) to support employment-related legal and compliance matters in a global jurisdictional capacity. You will work out of our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. This is a strategic and tactical role responsible for partnering with internal stakeholders—including People Team, Legal, and executive leadership—to ensure compliance with employment laws, mitigate risk, and support the business in all aspects of employment including advising on employee issues and drafting offer documentation across a complex and diverse regional landscape. What you will do: Provide expert counsel on employment law matters across multiple regions. Particular familiarity in Europe, Middle East & Asia including Spain, India, UK, Ireland, Israel, Portugal, Switzerland, Turkey and Germany is required. Support for other regions within the portfolio may also be required. Serve as a trusted partner to the People Team and business leaders, guiding decision-making on employee relations, risk mitigation, and complex workplace issues. Support the Talent and Compensation teams in creation of employment documentation. Support employment litigation and dispute resolution in the regions supported, managing outside counsel as needed. Provide timely, practical, and business-focused legal guidance across multiple jurisdictions. Develop and update region-specific policies, handbooks, contracts, and procedures. Advise on strategic workforce planning, organizational design, restructuring, and M&A activity. Advise on works councils, unions and CBAs across the regions. Monitor and communicate regional legal developments and proactively adjust policies and practices to remain compliant. What we are looking for: Law degree with admission to practice in at least one jurisdiction In-office presence required 2-3 days per week in Barcelona, Spain. Relocation available Minimum 14 years of progressive experience in global employment law Proven success advising on complex, cross-border employment issues in a global, matrixed environment Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability and a deep understanding of risk management Excellent negotiation skills and resilience in partnering with the business Fluency in English required; professional proficiency in Spanish required, fluency preferred. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. title: MLOps Engineer
description: Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us. 💫 Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. 🌱 Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology. The Challenge 🧩 Wallapop generates billions of data points daily. With a mature data infrastructure already in place, our Data Science and Machine Learning area is gaining significant momentum. As we scale, we face the exciting challenge of taking our ML Platform to the next level to support complex solutions in Personalization, Search, Trust & Safety, and Logistics. As an ML Engineer (MLOps) , you will contribute to the evolution of our ML Platform and MLOps practice. You will partner with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and DevOps to collaborate on a vision that balances innovation with reliability, ensuring our models scale efficiently to serve millions of users. What You Will Do 👇 Iterate and maintain Wallapop’s ML Platform, identifying opportunities to improve speed, reliability, and maintainability. You will help execute the long-term vision and roadmap for MLOps. Work hand-in-hand with Data Scientists to support their efforts, ensuring they have the tooling to develop, deploy, and monitor scalable models efficiently. Adopt and promote engineering best practices (coding standards, testing, CI/CD) within the ML domain. Partner with Data Engineering and DevOps to align ML development with company-wide infrastructure and data governance standards. Investigate and integrate new frameworks and tools (e.g., for LLMs or real-time inference) to keep our stack modern and effective. What We’re Looking For 🔎 Solid experience contributing to and maintaining production-ready ML platforms and pipelines. You understand the lifecycle from experimentation to monitoring. Solid understanding of AWS components (SageMaker, Lambda, S3) and container orchestration with Kubernetes . Strong software engineering background with proficiency in Python , Git, and CI/CD workflows. You write robust, testable code. Experience with real-time ML architectures, leveraging tools like Kafka for low-latency ingestion and inference. Hands-on experience with vector databases or semantic search infrastructure (e.g., OpenSearch, Vertex AI), including indexing and retrieval tuning. Familiarity with the broader ML toolkit, such as orchestration/tracking tools (Flyte, MLFlow, Feast) and standard libraries (Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch). Professional proficiency in English , with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders. What Would Be A Plus 🚀 Hands-on experience working with LLMs, RAG architectures, and libraries like LangChain or LlamaIndex. Familiarity with Big Data technologies like Spark or Beam. Experience with Data Engineering tools such as Airflow, dbt, or Datahub. Experience with other cloud platforms like GCP or Azure in addition to AWS. Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals. Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone. Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits : Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year Free office meals, lunch selection from different providers Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day Private Health Insurance with Alan Flexible working hours + intensive Fridays Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check) Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office Generous referral Program & Charity Donation Bonus for weddings & newborns Wallapop Renta (Tax income support) Monthly plan for free shipping, bumps & home-pick-up on our services Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable 26 holidays per year TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows) What does the hiring process for this position look like? 👀 **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.** Intro Call - run by Talent Acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. This usually takes 45-60 minutes. Case Study - you will be working in a case study to assess the technical skills required for the role. Expertise Interview - run by the core team, focusing on the hard skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60-90 minutes. Stakeholder Interview - run by the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes. Culture-Add Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes. Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. WPP Media ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y considera las candidaturas para todos los puestos sin distinción de raza, color, sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, embarazo, nacimiento de un hijo/a, condiciones médicas o discapacidad. title: Senior QA Engineer
description: BidMachine Exchange – a fast-growing global programmatic exchange built for the future of in-app advertising. BidMachine operates with a strong US foundation and an international presence, with teams across Warsaw, Barcelona, Parkland (FL), and remote experts around the world. We combine deep AdTech expertise, proprietary technology, and a data-driven mindset to deliver transparency, performance, and efficiency in the mobile advertising ecosystem. Why BidMachine? At BidMachine, we are building more than an exchange — we are shaping the infrastructure that powers fair, efficient, and scalable in-app programmatic advertising. Our mission is to create a high-performance marketplace where publishers maximize value and advertisers access premium inventory with full transparency and control. We are proud of our technology, our ambitious vision, and our globally distributed team of talented professionals who continuously raise the bar in AdTech. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Ownership & Accountability We move fast, take responsibility, and think like builders. Every team member has a direct impact on product growth and market success. Data-Informed Excellence We leverage data to make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and build scalable solutions that deliver measurable results. Innovation & Technical Depth We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem. Global Collaboration We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards. Ambition & Impact We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market. The team is looking for a QA Engineer in Barcelona. Responsibilities: End-to-End Mobile Ad Testing: Conduct comprehensive testing of mobile ad formats (banner ads, interstitials, rewarded video ads, native ads) to ensure correct display, functionality, and user experience across multiple devices and OS versions. Ad Integration Validation: Verify the correct integration of ad SDKs in mobile apps, ensuring compliance with ad network specifications and proper ad rendering. Tracking and Analytics Verification: Test and validate that analytics and tracking events are correctly implemented, ensuring that ad performance data is accurately captured (e.g., impressions, clicks, conversions). Cross-Device and Platform Testing: Ensure that ads are rendered and perform consistently across various mobile devices, screen sizes, operating systems (iOS/Android), and environments. SDK Testing: Perform manual and automated testing of mobile SDKs used for ad integrations, ensuring they function properly and integrate well with mobile applications. Bug Reporting and Tracking: Document issues, inconsistencies, and bugs related to ad display, tracking, and interaction using issue-tracking tools (Jira, TestRail, etc.) and collaborate with the development team for timely resolution. Regression Testing: Conduct regular regression testing for ad-related features following SDK updates, new releases, or modifications in the ad-serving framework. Collaboration with Ad Operations: Work closely with the ad operations and product teams to understand campaign requirements and ensure proper ad functionality and tracking throughout the mobile app lifecycle. Technology Stack: Mobile Testing: Android, iOS, mobile app testing tools. Ad Testing: Testing of mobile ads (banner, interstitial, video ads), ad network integrations, debugging ad rendering and tracking. Analytics Testing: Event tracking validation, experience with mobile analytics platforms (Google Analytics, Firebase, Adjust, AppsFlyer). SDK Testing: Experience testing Software Development Kits (SDKs), integration testing, API testing, and verifying SDK behavior across different environments. API Testing: Postman, REST API testing, validating data exchange between systems. Bug Tracking and Test Management Tools: Jira, TestRail, or similar tools for defect tracking and test management. Agile Methodologies: Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, participating in sprint planning and backlog grooming. Version Control: Git or other version control systems. Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance, preferably in a gamedev, AdTech. Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies. Test Automation experience is a huge plus. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Ability to quickly adapt to changing business requirements and ability to multitask. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space. Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!

title: Treasury Senior Associate
description: About the opportunity As Senior Associate, Treasury , you will autonomously drive core treasury operations, liquidity and cash management, and investments (with a primary focus on public sector financing). Operating with high autonomy, you will manage the short term Treasury book, central bank operations, assess bank’s liquidity position and monitor key KPIs. Acting as a crucial bridge across Group Risk, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting, you will also as 1 LoD maintain audit readiness to ensure complete operational stability. In this role, you will: Trade Execution & Portfolio Management: Evaluate potential investment opportunities, then price (Bloomberg experience required), execute, and log transactions across Front Office tools, focusing primarily on public sector financing and short maturities. Proactively manage money market products and the short-term book, including Repo and Reverse Repo portfolios. Liquidity & Reserve Management: Oversee key liquidity functions, including Bundesbank cash pooling, Eurosystem minimum reserve requirements, overnight deposits, credit lines, and short-term portfolio hedging. Payment Systems & Central Bank Operations: Serve as the primary deputy for key payment and settlement infrastructure (Target, ESMIG, MACCS) and oversee central bank account management. Audit, Compliance & Governance: Support internal and external audits, enforce compliance with key banking regulations, and drive First Line of Defense (1LoD) risk management. Product & Tech Initiatives: Lead New Product Process (NPP) implementations, vendor onboarding, core banking system enhancements, and automated reporting solutions using SQL. What you need to be successful: Experience: Strong background in bank treasury operations, liquidity management, and money markets, with a preference for hands-on Repo/Reverse Repo and hedging experience. Technical & System Expertise: Solid familiarity with Treasury Front Office tools (Bloomberg experience required), payment and settlement systems (Target, ESMIG, MACCS), and data querying skills (SQL). Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of financial markets combined with a sound grasp of Eurosystem frameworks, reserve requirements, and key European banking regulations (including MaRisk, CRR III, and KWG). Ownership: Proven ability to drive cross-functional projects, step in as a trusted deputy across core functions, and operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment. What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles! Equal opportunities for all At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you! title: Senior Liquidity Risk Manager (ILAAP)
description: About the opportunity We are seeking a Senior Manager Risk Controlling to help us further develop and strengthen our Risk Controlling function with a focus on the Internal Liquidity Adequacy Assessment Process (ILAAP) and overall Liquidity Risk Management . As part of the Risk Controlling team , you will lead the development, implementation, and analysis of models for liquidity risk controlling, covering both regulatory requirements (Pillar I) and internal methodologies (Pillar II) . You will ensure that N26 maintains a robust liquidity position through advanced modelling, stress testing, and expert methodological guidance. At N26, we are redefining banking through technology and innovation. As a Risk Controlling Manager with a focus on ILAAP and liquidity risk , you will have the opportunity to shape the future of risk management in a fast-paced, forward-thinking environment. Join us and be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and excellence. In this role, you will: Lead the design, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the ILAAP framework , ensuring it accurately reflects the firm's liquidity adequacy and risk appetite. Develop, calibrate and continuously refine quantitative liquidity risk methodologies based on historical development data, including deposit stability models, liquidity runoff assumptions, internal liquidity maturity ladders , survival period analysis, and intraday liquidity metrics. Design and statistically calibrate liquidity risk model parameters using internal historical data, expert judgement and stress-testing results, ensuring that assumptions remain empirically grounded and fit for purpose. Translate the specific characteristics of a digital retail bank into tailored liquidity risk methodologies rather than relying solely on standard regulatory metrics and industry practices. Spearhead the design and calibration of comprehensive liquidity stress scenarios , identifying potential vulnerabilities and challenging qualitative assumptions. Ensure full compliance with relevant European and German regulatory requirements, such as MaRisk and EBA Guidelines on ILAAP , while overseeing regulatory liquidity reporting standards. Establish and maintain the architectural design of risk limits for liquidity and funding, providing expert advice on limit calibration and remediation strategies. Lead initiatives to improve the quality, governance, and lineage of core balance sheet data used in liquidity risk and ILAAP calculations. Act as the primary methodological expert and project lead for interactions with internal/external auditors and regulators (e.g., EBA, national central banks) regarding the adequacy and robustness of liquidity risk practices. What you need to be successful: Background : Quantitative academic background (Master's in statistics, mathematics, economics, or a similar quantitative field). Professional certifications like CFA or FRM are a plus. 7-10+ years of practical experience in a risk controlling function or a leading consultancy (Big Four), with deep expertise in Liquidity Risk and ILAAP within a regulated financial institution. Skills : Strong understanding of ILAAP frameworks and liquidity risk management (Pillar I and Pillar II), including liquidity stress testing, funding risk, deposit behaviour modelling, and key metrics (e.g. survival horizon, maturity transformation). Experience in designing, calibrating, and validating quantitative methodologies for liquidity risk, including stress scenarios, behavioural assumptions, and model parametrisation. Strong understanding of statistical analysis and data-driven modelling techniques (e.g. time-series analysis, scenario modelling, calibration and backtesting). Strong understanding of data flows, data quality and governance of key risk inputs. Ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into structured analytical methodologies and algorithmic solutions. Extensive knowledge of regulatory requirements (e.g., MaRisk, CRR, ICAAP and ILAAP guidelines, EBA regulatory expectations). Strong expertise in risk governance frameworks , including risk appetite, policies, internal controls, and decision-making frameworks. Ability to work independently , form sound judgments on complex risk topics, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders and regulators. Experience with specifying data requirements and collaborating with Data Engineering or Risk Technology teams is a strong plus. Fluent English is required; German language skills are a plus. What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. Sounds good? Apply now for this position. Equal Opportunities: We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential. We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com . title: Senior Backend Engineer - Engagement
description: About the opportunity You will work in the Grow & Engage domain —the heart of the N26 experience. From initial signup to premium memberships and daily engagement, you’ll work in teams delivering innovative features that serve our customers. We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with product-centric​ mindset to join our mission-driven team. As a vital contributor throughout the entire feature lifecycle, you will partner closely with Product Owner, Tech Lead and Designers to translate user needs into the seamless, scalable backend systems that empower our users from day one. This is a hybrid role based in Berlin or Barcelona. We value in-person collaboration and expect our employees to spend at least 8 days per month in the office . In this role, you will: Do discovery, design, develop, test, deploy and maintain software in a thriving environment. Manage individual project priorities and deliverables whilst working in a team who enjoy knowledge sharing sessions. Stay up to date with the latest trends in technology. Propose new product ideas, build tech tools or try out new architectural approaches during our Get Stuff Done Days (GSDD). What you need to be successful: Background: Experience in developing software using a JVM language and Spring Boot in large-scale production systems (note: experience of Kotlin would be a plus). In-depth understanding of microservice architecture. Knowledge of both relational (preferably Postgres) and non-relational databases. Appreciation of working in a modern cloud architecture, preferably with AWS. You know your way around using AI tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development without sacrificing quality. Traits : Product-centric mindset, first you ask "why", then "what" and only then think of "how". Strong sense of ownership: you take initiatives from early-stage ideas all the way to customer-facing results. Negotiating delivery scope and providing realistic timelines are just as important to you as writing code. Strong call to action and for getting things done Ongoing appreciation and consideration for security Motivation to write code which is well-tested and well-documented Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. title: Fleet Development Analyst
description: ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas? En el equipo de Fleet Development estamos buscando la persona idónea para que se incorpore como Analyst. Dentro de la estructura de España, el equipo de Fleet Development es responsable directo de la negociación y crecimiento de la oferta que opera en la plataforma a través de negociación y cierre de operadores nuevos, así como la constante iteración de propuesta de valor a los mismos que genera el mercado y su crecimiento dentro de la misma.. La misión de la posición será apoyar el crecimiento y maximización de la capacidad de operación de nuestros operadores en el mediano y largo plazo mediante la coordinación táctica del resto del equipo y resto de áreas, así como la implementación de propuestas de valor definidas en el área de Success para cada región en la que operamos y mix de competencia. ¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión? Mantener relaciones con partners existentes y potenciales Apoyar en el desarrollo de la estrategia de retención y activación de partners, identificando las principales oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo de aquellos que actualmente operan con Cabify. Coordinación con el resto de disciplinas de las líneas de acción que atacan estas oportunidades, ejecución de las propias y maximizar activación. Seguimiento de objetivos de activación de licencias de partners actuales. Seguimiento y evolución de partners, diagnosticando motivadores de cambio para ejecutar posibles palancas que reviertan el impacto. Analizar e interpretar datos de CRM así como generación de cuadros de mando operativos para toma de decisiones tácticas e identificación de oportunidades tanto a corto como medio y largo plazo. Identificación constante de nuevas oportunidades de modelos de negocio y propuestas para mejorar la relación con partners y cierre de nuevos. ¿Qué buscamos? Experiencia en captación de clientes y su gestión Gran capacidad de creación de relaciones de confianza con Partners o clientes. description: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI. The Role Are you ready to accelerate your sales career at Elastic, the Search AI company ? As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Elastic, you'll play a key role in driving our continued growth by engaging prospective customers, understanding their business challenges, and creating high-quality opportunities that fuel our sales pipeline. Working closely with Account Executives and Marketing, you'll identify the right prospects, spark meaningful conversations, and help organizations discover how Elastic's platform can solve their most critical business challenges. We've built a collaborative workspace in Barcelona where teamwork, continuous learning, and career development are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that drive, curiosity, and coachability are the foundations of long-term success. If you're eager to learn, embrace feedback, and make an impact, we'd love to meet you. What You Will Do Partner for Success: Collaborate closely with your Account Executives and Marketing to identify target accounts, execute strategic campaigns, and generate high-quality pipeline across your territory. Create Meaningful Conversations: Engage inbound and outbound prospects through a thoughtful multi-channel approach. Ask great questions, uncover business challenges, and qualify opportunities that create value for both the customer and our sales teams. Leverage Technology: Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Demandbase, Sumble, AI-powered tools, and other sales technologies to research accounts, identify key decision-makers, personalize your outreach, and maximize your effectiveness. Become an Elastic Expert: Develop a strong understanding of the Elastic platform, our AI-powered solutions, and the industries we serve so you can confidently articulate business value and connect customer challenges with the right solutions. Learn, Grow, and Own Your Development: Take ownership of your growth by embracing coaching, continuous feedback, and ongoing enablement. You'll work alongside experienced colleagues who are invested in helping you build a successful long-term career at Elastic. What You Bring Native-level language skills in region and professional fluency in English. Sales, Sales Development, or customer-facing experience is a plus, but not a requirement. We're equally excited to meet ambitious early-career professionals who are eager to build a career in sales. A strong drive to succeed and a genuine desire to build a successful career in sales. A highly coachable mindset: you actively seek feedback, embrace challenges, and continuously look for ways to improve. Curiosity and a passion for understanding technology, customer challenges, and how businesses grow. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage prospects confidently through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other digital channels. Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize effectively and manage multiple opportunities. AI Mindset: Use new technologies for performance advantage Resilience, determination, and the ambition to consistently achieve and exceed your goals.
