title: Independent Board Director (ML-Driven Product & Data Platform Leader)
description: Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence. We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world. Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space. Why Appodeal? At Appodeal, we’re more than just a company—we’re a team united by a common mission: Help people discover and grow their talents through products that enable successful mobile app businesses! We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Continuous Learning and Growth: We are passionate about learning, growing personally, and building rewarding careers. Making an Impact: We are committed to building a history-defining company that leaves a lasting impact on the mobile app industry. Solving Exciting Challenges: We tackle complex problems every day, supported by a team of world-class professionals and mentors. Enjoying the Journey: We believe in having fun while working toward our goals. We are seeking an independent board director with deep experience operating ML-driven products and data platforms at scale . This role is not focused on academic research or algorithm development. Instead, we are looking for a leader who has built organizations where data, experimentation, and machine l earning directly drive product decisions, optimization, and revenue growth . The ideal candidate brings expertise in areas such as: building strong data science organizations; designing data platforms and experimentation infrastructure; integrating ML into product decision loops; developing operating cultures built around data and experimentation; This is a non-executive board position , not an operating role. Appodeal is building a performance-driven technology platform powered by data and machine learning . Our systems rely on: large-scale data pipelines; real-time decision systems; automated optimization; experimentation and model iteration. The company operates an ecosystem including: advertising infrastructure; demand-side platform (DSP); supply-side platform (SSP); mobile game publishing and development. Machine learning and data infrastructure are core to the company’s long-term competitive advantage . Strategic Focus of the Role The mission of this role is to strengthen the board’s ability to guide the company in building a world-class data and machine learning organization . The director will contribute a perspective on: structuring and scaling data science teams; designing experimentation-driven product cultures; building high-quality data platforms and infrastructure; integrating ML systems into business decision processes; best practices for data-driven product development; organizational structures that allow ML systems to improve continuously. This role focuses on how ML-driven companies operate , rather than on the underlying algorithms themselves. Responsibilities Board members are expected to: Participate in quarterly board meetings; Provide independent strategic guidance to the CEO and leadership team; Contribute to discussions around data platform strategy and ML-driven product development; Provide perspective on organizational structure for data science and ML teams; Help evaluate major technical and infrastructure investments; Share insight from companies where ML directly drives business outcomes; Board members are not involved in day-to-day operations . Ideal Background We are looking for a technology or product leader who has built ML-driven product organizations where data science plays a central role in revenue generation and product optimization. Prior board experience is welcome but not required. What We Value We are looking for individuals who bring: deep experience running ML-driven product organizations: strong operational judgment; experience building data-driven engineering cultures; an independent mindset; willingness to challenge assumptions constructively. Time Commitment Estimated commitment: approximately four weeks per year . This includes preparation and participation in board meetings as well as occasional strategic discussions with the leadership team. With an outstanding product and a mission that excites and inspires, Appodeal offers a unique opportunity to make an impact while being part of an amazing team. Join us and help shape the future of mobile app success!

title: IT Solutions Engineer - Google Cloud
description: About the opportunity As an IT Solutions Engineer (Google Cloud) within N26 Internal IT, you will be the primary architect, engineer, and guardian of our Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) corporate ecosystem. We aren’t looking for traditional system administrators. We need a modern, engineering-focused professional who treats our Google environment as a programmable platform. You will bridge the gap between corporate productivity, identity management, and cloud infrastructure—ensuring our global workforce is secure, highly automated, and empowered by next-generation AI integrations. In this role, you will: Infrastructure & Governance: Manage the full lifecycle of our enterprise Google Workspace organization. Design and maintain complex GCP project structures, organizational units (OUs), Cloud Identity, and Chrome Enterprise across the company. Automation & Development: Eliminate manual overhead by building robust, custom automation workflows. Leverage Google Apps Script, Python, and REST APIs to seamlessly integrate Workspace with internal tools, HRIS platforms, and Identity providers. Next-Gen Productivity: Lead the rollout, adoption, and ongoing optimization of Gemini Enterprise, driving organizational productivity through emerging AI capabilities. Security & Compliance: Design and enforce Data Loss Prevention (DLP) rules, Context-Aware Access (CAA), and secure BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) policies that balance "Security first" with "Employee Experience." eDiscovery & Compliance: Serve as the technical owner for Google Vault. Define and manage data retention policies, execute precise legal holds, and lead matter-based exports to meet strict financial regulatory and audit requirements. What you need to be successful: Google Workspace & GCP Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience administering Google Workspace at an enterprise scale, combined with solid foundational knowledge of GCP (IAM hierarchies, Service Accounts, VPCs, and Organization Policies). Automation Mindset: Proven track record of automating repetitive IT workflows using Python, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script, and interacting with RESTful APIs. Infrastructure as Code Skills: Practical experience (or strong familiarity) using Terraform to manage SaaS or cloud environments. Security & Identity Focus: Deep understanding of modern identity management, SAML/OIDC protocols, and Zero Trust security architectures (specifically Google’s Context-Aware Access and BeyondCorp models). Chrome Enterprise Management: Proven experience configuring Chrome as a secure enterprise browser, including the deployment of Chrome Enterprise Premium security controls. Analytical & Compliance-Minded: Familiarity with compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC2) and the operational workflows of Google Vault for legal and audit discovery. Collaborative Spirit: Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical requirements into user-friendly solutions for a diverse global team. Nice to Have Professional Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Collaboration Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent security certifications. Fintech Experience: Experience working in highly regulated industries (banking, fintech, or healthcare) with stringent data governance requirements. What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles! Equal opportunities for all At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you! title: Game Designer - Wheel of Fortune!
description: Scopely is looking for a Game Designer to serve on and elevate the experience on Wheel of Fortune! As the sole Design owner on Wheel of Fortune and reporting directly to the Game Director, this is a unique opportunity to work on a small & mighty Team and put your stamp on a beloved Franchise played across the globe and live for over a decade! What You'll Do This role has it all: helping to define the product roadmap, ensuring that each user experience is flawless, and anything in between. You will be expected to: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Art, Analytics, LiveOps and QA to bring compelling features from concept to release. Write and update design specs that contain the right level of detail while staying concise and easy to understand for the whole team Help plan our Production roadmap and Liveops calendar Drive feature optimizations to maintain gameplay quality, improve balance, and boost player engagement (levels & puzzles, battle pass, weekly and daily challenges, etc.) Keep a Design Owner mentality, ensuring designs meet the player’s needs, the franchise strategy and the business goals Follow the most recent market trends and best practices to create the best possible designs for our roadmap features, and to bring new ideas to the table What We're Looking For 2-5 years of professional game design experience Demonstrated proficiency with level design, systems design, game tuning, content design, user experience design and overall design documentation Deep understanding of free-to-play monetization mechanics including game balancing and virtual economy management Excellent communication skills - remotely and in person - with the ability to gather feedback, align stakeholders, and iterate to success collaboratively. Comfortable working independently while thriving in a highly dynamic and international environment. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to improve designs. Bonus Points Experience working as a Game Designer in free-to-play mobile gaming with a focus on casual/social and/or word/trivia genre Deep understanding of the Wheel of Fortune TV show, its gameplay and rules At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure! About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. description: Allow us to introduce ourselves Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions. We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally. Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀 Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here Your mission as a Growth Marketing Manager We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to build and activate a consistent New Business pipeline engine for Spain, working closely with Marketing and Account Management to turn events, target accounts and dormant clients into high-value opportunities. A few words about the team Our Spanish team is fast-moving, highly collaborative and supportive, and we love momentum. We work hard to push the needle, but we do it as a tight-knit group. We are hands-on, quick on our feet and always ready to test creative ideas to keep our growth trajectory high while having a great time doing it. What you’ll be doing Build target account lists, map key stakeholders and support Account-Based Marketing initiatives together with Sales. Drive commercial activation around owned and third-party events, from pre-event outreach to post-event follow-up and opportunity creation. Reactivate dormant or underdeveloped accounts to unlock new business potential. Design outbound sequences, commercial angles and follow-up campaigns for priority accounts and industries. Adapt global Marketing initiatives to the Spanish market and connect them with local commercial priorities. Track meetings, opportunities and pipeline generated through events and marketing-led activities. Improve commercial discipline and pipeline visibility across these initiatives. You will thrive in this role if You bring 4–7 years of experience in B2B commercial activation, field marketing, demand generation, ABM or consultative agency environments. Good understanding of market research is a super plus. You are a natural dot-connector who combines a hands-on execution style with creative commercial thinking. You understand how to use Account-Based Marketing principles, events and targeted outreach to open doors at priority accounts. You are comfortable working closely with Sales and contributing directly to pipeline generation. You are quick to learn, adapt fast to changing priorities and enjoy working in a high-energy team. This is not a performance marketing role or a traditional BDR position. What’s in it for you? Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year All the hardware you need and your own MacBook In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces Additional role details This is a fully remote position for candidates based in Spain This role will report directly to our General Manager for Spain Our interview process Screening Call with the Talent Acquisition team Hiring Manager Interview Case Study Interview Reference Check Offer Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English. title: Sales Development Representative - Finland

Join our high-energy team in Barcelona and help us bring smarter payment solutions to small businesses across Finland and Europe. At SumUp , we’re on a mission to empower small merchants by making payments simple, accessible, and hassle-free. Today, we support over 4 million businesses in 30+ countries — and we’re just getting started. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you’ll be the first point of contact with future SumUp merchants, introducing them to a product that actually makes a difference. Whether you're just starting out or looking to grow in your sales career, this role offers the perfect launchpad: 📞 Build real sales skills 🌍 Work in a diverse, international team 🧠 Learn fast with expert mentorship 🚀 Grow your career in tech from day one What you'll be up to: Proactively reach out to businesses via targeted outbound calls to understand their needs and assess their fit for SumUp’s POS and payment solutions Qualify merchants by gathering key business information and offering insights into how our products can support their operations Schedule high-quality, localised appointments for our Field Sales team to conduct in-depth demos, negotiate terms, and close deals Focus on outreach to merchants who haven’t requested contact, using outbound tools, lead lists, and past opportunity data Play a key role in driving deal generation by ensuring Field Sales has a strong pipeline of well-matched, engaged prospects We’d love to meet you if you have: Strong communication skills and a friendly, confident phone presence Fluency in Finnish and English Experience working directly with customers or clients in a fast-paced environment A track record in outbound outreach — you’re comfortable starting conversations from scratch Some hands-on cold calling experience (and the resilience that comes with it!) Previous sales experience — not a must, but definitely a plus Life at SumUp: 💸 Competitive base salary + uncapped commission — your earning potential grows with your success! 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Barcelona office. This involves an office-first setup. 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 🥗 Restaurant tickets 🚇 public transport ticket (50%), Health Insurance (50%) 🏅The Urban Sports Club basic plan membership 👥An amazing team and work environment that works with passion and purpose to achieve incredible results. 🪩We get together regularly for breakfasts, team events, office parties and sports. 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 📍 be based in the heart of Barcelona 🏠We offer a relocation bonus to support your move About SumUp Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we create powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. title: Retail Media Manager
description: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com . Nuestra cultura y nuestras personas son el motor de WPP Media, y nos impulsan a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales. En este rol, tu contribución será clave para vivir y promover nuestros valores: Ser Extraordinario: Liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza. Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa. Tu rol y contribución Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Media Management & Delivery buscamos un/a Retail Media Manager que impulse el desarrollo e implementación de la estrategia integral de Retail Media, maximizando los ingresos publicitarios y el crecimiento del ecosistema digital de uno de nuestros principales clientes del sector FMCG. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de: Definir y optimizar la estrategia de inversión en Retail Media para alcanzar los KPIs de negocio del cliente. Planificar campañas full-funnel en Amazon y otros retailers para cumplir objetivos de performance y branding . Utilizar analítica avanzada (ej. AMC) para generar insights , construir audiencias y medir el impacto incremental en el negocio. Orquestar equipos internos y externos para activaciones integradas y presentar resultados y recomendaciones estratégicas al cliente. Identificar oportunidades (análisis de competencia, nuevas betas) y ejecutar planes de Test & Learn para mejorar continuamente el rendimiento de la cuenta. Presentar y comercializar la oferta publicitaria a clientes directos y agencias, negociando acuerdos comerciales estratégicos. ¿Qué buscamos en ti? Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en Retail Media con un enfoque en la gestión de campañas publicitarias. Experiencia práctica indispensable en el ecosistema de Amazon Ads (Sponsored Ads, Brands, Display) y Amazon DSP. Experiencia demostrable en la gestión de plataformas self-service más allá de Amazon, como soportes que utilizan tecnologías de Citrus, Criteo, etc. Valorable experiencia en el uso de herramientas de terceros para la automatización y optimización a escala, como Pacvue o Skai. Familiaridad con data clean rooms como Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) o soluciones similares. Visión estratégica del negocio y alta capacidad para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación estratégica y gestión de stakeholders . Nivel de inglés fluido, que te permita defenderte en conversaciones de negocio. Título universitario en Marketing, Publicidad, ADE o similar. Vida en WPP Media y beneficios En WPP Media, invertimos en nuestra gente, impulsando tu crecimiento profesional con la misma pasión con la que lideramos la inversión responsable en medios. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Además de un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, en WPP Media nos preocupamos por tu bienestar y equilibrio. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete de beneficios pensado para ti: Flexibilidad: Disfruta de un modelo híbrido de teletrabajo en Barcelona, complementado con flexibilidad horaria en la entrada y salida. Bienestar y ventajas: Accede a un plan de Retribución Flexible que se adapta a tus necesidades, subvención del menú diario y café y fruta en la oficina. Cuidado personal: Fomentamos tu salud y bienestar con clases de Yoga/Pilates y la posibilidad de sesiones de fisioterapia. Próximos pasos Si te identificas con esta oportunidad y quieres formar parte de WPP Media, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!. Envíanos tu candidatura y, si tu perfil encaja con lo que buscamos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo. Para cualquier duda, puedes contactar con nosotros en talentacquisition.spain@wppmedia.com . WPP Media ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y considera las candidaturas para todos los puestos sin distinción de raza, color, sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, religión, nacionalidad, embarazo, nacimiento de un hijo/a, condiciones médicas o discapacidad. Para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas consulta nuestra Política de Privacidad ( https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ). #Hiring #WPPMedia #MediaManagementAndDelivery #RetailMedia #Amazon #LI-PROMOTED Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: UA Manager
description: Who we are: Let's have fun shaping your future! We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them! About the Role We’re looking for a User Acquisition Manager to support the growth of Two Dots, Dragon City & Monster Legends through hands-on campaign management, testing, and performance optimization. This role focuses on day-to-day execution, data-driven decision making, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive efficient user growth. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with ~3 years of experience in mobile UA who is ready to take ownership of live campaigns, improve performance, and grow their career within a leading gaming studio. What You'll Do: Manage daily UA operations across key channels (social, SDK networks, programmatic). Execute campaigns end-to-end: setup, optimization, budgeting, and reporting. Run structured tests (creatives, audiences, channels) to improve CPI, ROAS, and IPM. Partner with the Creative team to brief concepts, review performance, and iterate. Monitor performance dashboards and surface insights, trends, and opportunities. Collaborate with Product, ASO, and BI teams to support full-funnel improvements. Assist in forecasting and pacing monthly budgets. Stay current on platform updates, industry trends, and competitive activity. What You Bring: 2–3+ years of mobile UA or performance marketing experience. Hands-on experience running ad networks or social campaigns. Strong analytical and KPI-driven mindset; comfortable working with data. Familiarity with mobile attribution (MMPs), ad networks, and UA platforms. Proficiency with Excel/Sheets (pivot tables, lookups). Organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously. Clear communicator and effective cross-team collaborator. Bonus Points: Experience in mobile gaming and free-to-play environments. Basic knowledge of SQL or data tools. Experience working on a live game or app at scale. What's in it for you as a Socialpointer? Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full Disability and life insurance Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet) Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies) Professional development budget for skills training Onsite perks include: State of the art gym facilities Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!) The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English. title: Specialist, Trading Operations - Night Shift
description: Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go! Your mission As a Trading Operations Specialist at Bitpanda, your mission is to ensure a secure and smooth trading experience. You are well-versed in the foundations of financial instruments and trading systems and also possess a very strong, problem-solving-oriented mindset. What you’ll do Deep-dive into and quick understanding of our financial products, trading and hedging systems Handle market alerts and execute OTC trades & blockchain transactions on behalf of Bitpanda Perform daily settlement and reconciliation of trades Monitor hedging and trading activity and maintain the relevant risk parameter settings; you will be the first line of defence for the sanity of our trading and hedging operations Proactively document and improve processes & recommend system developments Who you are Experience in trading operations or a similar area (trader certificate is a plus); you should have a great understanding of and/or interest in financial markets, particularly equities or cryptocurrencies/blockchain Ability to identify problems and solve them quickly or escalate them as necessary Strong data investigation skills (MS Excel in particular and SQL or working with databases is a plus; experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv (Reuters) or FactSet is welcome) Great team player with strong attention to detail, excellent organizational and communication skills (English is a must), thriving in an ever-changing environment Ability to work in night shift (00:00-07:00) to ensure operational continuity in a 24/7 business What’s in it for you Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice. Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan. Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP. Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months. Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace. Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel. Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family. Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long. Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda. Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent. Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are. Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform. Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. * These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).

In this role, you will Support the Vendor Management team in daily collaboration with external providers, facilitating communication between vendors and internal teams on operational topics. Manage access requests for external users, ensuring the correct tools and permissions are assigned and that technical issues are resolved in a timely manner. Assist in preparing and tracking SLA and KPI reports to monitor vendor performance, and support the creation of regular reports on vendor performance and key risk indicators (KRIs). Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical ability with attention to detail. Understanding of game design concepts and principles. Experience hitting revenue/metric targets on a live game. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Passion for figuring out how game economies work. Strong verbal and written communication skills. An MBA or a Degree in Economics, Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, or Finance is a plus. At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! description: Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. You must be comfortable with being both strategic and hands-on, with a customer-centric mindset you will find the balance to further scale our product and maximize the potential value we can deliver to our Wallapop users and organization. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, product vision, and leadership skills to drive initiatives that address challenges in a dynamic digital environment. What You Will Do 👇 Drive the development and execution of the product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on impact, user needs, and company objectives. Collaborate with engineering, data science, product design, and operations teams to develop and launch innovative products that meet user needs and drive business growth. Ensure product quality standards are maintained across all devices, platforms, and applicable use cases. Analyze market trends and user feedback to inform product development and strategy. Lead cross-functional teams through the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions. Monitor product performance and user feedback, iterating and refining products to improve user experience and achieve business goals. Stay abreast of industry trends and technological advancements to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge. What We’re Looking For 🔎 Demonstrated experience in leading x-functional teams to successfully deliver product initiatives in a fast paced environment Ability to solve complex problems, assess risks, and carry out well-structured, data-informed reasoning Deep user empathy Strong communication and interpersonal skills Proficiency in English a must & spanish a plus Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals. Wallapop is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone. We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package. Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits : Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year Free office meals, lunch selection from different providers Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day Private Health Insurance with Alan Flexible working hours + Intensive Fridays Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check) Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office Generous referral Program & Charity Donation Bonus for weddings & newborns Wallapop Renta (Tax income support) Monthly product advantages (Wallapop Club) Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable 26 holidays per year TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows) What does the hiring process for this position look like? 👀 **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.** Intro Call - run by talent acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. Case Study Submission - you will be assigned a task to submit within 5 up to 7 days where you will be able to showcase your expertise for the role. Expertise Interview - run by the hiring team, focus on the required core skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60-90 minutes. Stakeholder Interview - run by relevant stakeholders reflecting the reality of the context of the role, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up. This usually takes 60 minutes. Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes. Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

description: ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? En Cabify eso es exactamente lo que hacemos. title: IT Operations Lead EU
description: 📍 Berlin, Germany | Full-time | Corporate IT About the team Corporate IT at SumUp keeps technology working for 4,600+ people across more than 30 markets. The team runs the daily IT experience, from hardware and access to service delivery and regional support, and is now building the management layer that lets it scale properly. This role sits at the centre of that build: you'll own the operational performance of a mixed in-house and outsourced support team across Europe, and you'll be the person who makes SLAs real, onboarding and offboarding reliable, and regional IT consistent from Berlin to Barcelona and beyond. If you're energised by bringing structure to a fast-moving operation rather than inheriting one that's already clean, this is the right opportunity. What you'll do Lead the day-to-day performance of a team of system administrators and outsourced first-level IT admins across Europe Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s, and build capability through coaching Own SLA targets end-to-end: design the priority model, enforce queue standards, run the daily triage operation, and report performance to stakeholders in plain business language Take full ownership of the joiner-mover-leaver process in close partnership with HR and Security, ensuring every new joiner has hardware and access on day one, role changes are clean, and offboarding is timely and audit-ready Manage the regional access and licence lifecycle: provisioning, access reviews, renewals, and day-to-day allocation with a clear approval path that keeps shadow IT out Set and enforce the standards for outsourced first-level coverage across multiple cities, so expansion lands with structure and quality, not just headcount Coordinate incident response for operational failures, lead post-incident reviews, and make sure learnings feed back into process and tooling You'll be great for this role if… More than 8 years of experience working in IT Operations or as an IT Manager Proven experience managing a distributed team in different locations and time zones (4 - 8 team members). Deep experience designing and enforcing SLA frameworks. Strong ownership of the joiner-mover-leaver process end-to-end, working closely with HR and Security to keep access clean and offboarding audit-ready. Solid working knowledge of Jira Service Management for operational use, queue design, SLA tracking, and performance reporting. Familiarity with ITIL or similar service management frameworks, applied in practice rather than in theory. Comfort bringing structure and consistency to a fast-scaling operation. Why you should join SumUp 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 🏖 Generous time off 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team About SumUp Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify. SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: Scopely is seeking a highly motivated Senior Analytics Engineer to join our Playgami team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis ! At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily. Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to build the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC. What You’ll Do Lead and collaborate with engineers, product teams, and analysts to develop self-serve insight products that are responsive, precise, and scalable at petabyte levels Oversee the entire data product lifecycle, including designing new tracking plans, developing data models, ELT pipelines, and self-serve insight products like Looker explores and dashboards Act as a guardian of data quality, ensuring consistent metric reporting across a wide range of data products Utilize cutting-edge technology stack including BigQuery, dbt and Looker Provide technical leadership and empathize with game product teams and departments to enhance their daily operations and product success Bring expertise in a specific part of the data stack and lifecycle while contributing broadly across all aspects Mentor team members and drive the adoption of best practices within the team What We’re Looking For A strong passion for solving complex analytical puzzles Proven ability to translate business needs into advanced analytics solutions Deep expertise with the modern data stack (BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Airflow, GitHub, command line-based workflows) Exceptional SQL skills coupled with at least 5 years of relevant experience in data analytics or engineering roles Solid understanding of data modeling principles (e.g., Kimball methodology, star schemas) A high valuation of business context and the drive to achieve technical excellence An inclination towards collaboration and pride in contributing to high-functioning teams Enjoyment in working within fast-paced, growth-oriented environments A sense of fun at work, with extracurricular interests like Ping Pong or Mario Kart seen as a bonus! At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure! About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com . Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice . Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. title: Engineering Manager - Content Discovery
description: Wallapop is a Barcelona based scale-up driven by the purpose to empower people to embrace a more conscious and human way of consumption. We believe in a world where collaborative economy is mainstream. This is what drives us. 💫 Wallapop operates in Spain, Italy and Portugal, offering a catalogue of several hundreds of millions of products and services. Powered by technical innovation and continuous improvement, we bring together the scale & trust of classifieds with the marketplace’s convenience & reach. 🌱 Our mission is to enable a connected trade ecosystem, making 2nd-hand the norm through smart use of technology. The Challenge 🧩 We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to join the Buyer Tribe and lead a cross-functional engineering team responsible for redesigning the Home experience and building the next generation of our recommendations platform. You will guide the team through a complex technical and product transformation, including evolving the backend architecture, integrating advanced machine-learning capabilities, and supporting multiple recommendation use cases at scale. You will be responsible for keeping the roadmap healthy and delivery predictable while continuously balancing experimentation, technical quality, scalability, emerging scope, and stakeholder expectations. This includes helping the team handle pragmatic trade-offs between speed and long-term technical sustainability, and creating the clarity, focus, and operating environment needed to deliver high-quality outcomes to ensure the best user experience. What You Will Do 👇 Lead engineering for a topic team to ship high-quality software on predictable schedules Make sure that the meetings are effective Coaches people & the organization Provide vision, sense of purpose, and visibility to teams Implement process improvements Have regular one-on-ones with engineers, where you will: Set expectations, provide regular feedback & keep team members accountable (Conduct performance reviews) Develop a strong two-way feedback loop where you share organizational context and build a deep understanding of the engineer and how they work Support engineers and help reach a resolution when challenges arise Craft a fulfilling and engaging work experience through regular career growth and development conversation Iterate and improve our engineering processes and technical culture Participate in hiring and onboarding of engineers What We’re Looking For 🔎 You have experience leading engineering teams (Ideally +2 years) You have very strong verbal English communication skills (Spanish is a plus) You are comfortable with participatory management/servant leadership Positive attitude, excellent problem-solving, and critical thinking Quality-driven, attention to detail, and pragmatic Excellent communication skills, adaptability, and eagerness to learn What Would Be A Plus 🚀 Previous exposure to Tribes & Squads. Do note that all our jobs are 📍 Barcelona based. We follow a hybrid model where flexibility rules. We commit to a minimum of 6 days per month in the office. Each team self-organizes to decide on cadence and in-person/remote rituals. Wallapop is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees as we want Wallapop to be a place for everyone. We sponsor visa processes for international candidates when applicable and provide legal & admin support along the process combined with a competitive relocation package. Additionally to the opportunity to contribute to an agile product set up and work together towards achieving our meaningful mission, we offer the following 🍭 Perks & Benefits : Generous individual learning budget of 2k per year Group and individual English, Catalan & Spanish lessons as part of our working day Private Health Insurance with Alan Flexible working hours + intensive Fridays Flexible remuneration to deduct from gross salary (kindergarten/food/transport check) Gym & Wellness plan, including physiotherapist in the office Generous referral Program & Charity Donation Bonus for weddings & newborns Wallapop Renta (Tax income support) Monthly plan for free shipping, bumps & home-pick-up on our services Work anniversary Gifts and Birthday Surprises Contribution towards your WIFI in your monthly payroll One-off payment based on compensation package to go towards setting up your home office Relocation package (monetary support and legal advice) and visa sponsorship, if applicable 26 holidays per year TOP hardware of your choice (latest Apple or Windows) What does the hiring process for this position look like? **Please, note that all interviews take place remotely over hangouts.** Intro Call - run by talent acquisition, focus on providing more information about the role and the company as well as going over your experience, motivation, and expectations. This usually takes 45-60 minutes. Technical Task - you will prepare a practical case to present in order to assess the skills required for the role. Expertise Interview - run by the core team, focus on the hard skills and the ability to deliver in a given context. This usually takes 60-90 minutes. Stakeholder Interview - run by the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, focus on the ability to collaborate & deliver in a cross-functional set-up, as well as on leadership skills aligned with the role requirements. This usually takes 60 minutes. Culture Interview - run by culture interviewers, focus on adherence to Wallapop's purpose and business proposition. This usually takes 60 minutes. Offer - should you be the right candidate, your offer will be discussed over a call with talent acquisition and will then be confirmed in writing.

title: B2B Growth and Sales Ops Intern
description: ¿Por qué Cabify? ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? En Cabify eso es exactamente lo que hacemos. Nuestro objetivo es mejorar la movilidad en las ciudades, conectando a usuarios con conductores y ofreciendo alternativas de transporte al alcance de un botón. Quizás algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado. Pero aún nos queda camino por recorrer. Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer 'unicornio' tecnológico español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid, pero actualmente puedes encontrarnos en 93 ciudades de España, Portugal y Latinoamérica. Sin importar cuánto crezcamos, estamos decididos a mantener nuestro espíritu 'startup'. Somos un equipo seguro, profesional, carismático y enfocado, joven de corazón y orgulloso de hacer las cosas bien. Nos consideramos una empresa tecnológica ética e innovadora, donde todos son tratados con justicia y respeto, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que usan nuestra plataforma. Cumplimos con todas las normativas gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales. Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos a crear un entorno inclusivo para todos los empleados, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¿Te apuntas? Tu equipo Gestionamos las relaciones con nuestros clientes empresariales, desarrollando soluciones de movilidad a medida para compañías de todos los sectores. Somos el puente entre la tecnología de Cabify y las necesidades reales de las empresas, transformando la forma en que las compañías se mueven y optimizan sus operaciones. Tu misión Tu misión será sostener la operativa y el reporting de las carteras B2B España, y dar soporte a los equipos comerciales para que cada decisión se tome sobre datos al día y fiables. ¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión? Analítica y reporting — el núcleo del puesto, en torno al 60% de tu tiempo Actualizarás y publicarás el reporting recurrente de las carteras —semanal y mensual—, validando cada cifra contra su fuente antes de darla por buena. Analizarás el performance de las carteras comerciales, identificando tendencias de consumo y los gaps frente a objetivo, y explicando a qué responden. Ejecutarás y mantendrás nuestros flujos de trabajo automatizados con Claude: tareas programadas, skills y reports, detectando y corrigiendo los fallos de ejecución antes de que lleguen al equipo. Soporte operativo y comercial — el resto de tu tiempo Configurarás y mantendrás las cuentas de nuestros clientes corporativos en las herramientas internas de Cabify: creación de vouchers, configuración de productos y precios, pricing groups, journeys y permisos. Darás soporte a los equipos comerciales en sus herramientas de venta, principalmente Salesforce: mantenimiento de la información de cuentas y oportunidades, y seguimiento del pipeline. Harás el seguimiento y la ejecución de las campañas comerciales, desde el lanzamiento hasta la medición de su impacto. Resolverás la operativa transaccional del día a día del equipo: peticiones de cliente, incidencias y tareas de soporte. ¿Qué buscamos? Afinidad con nuestros principios . Estudios en curso o recién finalizados en analítica de datos, ADE, ingeniería, económicas o similar. Capacidad analítica real: manejas volúmenes de datos con soltura y eres capaz de detectar que una cifra no cuadra antes de publicarla. Dominio de Excel y Google Sheets, y manejo básico de Tableau o herramientas de BI equivalentes. Se valorará SQL. Resolutividad para aprender herramientas internas por tu cuenta: buena parte del puesto consiste en dominar nuestro admin y nuestro CRM, y no hay manual que lo cubra todo. Interés genuino por la IA aplicada al trabajo: este rol trabaja con Claude a diario y buscamos a alguien que quiera exprimirlo. Rigor y autonomía en tareas recurrentes, y criterio para levantar la mano cuando algo no encaja. ¿Qué ofrecemos? 📝 Ayuda económica. 🌍 Horario flexible y modelo de trabajo adaptado a tus necesidades. 👩🏽‍🎓 Presupuesto anual dedicado a tu formación y crecimiento profesional. 💰 Planes de retribución flexible. 🎟️ Descuentos en gimnasios, comercios y restaurantes. 🐶 Oficina pet-friendly con sala equipada para mascotas. 🍇 Fruta fresca, café de calidad y espacios diseñados para el bienestar. 🖥️ Equipo de trabajo de última generación.

title: Inside Sales Representative
description: ¡Únete a nuestro movimiento y defiende la cultura gastronómica! 💚 En TheFork creemos que las mejores cosas de la vida suceden alrededor de una mesa. Como la plataforma de reservas de restaurantes líder en Europa, conectamos a la mayor comunidad de comensales fieles con sus restaurantes favoritos en todo el mundo. Impulsados por la innovación y una profunda pasión por la industria de la restauración, creamos experiencias gastronómicas únicas en 11 países. Formamos parte del Grupo TripAdvisor y nos enorgullece construir una cultura diversa centrada en las personas, donde prosperan valores como el "respeto", la "responsabilidad" ( ownership ), el "crecimiento" y el "mejor juntos". Si te apasiona la comida, la tecnología y generar un impacto real, tu lugar en nuestra mesa está reservado. 👉 Discover life at TheFork Qué harás: Tras seleccionar los restaurantes dentro del alcance, contactarás proactivamente por teléfono con sus propietarios o gerentes. Tu actividad diaria consistirá en realizar llamadas en frío (cold-calling) y llamadas de seguimiento para presentar los productos y servicios de TheFork. Te encargarás de proponer y vender el ecosistema de TheFork, que incluye: promociones, herramientas de software avanzado, widgets de reserva para la web del restaurante, y soluciones de formación y marketing. Interactuarás con los gerentes de los restaurantes para ayudarles a comprender las oportunidades, funciones y beneficios de la herramienta TheFork Manager y de toda nuestra red. Realizarás el seguimiento de los clientes potenciales con los que contactes hasta cerrar el acuerdo y lograr que el restaurante se publique con éxito en TheFork y sus sitios web afiliados. Quién eres: Nivel C2 de español + nivel medio de inglés. Una persona proactiva y orientada a resultados, a quien le apasione alcanzar y superar objetivos. Alguien orientado al cliente, con una mentalidad comercial sólida, capacidad de influencia y aptitudes para convencer y generar compromiso. Un profesional de alto rendimiento con experiencia demostrada en desarrollo de negocio, preferiblemente en entornos B2B y en el sector de restauración/hostelería, habituado a gestionar negociaciones a corto plazo. Una persona dinámica, acostumbrada a trabajar de forma independiente en entornos de ritmo rápido y con excelentes dotes organizativas. title: Business Unit Director - Strategic Fleets
description: ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas? Para impulsar esta transformación buscamos a quien lidere nuestra nueva vertical , la persona que dirigirá el ecosistema de flotas externas en España como si fuera su propio negocio dentro de Cabify. Gestionará una cuenta de resultados que buscamos supere los 500 M€ de ingresos anuales en los próximos dos años. Dado el carácter estratégico de esta posición, interactuará de forma regular con el CEO de la compañía y reportará directamente al responsable de las operaciones europeas, actuando como su mano derecha en esta unidad. Tendrá autonomía real de decisión sobre estrategia, estructura y resultado. Nuestra ambición no es únicamente contribuir al desarrollo y optimización de flotas colaboradoras, sino construir el ecosistema operativo y tecnológico de referencia para operadores de movilidad en España. ¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión? Transformación de Equipo: Construir, mentorizar y escalar un equipo híbrido (comercial y de operaciones), evolucionando su rol de "gestores transaccionales" a verdaderos aliados de negocio para nuestros partners. Levantar una red de partners estratégicos: identificar, negociar y consolidar relaciones de largo plazo con operadores de flotas de alto potencial en todo el territorio, elevando el estándar de la industria. Transformar el modelo de relación: convertir a los operadores de flotas de proveedores transaccionales en socios estratégicos del marketplace, con incentivos y acuerdos pensados a largo plazo. I mpulsar la modernización del negocio: apoyarte en tus referentes de operación y comercial para identificar oportunidades de mejora, y liderar la adopción de tecnología y automatización que hagan de Cabify el partner más ágil del mercado. Lo que estamos buscando: Experiencia dirigiendo negocio, no solo operándolo: +7 años liderando una unidad de negocio, país, franquicia o P&L propio, con responsabilidad real sobre resultado, no solo sobre ejecución. Capacidad de construir desde cero: track record montando estructura, equipo y procesos en etapas tempranas de un negocio o unidad. Habilidad para levantar redes complejas: experiencia generando y sosteniendo relaciones estratégicas de alto nivel con múltiples partners o stakeholders externos. Visión financiera de negocio: capacidad de leer una cuenta de resultados y traducirla en decisiones y palancas concretas de rentabilidad. Liderazgo de perfiles senior: experiencia dirigiendo y potenciando a especialistas o líderes funcionales, delegando ejecución y enfocándote en dirección estratégica. Gestión de stakeholders de alto nivel: excelencia en negociación e influencia, tanto interna como externa. Ambición de crecimiento: mentalidad orientada a escalar el negocio de forma agresiva pero sostenible, apoyándote en tecnología, automatización e IA como palancas para crecer sin perder eficiencia. Valorable experiencia previa en movilidad, transporte o logística; formación o trayectoria en compañías o consultoras de primer nivel es un plus que refuerza el criterio de rigor, no un filtro excluyente. 👀 Por qué Cabify es tu mejor opción 📝 Contrato indefinido desde el primer día. 🌍 Flexibilidad horaria: margen flexible en la hora de entrada y salida para que te organices a tu ritmo. 💸 Crédito mensual en la App Cabify. 👩🏽‍🎓 Presupuesto anual para formación y programas de desarrollo personal. 💰 Planes de retribución flexible en tickets restaurant, transporte, seguro médico y guarderías. 🎟️ Descuentos en diferentes restaurantes, tiendas y gimnasios. 🐶 Oficina pet-friendly (con sala de mascotas para que no dejes a tu peludo amigo en casa). 🖥️ Equipo de trabajo completo (tú solo tienes que poner tu talento). 🍇 Excelente ambiente de trabajo: espacios con fruta fresca, café gratis y eventos divertidos con todo el equipo. Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con crear un entorno inclusivo para todas las personas, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¡Únete a nosotros!

title: Central Operations Lead
description: Location: Come and join us in Barcelona! At Freenow, we shape the future of urban mobility, empowering people to move freely and helping cities thrive through smarter, sustainable choices. We are looking for a dynamic Supply Operations Lead to supercharge our central supply operations, with a razor-sharp focus on Funnel Management (Driver Acquisition & Retention) and elevating the overall Driver Experience (Engagement, Education, & Communication). In this high-impact role, you will ensure central programs are executed with absolute excellence across regions. You will champion the voice of our markets by channeling structured local feedback into global program designs, bridging local needs with scalable operational mastery to deliver world-class experiences across our diverse European footprint. YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE: Ownership of Supply related KPIs such as Active and New drivers, Retention, NPS and Supply volume Act as the key interface between central and local teams, cascading priorities and frameworks while providing structured feedback on market insights, regulatory risks, and operational constraints to influence global program design, and scaling best practices across markets Translate global strategies into clear regional plans, operating procedures, defining ownership, timelines, success metrics, and governance structures to ensure consistent execution across all markets. Analyse driver retention performance, align stakeholders on key initiatives, and drive continuous improvement across teams Supporting markets and Marketplace teams with engagement and acquisition initiatives to steer supply levels towards targets Support in building and improving end-to-end communication strategies across different channels tailored specifically for our drivers and maximising retention and engagement, in collaboration with local ops, marketing and other central teams Optimising the Driver NPS and other satisfaction metrics, by translating insights into clear actions that enhance the early driver experience, in collaboration with different stakeholders from Product, Marketing, and operations across markets Defining and improving driver training based on needs and observed trends in collaboration with Marketing, Quality of Service, and Product Identifying opportunities to improve the product experience for new drivers and provide prioritised, data-backed recommendations to product teams. Designing, testing, and scaling proactive support initiatives to help new drivers succeed from day one, across their onboarding journey TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE 6 years of experience in operations management, strategy consulting, or business operations, preferably in marketplace or mobility, inc previous experience in leading people Proven track record of scaling operations across multiple markets or business units, ideally within European contexts Experience with process design, optimization, and cross-functional project management Background in data analysis and using metrics to drive operational decisions Fluent in English + Additional European languages (German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Spanish) are a plus but not mandatory BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL: Flexible working arrangements LinkedIn Learning Sabbatical & special leave policies WeRoad partnership Birthday, 24th + 31st December off Short term EU work policy Mobility Credit Health Insurance Employee assistance program Plus more local benefits depending on your work location! DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION: Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age. We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work . ABOUT FREENOW: Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

title: Independent Board Director (Performance AdTech)
description: Appodeal is a dynamic US-based product company with a truly global presence. We have offices in Warsaw, Barcelona and Parkland (FL), along with remote team members located around the world. Our company thrives on diversity, collaboration, and innovation, making us a leader in the mobile app monetization space. Why Appodeal? At Appodeal, we’re more than just a company—we’re a team united by a common mission: Help people discover and grow their talents through products that enable successful mobile app businesses! We take pride in our cutting-edge product and our internationally dispersed team of talented professionals. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Continuous Learning and Growth: We are passionate about learning, growing personally, and building rewarding careers. Making an Impact: We are committed to building a history-defining company that leaves a lasting impact on the mobile app industry. Solving Exciting Challenges: We tackle complex problems every day, supported by a team of world-class professionals and mentors. Enjoying the Journey: We believe in having fun while working toward our goals. We are seeking an Independent Board Director with deep e xperience in performance-based advertising technology, particularly DSP platforms driven by machine learning and optimization algorithms. This individual should bring operator-level experience from leading performance advertising platforms and be able to contribute meaningfully to discussions around: DSP product strategy; machine learning driven ad optimization; advertiser acquisition and growth; competitive positioning in performance advertising; This is a non-executive board position, not an operating role. Appodeal is building a performance-based DSP and advertising infrastructure platform powered by machine learning. Our long-term objective is t o build a global performance advertising platform that enables advertisers to acquire users and customers efficiently through data-driven optimization and ML-based bidding systems. Appodeal operates a broader ecosystem that includes: advertising infrastructure; demand-side platform (DSP); supply-side platform (SSP); mobile game publishing and development. The company is profitable, growing, and operates globally across the United States and Europe. Strategic Focus of the Role The primary mission of this board role is to strengthen Appodeal’s ability to build a world-class ML-driven performance DSP. The director will contribute a perspective on: performance advertising market dynamics; DSP platform strategy; advertiser growth and retention; machine learning driven optimization; industry partnerships; competitive landscape. In addition to strategic insight, the company is looking for a director who is well-connected in the performance advertising ecosystem and can help the company stay closely aligned with industry developments. Responsibilities Board members are expected to: Participate in quarterly board meetings; Provide independent strategic guidance to the CEO and leadership team; Contribute to discussions around product strategy, partnerships, and market positioning; Help evaluate major strategic initiatives; Provide perspective on industry trends and competitive threats; Support the company through relevant industry connections and relationships; Board members do not participate in day-to-day operations. Ideal Background We are looking for a senior operator with leadership experience in performance advertising platforms or performance marketing infrastructure. What We Value We are looking for individuals who bring: deep expertise in performance advertising platforms; strong industry network and relationships; high strategic judgment; an independent mindset; willingness to challenge assumptions constructively; long-term thinking aligned with building durable technology platforms. Time Commitment Estimated commitment: approximately four weeks per year. This includes preparation and participation in board meetings, as well as occasional strategic discussions with the leadership team. With an outstanding product and a mission that excites and inspires, Appodeal offers a unique opportunity to make an impact while being part of an amazing team. Join us and help shape the future of mobile app success!
