title: Head of Engineering - Developer Experience & Platform (f/m/d)
location: Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands; Berlin, Berlin, Germany; Iași, Iași, Romania; London, England, United Kingdom; Madrid, Madrid, Spain; Milano, Milan, Italy; München, Bavaria, Germany; Warsaw, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Head of Engineering - Developer Experience & Platform Awin is seeking an exceptional engineering leader to shape the future of how our engineers build, ship, and operate software at scale. As Head of Engineering – Developer Experience & Platform, you will own the end-to-end developer experience strategy, drive the adoption of AI-native engineering practices, modernise our cloud platform, and lead the teams and tooling that enable Awin's engineering organisation to work at its best. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence, platform strategy, and AI innovation. You will define and deliver the developer experience (DevEx) vision for Awin, ensuring our engineers have the tools, environments, processes, and culture to be highly productive and deeply satisfied in their work. You will own our platform strategy on AWS, lead FinOps practices, and spearhead the organisation-wide rollout of AI-augmented and agentic development workflows. You will act as a trusted internal champion for engineers – gathering data-driven insight, translating it into organisation-wide improvements, and working hand-in-hand with engineering leadership, product, and stakeholders to make change happen and allow our Product teams to deliver value to our customers at scale. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience with modern AI-driven software development and building developer-centric cloud platforms at scale. This is a senior but hands-on role within the Engineering organisation, reporting to the Director of Engineering. Key Tasks & Responsibilities Developer Experience Strategy & Tooling Own and evolve Awin's Developer Experience programme – defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for DevEx improvement across the engineering organisation Identify friction points, productivity blockers, and systemic inefficiencies through data, qualitative research, and direct engagement with engineering teams, other Heads of Engineering or Engineering Managers Drive organisation-wide improvements to technology, tooling, and engineering processes, building consensus and alignment with key stakeholders across product, engineering, security, and operations. Establish and track DevEx metrics and KPIs (e.g. DORA metrics, developer satisfaction scores), using them to demonstrate impact and guide investment decisions. Own the developer tools portfolio and associated budgets – evaluating, procuring, and retiring tools to ensure engineers have best-in-class tooling without unnecessary cost or complexity. Lead strategic assessment and rollout of new developer tooling, including CI/CD platforms, IDE capabilities, code quality and security tools. AI-Native Development & Agentic Workflows Lead Awin's AI engineering rollout – defining the strategy for AI-native software development, establishing standards, and scaling adoption across the engineering organisation. Evaluate and implement AI-augmented development tools including AI coding assistants, agentic development environments, automated code review, test generation, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines. Champion modern AI-native software development best practices and drive continuous evaluation of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape. Design and deliver enablement programmes – training, communities of practice, documentation, and hands-on workshops – to accelerate AI fluency and confidence across engineering teams. Measure and report on the impact of AI adoption on developer productivity, code quality, and time-to-market. Cloud Platform Optimisation Lead the strategy and execution of cloud platform standardisation across Awin's AWS estate, establishing golden paths, reference architectures, and platform abstractions that improve developer experience and reduce cognitive load. Drive cloud migration efforts, infrastructure modernisation initiatives, partnering with Product teams to improve reliability, scalability, observability, and security posture (including platform-wide Incident Management, SRE Own AWS cost management and FinOps practices – establishing budgeting frameworks, implementing cost allocation and tagging strategies, identifying and acting on optimisation opportunities, and providing transparent reporting to leadership. Build out internal developer platform capabilities to abstract cloud complexity and accelerate developer self-service. Ensure cloud platform decisions are made with developer experience as a primary consideration alongside cost efficiency, security, and scalability. Leadership & Organisational Impact Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team spanning developer experience, platform engineering, and tooling functions. Act as a collaborative, influential engineering leader, shaping Awin's technical culture, engineering standards, and ways of working. Contribute to the engineering leadership team, participating in strategic planning, headcount discussions, and broader organisational design. Skills & Experience Significant experience in and passion for software engineering, with hands-on coding background in one or more major languages (e.g. Java, TypeScript). Strong understanding of AI-native software development – including AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), agentic development workflows, and LLM-integrated toolchains. Proven leadership experience in developer experience, platform engineering, developer productivity, or a related engineering leadership role within a mid-to-large scale technology organisation. Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, engineering best practices, and what makes engineering teams highly productive. Demonstrable experience leading and improving CI/CD practices, deployment pipelines, and developer tooling ecosystems. Strong background in AWS – comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), container platforms, serverless patterns, and cloud-native architectures. Experience with FinOps or cloud cost management, including budgeting, tagging strategies, and cost optimisation at scale. Track record of successfully delivering organisation-wide change programmes in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders. Experience designing and using developer experience metrics frameworks (e.g. DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) to measure and improve developer productivity. Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams in a fast-paced, distributed environment. Strong commercial awareness – experience managing budgets, building business cases, and making tool and investment decisions with clear ROI thinking. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery; comfortable operating from vision through to execution. Experience working in global, distributed engineering organisations across multiple time zones and cultures. Our Offer Flexi-Week : We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance. Flexi-office : We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility. Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture : You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home. Health and Wellbeing : With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing. Development : We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development. Appreciation : Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme. We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview. Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture. Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities. Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know. Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/ en / , and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development. #LI-RS1

title: Lead In‑House Legal Counsel
description: BidMachine Exchange – a fast-growing global programmatic exchange built for the future of in-app advertising. BidMachine operates with a strong US foundation and an international presence, with teams across Warsaw, Barcelona, Parkland (FL), and remote experts around the world. We combine deep AdTech expertise, proprietary technology, and a data-driven mindset to deliver transparency, performance, and efficiency in the mobile advertising ecosystem. Why BidMachine? At BidMachine, we are building more than an exchange — we are shaping the infrastructure that powers fair, efficient, and scalable in-app programmatic advertising. Our mission is to create a high-performance marketplace where publishers maximize value and advertisers access premium inventory with full transparency and control. We are proud of our technology, our ambitious vision, and our globally distributed team of talented professionals who continuously raise the bar in AdTech. Here’s what we value, and what we hope you do too: Ownership & Accountability We move fast, take responsibility, and think like builders. Every team member has a direct impact on product growth and market success. Data-Informed Excellence We leverage data to make smarter decisions, optimize performance, and build scalable solutions that deliver measurable results. Innovation & Technical Depth We solve complex programmatic challenges with cutting-edge technology and a deep understanding of the ecosystem. Global Collaboration We work across cultures, time zones, and disciplines — united by shared goals and high standards. Ambition & Impact We are here to build something significant — a best-in-class exchange that competes with the strongest players in the market. Position Overview We are seeking an experienced and business-oriented Lead In‑House Legal Counsel to support a fast-growing advertising technology company operating at the intersection of digital advertising, data privacy, AI, and global monetization. This role will serve as a strategic legal partner across commercial, product, privacy, data governance, and regulatory matters, with a strong emphasis on adtech ecosystem compliance and IAB frameworks. The ideal candidate has deep experience supporting adtech, martech, programmatic advertising, mobile advertising, DSP/SSP, attribution, or data platform businesses and is highly fluent in global privacy regulations, data processing structures, and digital advertising industry standards. This position partners closely with Product, Engineering, Revenue Operations, Security, Privacy, Finance, and Executive Leadership. Key Responsibilities Commercial & Revenue Support Lead negotiation, drafting, and review of complex commercial agreements, including: Publisher agreements Advertiser and agency agreements DSP/SSP/platform agreements Data licensing agreements Vendor and cloud services agreements Enterprise MSAs and DPAs Advise internal stakeholders on commercial risk, revenue impact, and scalable contracting strategies. Develop standardized contract templates, fallback positions, and negotiation playbooks. Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to accelerate deal cycles while appropriately managing legal and compliance risk. Privacy, Data Governance & AdTech Compliance Serve as lead legal advisor for global privacy and data governance matters impacting advertising technology operations. Advise on compliance with: GDPR UK GDPR CCPA/CPRA VCDPA and other U.S. state privacy laws ePrivacy and cookie consent requirements COPPA and children’s advertising considerations Cross-border data transfer requirements Provide legal guidance on: Programmatic advertising Mobile advertising identifiers Attribution technologies Consent management frameworks AI and machine learning use cases involving advertising data Support implementation and governance of privacy-by-design and data minimization principles. Review and advise on data retention, data sharing, and data processing practices. Coordinate with Security and Engineering teams on incident response and data governance initiatives. Advise on and maintain internal GDPR compliance for HR and employment data, including employee and candidate privacy notices, RoPA entries, and data subject request handling. Oversee DPAs with HR system vendors (HRIS, payroll, recruitment tools), cross-border transfer mechanisms for employee data, and data processing considerations in performance management and AI-assisted HR tools. IAB & Industry Standards Advise on compliance with relevant IAB and advertising ecosystem standards, including: IAB Europe Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF) IAB Global Privacy Platform (GPP) IAB Tech Lab specifications Programmatic advertising supply chain standards Monitor developments in digital advertising regulation and industry self-regulatory frameworks. Support internal implementation of evolving industry requirements related to consent signaling, transparency, identity frameworks, and data usage disclosures. Serve as internal subject matter expert on advertising ecosystem legal and compliance obligations. Product & Regulatory Counseling Partner with Product and Engineering teams during product development and launches. Provide practical, risk-balanced legal advice regarding: New ad products AI-enabled advertising tools Measurement and analytics solutions Conduct legal risk assessments related to evolving privacy, consumer protection, and advertising regulations. Help develop internal governance processes for data usage, AI governance, and advertising compliance. Corporate & Operational Support Support corporate governance, policy development, and internal compliance initiatives. Assist with dispute management, pre-litigation matters, and regulatory inquiries. Manage outside counsel efficiently and cost-effectively. Develop and deliver internal legal and privacy training programs. Help build scalable legal operations processes and contract management practices. Develop the company’s contract management workflow in Aline by transitioning all contract-related communication, review, negotiation, approval, and execution processes into a centralized platform environment. Qualifications Required Experience J.D. degree from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar or admitted to practice in at least one EU jurisdiction . 8+ years of legal experience, including substantial in-house experience supporting technology or adtech companies. Deep familiarity with digital advertising ecosystems, including: Programmatic advertising Mobile advertising Identity and attribution frameworks Data licensing and monetization Strong working knowledge of global privacy and data protection laws. Experience negotiating sophisticated commercial and technology agreements. Demonstrated experience advising on IAB frameworks and adtech industry standards. Ability to balance legal risk with business objectives in a fast-paced commercial environment. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience at an adtech, martech, mobile gaming, media, data platform, or AI-driven advertising company. Experience supporting international operations and cross-border data transfers. Familiarity with: AI governance Data security frameworks Consumer protection and advertising regulations Platform ecosystem issues (Google, Apple, Android, ATT, SDK integrations) Experience supporting M&A, strategic partnerships, or international commercial expansion. CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or similar privacy certifications preferred. With a powerful product, strong market positioning, and a team that strives for excellence, BidMachine offers a unique opportunity to grow, innovate, and make a tangible impact in the programmatic advertising space. Build the future of mobile AdTech with us!

title: Account Executive,  Business Intelligence - based in Spain (German speaker)
description: Our Mission: Why Lighthouse? At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue. With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act. Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light We are Lumineers . Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment Pursuit of greatness : We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail Meaningful work matters : We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward Elevate each other : We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship? 🚀 Job details ● 💼 Revenue Team ● 📍 Spain - Barcelona (open to any location in Spain) ● 🕜 Full-Time/Hybrid | Full-Time Remote ● 🌐 Fluent in English and German What you will do You’ll be the face of Lighthouse’s Business Intelligence (BI) solutions for prospective clients, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close. This is a hunter role: you carry a quota, you build your own pipeline, and you’re accountable to outcomes and success. No excuses, just results. You'll primarily work with Revenue Managers , Commercial Directors, General Managers and C-level stakeholders within hotel groups and chains, helping them optimize their commercial performance through Lighthouse's Business Intelligence platform. In hotel commercial operations, Business Intelligence software plays a critical role by offering real-time data, forecasts, and reporting that help hoteliers measure performance, optimize pricing, allocate inventory, predict demand, and identify growth opportunities. You will sell the solution that empowers hoteliers to make data-driven decisions regarding their commercial strategy, with the ultimate aim of maximizing revenue. Overall, this technology enhances decision-making, reduces reliance on guesswork, and helps hotels stay competitive in a rapidly changing market. What makes this different: You won’t do it alone. Lighthouse is deploying an agent AI infrastructure — Enablement, Pre-Sales, and Coaching agents — alongside a modern revenue stack. AI handles the prep, the sequencing, and the pattern recognition so you can focus on what matters: building relationships, running sharp discovery, and demonstrating the value of our BI platform. We work with MEDDPICC to support high-quality deal execution. You’ll advance deals with evidence, protect pricing on value, and forecast with precision. We want to help you use modern tools to become a better seller and achieve great success. Where you will have impact Own your territory and your number. Build and execute a strategic territory plan to generate a net-new pipeline. Maintain 3x pipeline coverage, forecast honestly, and take full accountability for your results. Your quota is your commitment. Hunt and build a pipeline. Source a meaningful share of your own pipeline through outbound sequences, ICP targeting, Lighthouse Connect events, and industry conferences. This is not an SDR-reliant role. Run a disciplined sales process. Using MEDDPICC to qualify and advance opportunities. Use the AI Pre-Sales Agent to identify gaps before every major call. Advance deals through stage gates with evidence, not optimism. Leverage AI to make your days easier and focus on more selling time. Use AI as a force multiplier. Leverage the Enablement Agent for call prep, discovery frameworks, and positioning. Use the Coaching Agent to surface patterns in your pipeline and win rate. Push back on the tools when they’re wrong — help make the system smarter. Leverage your existing hospitality knowledge to have consultative conversations around Revenue Management, commercial strategy and hotel performance. Position Lighthouse as a strategic partner rather than simply another software provider. Drive results beyond net-new. Consistently meet and exceed sales targets through new business and by identifying expansion and upgrade opportunities within your accounts. Partner with Product to share market feedback and influence the roadmap. Represent Lighthouse at industry events to build the brand and your network. About our team You’ll join a global Revenue team of 150+ sales professionals across 24 countries. The BI team focuses on a core area of our product suite — a supportive, driven group with real opportunities for career growth and the chance to learn from experienced leaders. What's in it for you? Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices. Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance. Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery. Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery. Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription. Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents. Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues. Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential. Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide. Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work. Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent. Who you are 2+ years of successful B2B closing experience selling Hospitality Technology or complex SaaS solutions . Experience within the hospitality industry is required . Exceptional command of the English language and fluency in German . Self-directed, coachable, and driven to continuously improve. You seek feedback on your calls, your pipeline, and your positioning — and act on it within the next deal, not the next quarter. You treat AI tools as a core part of your selling motion, not a novelty. You adopt new tooling quickly and bend it to your style. You work with MEDDPICC to support high-quality deal execution. You’ll advance deals with evidence, protect pricing on value, and forecast with precision. You use modern tools to become a better seller and achieve great success. Strong business acumen with the ability to sell on value, not price. Confident engaging stakeholders from GMs to C-suite. You want to win. You prospect when it would be easier not to. You follow up one more time. You’re not okay with a bad quarter. Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter. Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you! title: SEO/GEO Manager
description: About the opportunity As the SEO & GEO Manager at N26, you will be responsible for driving organic user acquisition across all digital channels and emerging AI search engines (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). You will blend technical SEO rigor, data analytics, high-authority content strategy, and semantic optimization to ensure N26 remains the primary mobile banking recommendation across traditional search engines and AI discovery platforms. You will sit at the intersection of Marketing, Data, Product, and Content, scaling our organic footprint across multiple European markets while building N26’s pioneer strategy in AI search visibility. In this role, you will: Traditional & Technical SEO Search Strategy: Define, execute, and scale the multi-market organic search roadmap across key N26 operating markets (Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Austria, and pan-Europe). Technical SEO Leadership: Partner with Product and Web Engineering teams to maintain flawless technical site health, addressing site speed, crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals, dynamic rendering, and international multi-language architecture (hreflang). High-Intent Content Strategy: Collaborate with the Product Marketing and Brand teams to build and optimize localized, compliant fintech content targeting high-intent, converting keywords. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AI Visibility AI Search Strategy: Develop N26’s framework for GEO, optimizing web presence to maximize brand recommendation, inclusion, and positive sentiment in AI-generated answers (e.g., ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Knowledge Graph & Entity Management: Optimize structured data (Schema.org), digital entity relationships, and authoritative external references to establish N26 as the definitive financial authority for LLMs. Citation & Share of Voice Monitoring: Establish benchmarks, tracking metrics, and custom tools to measure N26’s share of AI voice (SoAIV) and recommendation rates against competitors in conversational search. Analytics, Testing & Reporting Performance Tracking: Deliver standard organic acquisition dashboards tracking organic traffic, sign-ups, and keyword/entity rankings. Testing & Experimentation: Run continuous A/B and multivariate tests on title tags, semantic markup, content structuring, and internal linking to drive conversion rate optimization (CRO) and crawl efficiency. Market Insights: Monitor algorithm updates, AI model updates, and regulatory shifts to proactively adapt our growth tactics. What you need to be successful: Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in SEO within high-growth tech companies, fintechs, or large-scale consumer digital products across multi-language markets. GEO & AI Search Mastery: Proven understanding of how Large Language Models (LLMs) ingest, index, and cite web sources, alongside practical experience optimizing content for AI platforms. Technical Proficiency: Strong command of HTML/CSS, technical SEO auditing tools (Screaming Frog, Log analysis, etc.), dynamic rendering, and structured data implementation. Data Fluency: Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Ahrefs, Semrush, and SQL/Python/R (a plus for large dataset analysis and API integrations). Language: Fluent written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian is a strong advantage. Nice-to-Haves Experience working with programmatic SEO and automated content workflows. Familiarity with vector databases, semantic search embeddings, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) concepts. Experience in App Store Optimization (ASO) for iOS and Android. What’s in it for you: Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀. Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service. A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds. A relocation package with visa support for those who need it. Who we are N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities. Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles! Equal opportunities for all At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you! Discover more about Diversity & Inclusion at N26: https://n26.com/en-eu/diversity-and-inclusion

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: Scopely is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team in Barcelona on a Hybrid basis At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day – whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. The Marketing team deeply understands a game’s audience, creative strategy and priorities. They are the glue between the Brand, Product, and our Player Communities that will redefine our social strategy to amplify our games across new and existing social channels while building a meaningful community for our players. What You Will Do: Manage and optimize large-scale User Acquisition budgets to drive profitable growth Execute and scale mobile campaigns across key platforms including Meta, Google, and emerging channels Design and run A/B, multivariate, and marketability tests from hypothesis to analysis to improve performance and unlock growth opportunities Analyze campaign, funnel, retention, and LTV metrics to drive data-informed optimization strategies Partner cross-functionally with Product, Creative, Data, and Marketing teams to improve full-funnel performance Identify and scale strategic acquisition partnerships and new growth opportunities globally Contribute creative insights and testing strategies to improve ad performance and acquisition efficiency Stay current on market trends, platform changes, and best practices in mobile performance marketing What You Will Need: 3+ years of experience in User Acquisition, performance marketing, or media buying, preferably in mobile gaming or mobile apps Proven track record of scaling growth through paid acquisition channels and identifying high-impact opportunities Strong understanding of UA KPIs including CPI, ROAS, retention, conversion funnels, and LTV optimization Hands-on experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, and AppLovin; DSP, ad networks, and rewarded advertising experience is a plus Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions in fast-paced environments Strong communication, stakeholder management, and ownership mindset Advanced Excel skills, AI tools, and data visualization platforms (e.g., Looker) are a plus Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Creative, Data, and Marketing teams BA/BS degree in Economics, Mathematics, Marketing, Finance, Business, or a related field Passion for mobile advertising, experimentation, and continuous optimization About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . title: Senior Performance Marketing Specialist
description: Who we are We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing. Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go! Your mission As the Manager, Growth Analytics at Bitpanda, you will build the core decision engine for our redesigned Growth organization. Your mandate is to establish trusted measurement, define clear customer economics, and deliver the high-impact analysis that dictates where the company invests. With direct access to decision-makers, you will build an analytics capability that materially shapes our customer acquisition, retention, and commercial outcomes. What you'll do Set the Growth measurement strategy and operating model, establishing trusted, company-wide definitions for CAC, payback, LTV, cohort performance, and incrementality. Lead forecasting, performance reviews, and decision-grade analysis to drive faster, more reliable, and economically grounded capital-allocation choices. Build and mentor a high-performing team of analytics engineers and senior analysts. Partner closely with Finance, Data, Product, and channel leaders to establish source-of-truth reporting and automate critical data workflows. Elevate the quality of our experimentation and make insights widely accessible across the organization without compromising on strict analytical standards. Who you are You have a proven track record of building or leading an analytics capability that goes beyond basic reporting to actively change commercial and product decisions. You are technically credible in SQL, data modeling, experimentation, and measurement, with the confidence and expertise to challenge weak analysis. You possess a deep understanding of acquisition economics, cohorts, incrementality, and forecasting to set the gold standard for the company. You excel at creating clarity from fragmented data, prioritizing the few specific models and metrics that materially improve business outcomes. You are a strong cross-functional leader capable of guiding analysts while fostering tight partnerships with Data, Finance, Product, and channel owners. What’s in it for you Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice. Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan. Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP. Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months. Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace. location: ES - Barcelona, Spain; GB - London, United Kingdom
description: Scopely is looking for a Creative Marketing Manager to join an unannounced title. This role can be based remotely in the UK or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. We are in the development stages on one of our new unannounced projects. Looking for passionate game makers to collaborate, get in early and make their mark on this exciting venture! What You Will Do You will be responsible for developing eye-catching and engaging marketing materials and ensure the brand identity is clear and distinctive, and that all marketing art and brand identity elements are consistent and reflect the creative game vision. Create and adapt marketing creatives for game launches and live operations, including static, video, and social media assets . Support the end-to-end creative production process, from brief intake and asset planning to stakeholder alignment, feedback management, and final delivery. Coordinate with game teams, external vendors, agencies, and internal stakeholders to ensure assets are delivered on time and at a high quality standard. Develop quick concepts, mockups, and visual references to support creative ideation and production needs. Monitor top-performing games, competitors, and creative trends across global markets, identifying insights and best practices that can inform future creative strategies. Continuously improve creative workflows, production efficiency, and asset quality through data, feedback, and process optimization. What We're Looking For 3-5 years of experience as a Creative Marketing role, ideally gained within the games industry or related creative field, agency experience a strong plus Strong visual design fundamentals, including composition, color, typography, layout, motion, and visual storytelling. Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects, with the ability to create both static and video marketing assets. Strong understanding of brand communication, marketing creatives, and current visual trends within the gaming industry. Passionate about gaming and actively follows creative trends across global markets, especially Western games; familiarity with Japanese, Korean, and other Asian gaming markets is a plus. Excellent project management and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and feedback cycles simultaneously. Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple deadlines. Able to work effectively in an English-speaking environment. Bonus Points Degree in Design or equivalent training in graphic art and graphic design desirable Experience creating creatives for top-performing or large-DAU mobile games is a strong plus. Please include a portfolio or PDF/links to examples of your work in the application. Please ensure that the resume/CV you attached is written in English. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . title: Product Manager Intern
description: Who we are: Let's have fun shaping your future! We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them! About the Role Spend more time playing collection/simulation/RPG games than sleeping? If you obsessively check leaderboards, have opinions about gacha mechanics, and get genuinely excited by a well-timed live event - we want to talk. Join the Dragon City team as a Product Manager Intern and turn your love for games into real player insights and product impact. You'll work side by side with experienced PMs, learning how to analyse game performance, track market trends, and help shape the future of one of the world's most iconic dragon-collecting games. From digging into live-ops data to benchmarking the competition, this is your chance to see how a top free-to-play title is built, measured, and grown from the inside out. What You'll Do As a Product Manager Intern, you'll be right in the action, working alongside experienced PMs to: Benchmark competitor collection, social and RPG games to identify trends and surface new feature ideas. Gather player feedback through community research, surveys, and in-game data to improve the player experience. Assist with feature and content launches: testing, monitoring, and documenting learnings. Dive into game metrics - retention, monetisation, engagement, and turn data into actionable insights. Support live-ops planning, dragon event scheduling, and cross-team coordination. What We're Looking For You're a current student (Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Game Design, UX… or similar). You're passionate about collection, social, RPG mobile games - Dragon City experience is a big plus. You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets. You're curious, proactive, and eager to learn about product analytics, game economy, and live-ops. You're an excellent communicator in English (Spanish is a plus). Bonus points if you've participated in game jams, personal projects, or uni assignments related to gaming or app design. What’s in it for You as a Socialpointer Hybrid working model – join our Barcelona office and enjoy amazing benefits: Free breakfast and lunch at the office. State-of-the-art gym facilities so you can level up your fitness game. Book an appointment with our onsite physiotherapist. Drop by our onsite hairdressers for a trim (and forget your wallet). Hands-on learning from senior Product Managers. Private medical insurance to keep your health bar full. English and Spanish lessons to grow your skills. Spotify Premium. Legendary events and parties that make working here even more fun. Intrigued? We’d love to hear from you. Please click “apply” to level up and submit your application in English. Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza. Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa. Tu Rol y Contribución Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Media Management & Delivery buscamos un/a SEO Consultant que se incorpore para participar activamente en la gestión y ejecución de proyectos SEO, aportando en el análisis, la optimización constante y la comunicación con nuestros clientes. En este rol, tendrás la oportunidad de: Analizar el rendimiento de las estrategias SEO para detectar desviaciones, puntos de mejora y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento. Participar en la relación con clientes, apoyando en la comunicación fluida del día a día, la presentación de avances y el reporte de resultados. Crear informes periódicos, detallando la evolución del tráfico, palabras clave y métricas clave de cada proyecto. Colaborar en la elaboración de auditorías y propuestas estratégicas para nuevos clientes o expansiones de servicio. Ejecutar estrategias SEO On-Page, SEO Técnico y Contenidos (investigación de palabras clave, arquitectura web, indexación, etc.). Proponer mejoras e implementar nuevas herramientas que contribuyan a optimizar los procesos internos y el flujo de trabajo del equipo. Aprender y desarrollarte junto a perfiles más senior, adquiriendo mejores prácticas y visión estratégica avanzada. Enriquecer tus conocimientos en otras áreas del marketing digital al trabajar en proyectos integrados junto a otros departamentos (Data, Paid Media, Content, etc.). Lo que buscamos en ti 2 años de experiencia ejecutando proyectos SEO (en agencia o cliente final). Conocimientos sólidos en las distintas ramas del SEO (SEO Técnico, On-Page, Contenidos y Off-Page). Experiencia demostrable en análisis de datos y elaboración de informes con recomendaciones accionables. Experiencia o soltura en la comunicación directa con clientes. Manejo habitual de herramientas SEO clave como Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Screaming Frog, Looker Studio, Semrush, Ahrefs, etc. Curiosidad y seguimiento continuo de las últimas tendencias del mercado en SEO y marketing digital. Formación académica: Grado en Marketing, Comunicación, ADE o similar. Se valorará formación específica en SEO o Marketing Digital. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Además de un entorno de trabajo dinámico y desafiante, en WPP Media nos preocupamos por tu bienestar y equilibrio. Por ello, ofrecemos un paquete de beneficios pensado para ti: Flexibilidad para tu día a día: Disfruta de un modelo híbrido de teletrabajo en Madrid, complementado con flexibilidad horaria en la entrada y salida. Bienestar y ventajas: Accede a un plan de Retribución Flexible que se adapta a tus necesidades, subvención del menú diario y café y fruta en la oficina. Cuidado personal: Fomentamos tu salud y bienestar con clases de Yoga/Pilates y la posibilidad de sesiones de fisioterapia. Próximos Pasos Si te identificas con esta oportunidad y quieres formar parte de WPP Media, ¡nos encantaría conocerte! Envíanos tu candidatura y, si tu perfil encaja con lo que buscamos, nos pondremos en contacto contigo. Para cualquier duda, puedes contactar con nosotros en talentacquisition.spain@wppmedia.com . title: Performance Marketing Director
description: Scopely is looking for a highly motivated Director of Performance Marketing for a new, unannounced casual mobile game to join our Performance Marketing Team in Barcelona on a Hybrid basis ! At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily. The Performance Marketing team is focused on driving player growth and efficiency across various digital marketing channels. The teams are based in Europe and the US. The UA team’s mobile advertising ecosystem is an always-changing, rapidly growing world, and at Scopely, you'll play a key part in our next big leap in user growth. Our mission is to make experiences that our players love and keep coming back to time and time again. What You’ll Do You will lead the Performance Marketing team based in Barcelona for a new casual mobile game launching. This role works cross-functionally with Product, Finance, Analytics, Growth Marketing and Data Engineering and is part of the Performance Marketing team at Scopely. Work closely with the global game team and lead the performance marketing team for a new, unannounced title based on an IP You will lead performance marketing efforts for this title, driving global user growth and building scalable acquisition strategies from pre-launch through live operations. Develop UA strategy, methodology and processes to deliver on each game’s performance targets and improve team’s capabilities Bring leading analysis and insight to acquisition funnel measurement, including helping to define & set goals for key performance indicators on each game, and working with Analytics on implementing improved Business Intelligence and Data Science predictions Mentor the performance marketing managers to identify gaps and inefficiencies in campaign creation, analysis and optimization Serve as key team leader offering feedback, guidance & coaching, and industry mentorship to Scopely’s Barcelona-based UA team Drive relentless culture of experimentation on all key existing UA channels (ex.: Facebook, Google, mobile ad networks, ad exchanges, offerwall) while also ideating and establishing new user acquisition funnels Partner with Product, Strategic Marketing, Finance, Analytics, Marketing Creative, and Data Engineering teams to align the UA strategy with game positioning, audience targeting, lifecycle marketing, and business goals Drive deep analytical insights into campaign performance, working with Analytics and Data Science to improve forecasting and decision-making Collaborate cross-functionally to enhance creative strategy, marketing technology, automation, and fraud prevention systems Manage and optimize multi-million-dollar marketing budgets with a focus on ROI and long-term player value What We’re Looking For Fluent in English 8+ years of performance marketing / user acquisition experience, ideally within mobile gaming or consumer apps 4+ years of people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams Deep analytical mindset with experience in attribution, incrementality testing, LTV modeling, and performance forecasting Strong experience with major platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic networks, etc.) Demonstrated expertise in launching, and scaling new products Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills Demonstrated ability to effectively manage and optimize a multi-million dollar acquisition budgets across multiple channels Demonstrated ability to drive major incremental volume & returns from improvements in automation, marketing tech stack, fraud prevention, or analytics Preference (but not required) for experience with match-3, puzzle or other casual mobile games At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure! About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ . Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com . Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice . Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.
